desc: The whole area is in cold colors and Mumu uses her power to bloom a red flower in the shape of her dreams.

name: Carmine Heart
desc: The koi blooms a red flower and carefully places it in Ria's hand, and she feels the joy in the flower.

name: Wave of Rouge
desc: Ria only learned of such startling colors after meeting the koi. She would not grow tired looking at this redness.

name: Thousands of Branches
desc: Vines bloom, and Ria envelops the koi's flower into a vessel. Now, two blooming fires burn over the lake's heart.

name: Vines of Broken Jewels
desc: Ria sends vines to fetch the little red koi here, and its splashing tail makes ripples she had never seen before.

name: Silent Heart Etching
desc: Through nature or habitual silence, Ria doesn't know how to respond to this forever-swimming little one.

name: Clouds Whisper
desc: The branches of the tree shiver with the koi's laugh. This is the first method Ria chose to respond to it.

name: Grasses Wither
desc: When Ria tries awkwardly to imitate the koi's playful smile on her face, the koi leaps up and hugs her neck.

name: Azure Rock in Water
desc: Ria feels the koi is slowly becoming less talkative and just reclines on her knee without splashing.

name: Encounter in Wind
desc: The broad hat is like a boat in the wind, full of greenery. Belonia raises the hat and feels the wind's freedom.

name: Gentle Thoughts
desc: She didn't know what the heroes of legends would take with them, but Belonia always has pen and paper with her.

name: Protagonist
desc: Cats are the cutest protagonists. If they knew they are the heroes of stories, will they go on adventures too?

name: Today's News
desc: Belonia's story makes it to the paper. The hero of the cat kingdom farewells its friends and keeps traveling.

name: Journeying Landmark
desc: The heroic knights have no aims in the story. Fate no longer controls them and they can go with the wind.

name: Chilly Water
desc: Ria tries reaching out to touch the koi's hair tip, but misses the chance as the koi dives.

name: Low Sound in Pond
desc: The silent tree likes eternal solitude and fits the stillness of the lake center. But the happy koi does not.

name: Flying Bird
desc: Bai Yin's paintings are widely sought after. But they seem to care more about her fame than her paintings.

name: Lonely Shadow
desc: Bai Yin used to feel sad about this. But in a world of constant changes, she cannot stay behind.

name: Green Hill at Dusk
desc: When Bai Yin returns, Grandma gently complains that she should have came back earlier.

name: Lights Under Eaves
desc: Bai Yin tries to hum the childhood song, but couldn't remember the melody, because she has been away.

name: Colorful Journey
desc: That world is busy and not as quiet as the small town, but quietness has its own purpose and the city its own joy.

name: Soundless Thoughts
desc: The postman sets off with letters that are still warm. The chariot rolls on like a traveler through time.

name: Colorful Journey - Blue
desc: Josie reviews the letters sent over the years. She is both happy and nervous, expectant and unsettled.

name: Soundless Thoughts - Blue
desc: She writes the news of her admission in the letter and it heads off far away. Friends and dreams will meet her.

name: Colorful Journey - Black
desc: The wish across long years has finally been accoomplished. Josie starts writing a reply to herself.

name: Soundless Thoughts - Black
desc: Josie uses her favorite stamp and puts the letter into the post, feeling like she returned to the small town.

name: Fog in Capital
desc: Dilas proudly believes she is meant to rule everything but is swallowed by powerlessness for the first time.

name: Barren Puppet
desc: Time moves on and all science and civilizations return to their original form. All have their own boats in life.

name: Flaming Hearth
desc: In the world created by the teacher, Dilas lived her life as an ordinary person, only regaining power later.

name: Endless Ruins
desc: This ordinary world never collapsed. All remained functioning on the ancient rules. That's the creator's position.

name: Moonless Cloudy Night
desc: Dilas had witnessed her teacher make worlds. Her teacher never intervened and left decisions to fate and time.

name: Divine Light Blessing
desc: If everything follows time, then what is the purpose of creation? Dilas never gave up the scepter of power.

name: Abyssal Scepter
desc: Omnipotent, Dilas believes she will create a perfect world, and the obsession made her ignore people's cries.

name: Nameless Chapter
desc: The world's cycles of destruction bore Dilas. Her power finally becomes shackled and the light of the scepter fades.

name: In a Moment
desc: The teacher arrives again with no spite towards her failure, but teaches her kindly just like before.

name: Shadow Follows Light
desc: The teacher let Dilas into her world and live as an ordinary mortal, only then can one create without arrogance.

name: Bright Night of Light
desc: As a mortal, Dilas lost her powers. The world, previously so puny, now seems such a giant thing.

name: Clearing Moon
desc: One day, the people of a town wake in the ruins and see the shadow of a spider walking away in the moonlight.

name: Wavebreaker
desc: Whitney pushes open the doors of the tower again. The fishing families all like her and agree to take her to the sea.

name: Familiar Old Sea
desc: It is her first time here but Whitney is familiar with all the islands and whirls. The sea feels like home.

name: Meeting Through Waves
desc: The divine whale was attracted by the song and set a contract to appear whenever the song is sung by the ancestor.

name: Journey on Whale
desc: The ancestor crossed the seas riding the whale and rested on the divine beast as they traveled over open water.

name: Song For a Friend
desc: However, tricked by other people, the ancestor called for the whale, only for it to meet a cruel iron net.

name: Realization of the End
desc: The ancestor realized this and, despite cruel punishments, broke the net to free the wounded divine beast.

name: Shackles of Guilt
desc: The red blood and lamenting cries of the whale traumatized the ancestor. The man wrote the family creed and then died.

name: Fulfill Promises
desc: Whitney decides to apologize to the divine whale for her ancestor. Her elders are shocked, but also agree.

name: Momentary Century
desc: Whitney arrives at the Eternal Sea where her family had lived, and the crystal tower still stands in the water.

name: Ancient Spirit
desc: But she has a premonition and is attracted towards the place of her hopes. All she needs is just a key.

name: The Promised Tide
desc: Black waves roll up and only a small light is left with Whitney. She is not good at singing, but suddenly wants to.

name: Twirling Whale Song
desc: With the girl's song, the ship rolls powerfully and a bright gold appears in the sea. Whitney falls down.

name: Reaching Thoughts
desc: The divine whale answers with a song. This late apology is finally handed over to its rightful recipient.

name: Whale Legends
desc: The fishing villages around the Eternal Sea still have tales about the divine whale that shimmers in the sea.

name: Oath of Time
desc: Lifeforms continuously work to maintain the world, stagnating but also igniting with hope time after time.

name: Shelter From Wave
desc: One day, the sea shook and the dragon princess protected others, then the oyster opened to provide refuge.

name: Floating Gems
desc: The dragon princess returns to her routine, treasures the pearl oyster, and traverses the sea to help others.

name: Thousands of Jewels
desc: The pearl gradually falls into her palm and shines brightly. The dragon explains this oyster is a test for her.

name: Dragon's Intentions
desc: The dragon princess does not understand but the dragon only says she has to think it through herself.

name: Worldly Lights
desc: The dragon told her the oyster contains a great pearl. For it to open, the princess needs a true heart.

name: Morning and Night
desc: She cannot fathom what is a true heart, so she stops others from nearing the oyster, yet it doesn't open.

name: Momentary Chance
desc: The animals are confused, but the turtle states the princess should not isolate the oyster, at the least.

name: Relieve Worries
desc: The sea creatures crowd around the princess' bed, and she asks them what they think is a true heart.

name: Sea Dragon's Brilliance
desc: All the sea creatures gossip that the playful princess no longer leaves the palace and only cares for the oyster.

name: Constant Thoughts
desc: The dragon princess finally understands the dragon's intentions and becomes determined to protect the sea.

name: Floating Green
desc: Bai Yin still likes to hum the songs of her childhood, though without anyone echoing her.

name: Couples Together
desc: The boy in her dreams is far away. Huai Jin keeps reading the letters and manages to calm herself down.

name: Letters of Birds
desc: The war is finally over but the boy does not return. Huai Jin keeps reading the letters, hoping he will return.

name: Dreamy Jewels
desc: The afternoon wind with bright dusk gently touches her black hair as the beautiful girl stands.

name: Shining Snow
desc: Thoughts for one's beloved fill every corner of life, and one only hopes to reunite with one's lover every year.

name: Accompany of Wind and Moon
desc: How can she not worry? But she knows the boy always wanted to fight. She only smiles tearfully and bids him well.

name: Falling Azure Gems
desc: He is the son of the general next door and came to visit when he did not hear laughter from her as per usual.

name: Light Cloud and Wind
desc: As their destiny connects, they fall in love and imagine being together, only for war to call him away.

name: Floating Reeds
desc: The horses come and go, taking away the boy and taking his letters back. These letters give her countless dreams.

name: Elegant Restraint - Ink
desc: Everyone says she is mature now, but she is no longer concerned as she finds happiness in old literature.

name: Seeking Water - Ink
desc: The open pages are like a door to a magic realm that slowly approaches a lost world, like a diver seeing gems.

name: Destined Match - Ink
desc: The soft sound of knocking comes and Qingzhu recovers from her memories, gently closing the book in her hand.

name: Dreamy Mirror - Ink
desc: A student walks in awkwardly and Qingzhu smiles when she sees the ancient literature textbook in her hands.

name: Elegant Restraint - Fog
desc: Songs float in from the ocean and she seems to understand those words. The sky darkens and fog rises from the sea.

name: Seeking Water - Fog
desc: Driven by curiosity, Qingzhu keeps swimming towards the fog to see a dragon spitting gems and mermaids dancing.

name: Destined Match - Fog
desc: Water drops from the merpeople's tails. She catches one drop, discovering it is now a shining pearl.

name: Dreamy Mirror - Fog
desc: Qingzhu stares at the sea in shock. When she wakes, she finds she is sleeping on an old book, Record of Blue Silk.

name: Elegant Restraint
desc: The students stare and do not seem to believe her, but are fascinated by their teacher talking about her past.

name: Seeking Water
desc: Does such a sea really exist?' Someone questions. Qingzhu listens to their query and recalls the sound of the sea.

name: Destined Match
desc: She answers the students and then reads to them Record of Blue Silk. Every word is as beautiful as gems to her.

name: Dreamy Mirror
desc: Qingzhu returns to the office and stares at her table, remembering the story about a dream, a sea, and a girl.

name: Time of Bloom
desc: No need for complicated decorations. The flowers clipped into the girl's hair are already the best decoration.

name: Flipped Heart
desc: No need for awkward invitations or testing words. Zoe and the youth smile at each other and decide to partner up.

name: Summer Handfan
desc: Summer is sweet flowers, gentle breeze, bright dusk, and sparkling fireflies. Summer deserves to be treasured.

name: Throbbing Flowers
desc: Joyful festivals brighten the summer night. Zoe pauses before a shop, as the round fan on sale fits her dress.

name: Time of Bloom - Vines
desc: New flowers bloom and the boy laughs. Zoe lowers her head shyly and the flower falls into the boy's hands.

name: Flipped Heart - Vines
desc: The boy puts the flower into Zoe's hair again. She blushes and turns her head away as he grins and they link hands.

name: Summer Handfan - Vines
desc: The handmade fans are delicate. The boy fans Zoe, who is sleeping on his shoulder, and lets wind fly to her dreams.

name: Throbbing Flowers - Vines
desc: The mountaintop is the best place to watch fireworks. Flowers bloom in the night and leave memories behind.

name: Time of Bloom - Afterglow
desc: Their eyes reflect each other like the dreamy lake. Their encounters are always tied with lakes.

name: Flipped Heart - Afterglow
desc: The boy is the first to say his affections. With summer passion, Zoe goes to meet her other star.

name: Summer Handfan - Afterglow
desc: Summer contains many surprising encounters - gentle whispers, the boy's smile, and the girl's heartbeat.

name: Throbbing Flowers - Afterglow
desc: Zoe lets her head down and the decorative flower is caressed in her hand, the boy's touch still lingers.

name: Colorful Vacations
desc: Summer is the time to have chilled drinks! This tastes pretty good, Nikki. Do you want a try?'

name: Intense Fragrance
desc: They have to dodge the maids and squeaking mice... This trip to the castle is fantastic.

name: Wildflowers
desc: They manage to put together a map that shows that the Valley of Flowers is not far from the castle.

name: Deep Implication
desc: Nervous and scared, Fingasie starts to sob, as someone hands her a handkerchief to wipe away her tears.

name: Aromatic Encounter
desc: The girl is Laverne, an ancient painting-turned elf. Fingasie asks Laverne to take her back home.

name: Following Joyfully
desc: Seeing how expectant Laverne is, Fingasie agrees, but before that, she must find a map.

name: Enchanting Destination
desc: Her wings, which were painted on the canvas, have never tried to fly, but a promise is a promise.

name: Strong Craving
desc: Fingasie tells her traveling stories, in which there are butterflies and flowers that fascinate Laverne.

name: Concealed Fragrance
desc: The hound finally dashes toward the uninvited guests. Fingasie closes her eyes in despair.

name: Unfinished Journey
desc: Fingasie looks forward to a new journey and meeting new partners along the way.

name: Misty Fragrance
desc: They are upset that the map has long been torn up. Fingasie smells something like parchment.

name: Secret Wish
desc: Laverne makes a secret wish to smell the sweetness of all flowers and to learn how to dance in the wind.

name: Ancient Painting Revival
desc: The hound that has been tracking them reveals its fangs as Laverne decides to protect their new hope.

name: Gentle Dance
desc: As if trying to get inspired by Fingasie's description, Laverne swings her wings but fails to fly.

name: Light Snuggling
desc: Laverne cannot fly even with wings. She's never left the castle and cannot imitate the dance of a butterfly.

name: Dormant Memories
desc: For years, no one would listen to Laverne. She doesn't want to see Fingasie in the same position.

name: Travel in the Air
desc: Flowers don't just grow in flower beds but also all over the valley.

name: Butterfly Wings
desc: Laverne decides to take the girl to the castle for the map. On the way, Fingasie tells her own story.

name: Vine's Guidance
desc: Following her memory, Laverne travels through the castle until she collects all the map fragments.

name: New Journey
desc: With the map, Laverne is so excited that she can see the flowers that are blooming in the mountains.

name: Light Companion
desc: The butterflies gather around Laverne to welcome their new friend. They even start to dance joyfully.

name: Imminent Hope
desc: Amid the flowers, Laverne smiles and looks forward to embarking on a new adventure with Fingasie.

name: Colorful Memories
desc: Laverne takes Fingasie to the sky, where she sees mountains, streams, and beyond.

name: Titmice Chirping
desc: The titmice are like elves in the forest, singing happily at treetops and calling out to their friends.

name: Harvest Season
desc: The titmice are getting fledged, the squirrels are busy storing food. On the grain piles, Pine Cone drifts off.

name: Prayer to Flowers
desc: In her dream, Pine Cone plucks a wildflower, which turns into golden wheat ears all over the mountain.

name: Golden Autumn's Gift
desc: The basket is filled with bread made of fresh wheat flour, which attracts a naughty titmouse.

name: Entwined Leaves
desc: Autumn is romantic. Pine Cone opens her treasure box to store the pinecone granted by the squirrel.

name: Sweet Berry Dream
desc: The sweet berries are stewed into thick jams, the aroma of which fills the whole cabin.

name: Orange Melody
desc: Perhaps the orange fruits on the branches will turn into warm lights that decorate Pine Cone's dream.

name: Letter from Hazelnut
desc: The aroma of hazelnuts has given Pine Cone inspiration for cooking. But her friends are not interested.

name: Lantern's Signal
desc: The berries look like clusters of small lanterns scattered in the forest, waiting to be collected.

name: Sweet Pistil
desc: Fingasie feels regretful. She is worried that Laverne would be afraid to embark on a journey of her own.

name: Cute Little Bear
desc: The little bear makes a wish to be even cuter. The next morning, it finds handmade bows on its round ears.

name: Red Berry Whispers
desc: Rich milk and crispy bear-shaped cookies pair perfectly, filling the mouth with sweet aroma to start a lively day!

name: Biscuits & Sweet Dream
desc: The girl enters a pastry world in dream. Cake houses, a fruit platter playground—even buns are cookie-shaped!

name: Endless Celebration
desc: As night falls, countless stalls light up. After work, people gather here to enjoy the mellow beers.

name: Beer Carnival
desc: Empty beer barrels lie on the ground, indicating the end of the wonderful night.

name: Light Chasing
desc: The entrance to the square is packed with malt-colored balloons to invite guests.

name: Bottle Opening
desc: After opening the bottle, she puts the bottle cap in her hair as decoration, which wins unanimous praise.

name: Center of Attention
desc: The beer carnival is always held at this time of the year, during which she participates.

name: Fun Memories
desc: The venue is dotted with distinctive stalls where you can win interesting souvenirs through games.

name: Cheerful Toast
desc: Souvenirs obtained from the games are tied around her wrist to show off her achievements.

name: Night in Mountain
desc: Dusk fades into a single string of light. It opens its eyes to a dark night of howling wind and starlight.

name: Amazing Views
desc: So it remembers, just as the girl does. The girl laughs, and it turns its head to her, as if confused.

name: Departing Winds
desc: The endless night is its domain, with the wind as its messenger. Rustling grass and cricket songs echo.

name: Dream of Future
desc: Students crowd around her after class, talking about their dreams. 'Teacher! If I try hard, can I reach my dream?'

name: Holding Hope
desc: Of course. I did.' She encourages the students with their eyes full of hope like her own teacher had done.

name: Soft Flower Words
desc: Everything is so quiet. She closes her eyes and enjoys the moment. That is when she hears lilting music.

name: Unknown Encounter
desc: She sees a boy in the corner. He stands next to a stone wall, holding a strange instrument. Music rings out.

name: Silence to the Ears
desc: Maple bread is an autumn special, and chocolate doughnuts seem boring... The girl wants spring desserts.

name: Long-Haired Rabbit
desc: She gazes far as she hopes for sudden inspiration for spring. Perhaps it might strike her this morning.

name: Silence to the Ears - Green
desc: The rabbits on the lawn provide the shop's unique scenery. They have to be involved in a product for spring.

name: Long-Haired Rabbit - Green
desc: The girl rubs the cute rabbit and touches the grass it frolicked in. She thinks she has a new plan.

name: Silence to the Ears - Purple
desc: The big gaps between chairs are now full of customers tasting bunny mousse. Rabbits roll on the floor.

name: Long-Haired Rabbit - Purple
desc: The girl behind the counter has a companion. The boy smiles and walks through the seasons with her.

name: Night Butterfly
desc: Are butterflies purple? Rachel recalls the purple in her dream was soft, beautiful, calm, and mysterious.

name: Guided by Stars
desc: Silvery moonlight flows through the night like silk. It decorates travelers' dreams and guides them.

name: Illusions in Time
desc: The silent and quiet night is like spoiled ink, dissolving all color but fostering hope.

name: Radiance in Valley
desc: Rachel finishes dyeing her skirt. Light as wings and sparkling like stars, she wears soft dreams.

name: Night Butterfly - Dawn
desc: Dawn breeze should be the softest green, like new sprouts or the clear eyes of freshly awoken girls.

name: Guided by Stars - Dawn
desc: The breeze parts new grass on spring lakesides and shows blooming flowers, bringing delight and radiant hope.

name: Illusions in Time - Dawn
desc: The girl closes her eyes and thinks of the stars and butterflies in her dream. They give romantic dreams to all.

name: Radiance in Valley - Dawn
desc: At the end, the girl records all the colors. Dreams fade, but hope grows. Colors bear the history of time.

name: Under Star Chapter
desc: The one who saved her belongs to a mountain rescue team. He stays here and patrols to help and guide others.

name: Encounter in Frost
desc: This clingy little snow fox was found with the girl. She hugs the fox and expresses her thanks.

name: Determined Heart
desc: She decides no storm will make her hesitant or confused. She stands tall and steps onto her own path.

name: Under Star Chapter - Successor
desc: The star on her hat shines as a testimony to Cynthia helping others, but she never slacks due to it.

name: Encounter in Frost - Successor
desc: Fully awake, the snow fox leaps out and plays with the team. It grew with Cynthia and spent years with her.

name: Determined Heart - Successor
desc: Cynthia always remembers the small but bright fire in the cave. She wants to be a light to continue the fire.

name: Virtual Illusions
desc: Recently, a virtual game took the land by storm, allowing people to connect their minds to the game.

name: Blinding Rainbow
desc: She never wants to be a hero or warrior in the game, satisfied with just putting her all into normal hobbies.

name: Speedy Charm
desc: The last leaf falls as winter comes. The lonely girl starts the game and drowns herself in the virtual world.

name: New Challenge
desc: After many failures, she lacks the courage to undergo more surgeries. She looks quietly from her wheelchair.

name: Virtual Illusions - Mirror
desc: The virtual reality glass is now covered in dust. She once again finishes a round of tough rehab.

name: Blinding Rainbow - Mirror
desc: Her attempts at music and roller skating all reach great outcomes. She finally understands she must face illness.

name: Speedy Charm - Mirror
desc: The handheld stereo still plays a melody. She wants to keep going and gives this courage to everyone.

name: New Challenge - Mirror
desc: A year later, an avatar lights up again. There are many new things she will challenge in the game with her friends.

name: Unique Gift
desc: Skeleton and Phoebe make a strange scene. Some even feel the bones pull on the hem of her shirt for attention.

name: Demure Tea
desc: Finally, some brave student touches the bones on Phoebe's hat. The bony hand happily waves back.

name: Passage of Time
desc: Students say this friendly bony hand must be related to the strange adventure the professor never divulges.

name: Elegant Scholar
desc: Phoebe is always holding her cane, which is polished by time. It accompanied her on many travels and jobs.

name: Unique Gift - Elegance
desc: Phoebe believes their encounter is a gift. A friendship from the grave is always a precious memory.

name: Demure Tea - Elegance
desc: When Phoebe became a professor, she sometimes wondered when she started taking history seriously.

name: Passage of Time - Elegance
desc: Perhaps it was from the first encounter with Miss Skeleton. Phoebe realized history is the lives of bygone people.

name: Elegant Scholar - Elegance
desc: When would she share this with her students? Probably when she retires. Phoebe wants to treasure it alone.

name: Unique Gift - Warmth
desc: Phoebe read the story of a noble lady on the gravestone, who passed young and had nothing significant.

name: Demure Tea - Warmth
desc: It was the first time Phoebe met the protagonist of a story. The bony hand jumped onto her knee, memories floating.

name: Passage of Time - Warmth
desc: The bony hand slept for a long time till Phoebe arrived, and it thought about how not to scare her.

name: Elegant Scholar - Warmth
desc: The cold words suddenly became more alive. Phoebe realized every historical piece contains a real human life.

name: Classic Memories
desc: Some graves looked good as new, with legible words and even flowers before them. These had visitors.

name: Reminiscing
desc: Yet some faded into obscurity, and cobwebs and weeds covered the name of the deceased. These were forgotten.

name: Fragrance of the Past
desc: An older lady Madina knows is buried here. She loved bright colors and had a red rose by her window.

name: Eternal Rose
desc: Madina didn't have colorful flowers. She made a fabric rose and placed it before the lady's grave.

name: Classic Memories - Gorgeous
desc: Many people's lives are ordinary but also filled with emotions. How can a small gravestone contain all that?

name: Reminiscing - Gorgeous
desc: Her youth, beauty, work, life, love, and all her fulfilled and unfulfilled wishes all disappear in memories.

name: Fragrance of the Past - Gorgeous
desc: If possible, Madina wishes she can remember them for longer, and save those lives for as long as she can.

name: Eternal Rose - Gorgeous
desc: Madina tidies up the grave, places a colorful bouquet at the lady's grave, then leaves to study.

name: Classic Memories - Rare
desc: Madina helped many elders turn the memories they want preserved into intricate art.

name: Reminiscing - Rare
desc: Madina also feels incredibly calm when her family passes away, as if it is only a normal farewell.

name: Fragrance of the Past - Rare
desc: Lively colors appear on the roses she draws. She knows her mother loved colors, just as she does.

name: Eternal Rose - Rare
desc: Madina uses her brush to portray past times, continuing the lives of the dead in a different way.

name: Classic Memories - Sunny
desc: Some feel this represents the three stages of human life, some feel these are the three emotions people long for.

name: Reminiscing - Sunny
desc: The three roses seem like codes Madina left for people, getting them to explore out of a desire for beauty.

name: Fragrance of the Past - Sunny
desc: They are like epitaphs Madina made for herself, leaving their colors forever on history's blank slate.

name: Eternal Rose - Sunny
desc: When Madina's color appears in a new design, it's like she touched the heart of others across time.

name: Classic Memories - Night
desc: She sits before the window and tries to record everything with her brush, but she is carrying too much.

name: Reminiscing - Night
desc: Even time is against her. Familiar faces fade in her head, and memories fade like tides.

name: Fragrance of the Past - Night
desc: Three different roses are wildly scribbled on the canvas. Her mind is blank, and she is pouring everything into it.

name: Eternal Rose - Night
desc: Nothing lasts forever. Madina sinks into eternal sleep with her residual regret and longing.

name: Data Collision
desc: The sailors return to the sea and sing the songs written for the singer, who harmonizes from afar, echoing their sincerity.

name: Starlight in Waves
desc: With the singer's protection, sailors no longer fear the unpredictable ocean. She is their undying starlight.

name: Starlit Guidance
desc: On stormy nights, sailors would see her walking toward them with light above her head, pointing them in the right direction.

name: Bygone Lullaby
desc: She would wave patterns of light upon the open seas. Fish and birds are her most loyal viewers, swarming to be by her side.

name: Data Ocean
desc: Those she had helped spread the name of the mermaid singer on land and composed many touching songs for her.

name: Virtual Movement
desc: The sailors who wanted to pay her back tried to take her to land, but she declined with a smile and disappeared.

name: Waves' Variations
desc: Many lullabies are saved in the water-proof data chip. She keeps learning new songs for new visitors.

name: Windswept Slumber
desc: Honeyberry would make all sorts of toys. All children come to the intersection of stories and reality.

name: Butterfly Murmurs
desc: Lonely kids receive a partner. Crybabies get a laughing pumpkin. Those scared of the dark get a lamp.

name: New Moon Poetry
desc: Honeyberry hopes her toys will stay with the children when they don't have family and give them warmth.

name: Time's Gift
desc: Annie wants her own goat toy. She went to every shop, but not a single toy looks like her goat Fluffy.

name: Soft Protection
desc: One day, Honeyberry sees a new visitor. She is a girl named Annie and has a surprising request.

name: Windswept Slumber - Gorgeous
desc: Honeyberry often invites Annie over to pass a happy afternoon with tea, then asks Annie to write a story.

name: Butterfly Murmurs - Gorgeous
desc: This story contains heroes and villains, with magic forests and elven lakes. Annie is immersed in this world.

name: New Moon Poetry - Gorgeous
desc: But who is the protagonist? Honeyberry doesn't tell her until they've made a complete story.

name: Time's Gift - Gorgeous
desc: The brave goat defeats the villains in the forest, leaving with her best friend Annie to a good end.

name: Soft Protection - Gorgeous
desc: The relaxing time flows by and Honeyberry gives the story to Annie, and the protagonist is the magic goat Annabelle.

name: Windswept Slumber - Rare
desc: A month later, Honeyberry leads children on an adventure. They huddle together in the dark castle.

name: Butterfly Murmurs - Rare
desc: Honeyberry is prepared and has many carved pumpkins on the table. Other pumpkins light up the castle.

name: New Moon Poetry - Rare
desc: Children discover in surprise that the castle has a feast inside. Was it prepared by the witch here?

name: Time's Gift - Rare
desc: Honeyberry had prepared a special castle adventure in the last month. Every child is a brave soldier in the castle.

name: Soft Protection - Rare
desc: The pumpkin lanterns wobble and the fear of the dark disappears. They explore seriously and find many toys.

name: Windswept Slumber - Berry
desc: The girl lost many things growing up. Not everyone can be a protagonist. There was no magic in her life.

name: Butterfly Murmurs - Berry
desc: An unknown lady helped her when the girl was at her lowest. She taught the girl how to make up for what's missing.

name: New Moon Poetry - Berry
desc: Not every parting leads to reunion, and not every story ends well, but the time spent is the best memory.

name: Time's Gift - Berry
desc: The girl became less sad and emulated that lady. That lady brought magic, and the girl now brings it to others.

name: Soft Protection - Berry
desc: The lady gave the girl a teddy bear before she left, hoping the toy will be with the girl after she leaves.

name: Windswept Slumber - Maple
desc: While with Honeyberry, Annie realizes the adults also send gifts, and they also harbor a fairytale.

name: Butterfly Murmurs - Maple
desc: They helped Honeyberry prepare for the castle adventure. They clumsily carved pumpkin lanterns and enjoyed the fun.

name: New Moon Poetry - Maple
desc: Meticulous jobs filled her boring days. Sometimes Annie feels she is weaving time for others and herself.

name: Time's Gift - Maple
desc: Maybe a child will one day ask Annie to make a magic toy, and Annie will have the best magic by then.

name: Soft Protection - Maple
desc: Children growing up in a fairytale start to help others. Annie takes on Honeyberry's mantle.

name: Sharp Bone Blades
desc: The ageless priestess comes to the tribe on nights of the full moon, singing ancient songs and praying for peace.

name: Sealed Fantasies
desc: They recreate the bonfire and try to beseech the gods with the same ritual, but no one can host the ceremony.

name: Gathered Light
desc: What's so different about the priestess of the mountain? The youth regard rituals as superstition and ignore them.

name: Barren Wastes
desc: As long as people sing the ancient songs, they will find the courage to face everything on their difficult journey.

name: Fading Oath
desc: When those who lived through difficulties look back, they realize their children no longer have faith.

name: Searching for A Rose
desc: The fertile land gradually cracks, the clear water becomes stained, and encroaching invasions destroy peace.

name: Reversed Time
desc: Without the blessing of the god, this land shows its cruel face, sweeping the people before it.

name: Guidance of the Moon
desc: The people build a new tribe at the oasis, lighting a bonfire every full moon to remember the guardian priestess.

name: End of Enigma
desc: The elders recall how they first arrived here — it was the priestess' power that made crops grow and gave life.

name: Chanting Lament
desc: As children cry at night, a tune suddenly rings out on the hills to soothe those who are suffering.

name: Pristine Protection
desc: People try to visit her in regret, yet the priestess' house stands empty, forcing the tribe to abandon the land.

name: Broken Dawning Light
desc: Closing their eyes, the tribe waits for final judgment, only for a silver light to pierce the darkness.

name: Unbroken Fate
desc: In despair, the people gather and sing the ancient ritual song for the last time, remembering their peaceful days.

name: Fragile Rainbow
desc: The priestess' figure fades with the sandstorm. Her final blessing appears as white flowers blooming on the path.

name: End of Eeriness
desc: The people open their eyes in confusion, finding the priestess wielding her bow to calm this disaster.

name: Summer Sunlight
desc: Xiaoqi recalls the summers of her childhood. Those memories are hidden in the depth of her mind.

name: A Ray of Sunlight
desc: Xiaoqi used to believe that nothing would linger forever in her heart but has now changed her mind.

name: Flower Season Tour
desc: The passing time seems to roam the streets with the wind.

name: Sunflower Island
desc: Every day of the trip is so bright that the melancholy of separation is dispersed.

name: Ice Cream Cone
desc: The taste of sweet strawberries and rich cream fills her mouth. The girl heads home accompanied by this pleasantry.

name: Ghostly Talisman
desc: The scholar intended to greet that guy. But when he opened his eyes, he found himself in the Cloud Capital.

name: Unfulfilled Will
desc: The owner of the mansion was Gu Ya, who detained evil ghosts in the mansion.

name: Hellish River
desc: Ordinary people were all afraid of the ghosts in the mansion. Therefore, they would always take a detour.

name: Vermilion Reflection
desc: A long time ago, a scholar passed by this place on his way to the Cloud Capital for the imperial exam.

name: Golden Scales
desc: He did not dare to open his eye. Soon after, a male voice suppressed the creepy voices around.

name: Passage of Time
desc: A horrifying cry petrified him. Amid the sands stirred up by the wind, he couldn't help but close his eyes.

name: Wind and Moon
desc: But the closer he got to the river, the colder he felt. The silver-like river seemed to lead to hell.

name: Deserted Mansion
desc: Mesmorized by the long river under the moon, the young scholar couldn't help but step forward.

name: River to Underworld
desc: The water flew to the deep. Any mortal who approached it would be infected with an incurable disease.

name: Black Water
desc: The river reminded him of an ancient legend. As he looked around, he found his surroundings changed.

name: From the Underworld
desc: The scholar didn't know if they had a chance to meet again. Finally he bowed in the direction of Mt. Tai Chi.

name: Everything in the Dream
desc: Since then, many people who heard the legend visited the mountain. Yet the Taoist never showed up again.

name: Song of the Heart
desc: Step on fluffy clouds and seek stars. Even without crystal shoes, you can dance tonight when sweet dreams descend.

name: Wondrous Stars
desc: The wondrous universe and the Milky Way appear - I want to explore distant worlds lightyears away and play with stars.

name: Colorful Memories
desc: The wind becomes multi-colored after rain, and lights dance between clouds like stellar flowers in the sky.

name: Soft Sweetness
desc: Fluffy clouds are made of the sweetest icing. Rest on them when you're tired, and sleep with the sweet scent.

name: Zephyr's Words
desc: The pinwheel suddenly spins as sweetness infuses the air. Are you ready, friend? We're about to go on an adventure.

name: Double Achievement
desc: Unlike in the arena and debate hall, Elaine reduces her shine when reciting poetry, becoming romantic and quiet.

name: Transparent Tag
desc: At the start of the year, the poetry club invites everyone to write anonymous poems and vote for a winner.

name: Under the Glory
desc: Submissions pour in and the best one soon emerges. It is gentle and charming, and all try to guess its author.

name: Cute Journey
desc: Elaine covers the student's mouth and drags them toward the poetry club with a smile. She wants to read poems!

name: Good Times for Moon
desc: Apart from normal moon balls, the girl also made some with new fillings. She arranges them and heads to her friends.

name: Splendid Rabbit
desc: How can there be no rabbit lantern at this festival? The girl caresses it and puts her wishes into its decor.

name: Mannered Professional
desc: A few years ago, Xie Jinghe's dearest brother contracted a disease, and the family could not get a cure for him.

name: Mid-Autumn Night
desc: The storyteller changes the tone and indicates there may be some hope yet in this desperation.

name: Worshiping the Moon
desc: In mid-autumn, the family offered goods to the moon and suddenly saw a rabbit with cassia twigs.

name: Floating Fragrance
desc: The family was shocked to hear the rabbit speak and obeyed it. Soon, the man was cured, and this story was told.

name: Flaming Lilies
desc: It thanked Xie Jinghe for helping a divine rabbit and says these cassia twigs used as tea will save the brother.

name: Cassia Fairyland
desc: The story ends and everyone cheers for the good ending. Moonlit City is as busy as ever.

name: Dream Talking
desc: Light silk drapes down for an otherworldly experience. All stress flies away in a soft comfy bed.

name: Bells in Valley
desc: Leanne learns during her work that talented designers are not always good at marketing, and she runs into trouble.

name: Refreshing Spring
desc: The fast-paced Apple Federation is different from Pigeon Kingdom. Efficient traders don't prioritize comfort.

name: Incoming Greenery
desc: Greenery from distant kingdoms grows in the shop's garden, framed in the window like an ethereal painting.

name: Comforting Dreams
desc: She wants to make the comfiest home and offer a respite for tired hearts! Lynn decides to be an interior designer.

name: Floating White
desc: Lynn heads out to Apple Federation, hoping this trade paradise can help her fulfill her dream faster.

name: Embroidered Tassels
desc: Inspiration overflows and Lynn smiles. Maybe this lady she had yet to meet will give her shop the pivot it needs.

name: Divine Bird
desc: This medicine is marvelous and quickly cures the girl, but where is Qing? The girl decides to look for her.

name: Mystical Flowers
desc: The girl dreams of Qing saying she is unwilling to leave, and promises the girl a future of freedom.

name: Tonight's Dream
desc: The girl wants to tell Qing that her life still has good moments, the best being meeting Qing.

name: Moon on the Pavilion
desc: The next evening, an elder suddenly visits, bringing a medicine Qing had created to cure the girl.

name: Fog on Mountain
desc: The divine bird recovers in a month and the girl takes her back. The bird's teal form flies off.

name: Reasons of Lily
desc: Later, someone knocks on the sick girl's door. She calls herself Qing and says she's a neighbor.

name: Genuine Heart
desc: The girl is fascinated by the world Qing describes. Her sickly form can only go to the river before her door.

name: Moon in River
desc: Qing asks the girl to see the world with her, but the girl smiles and says none can cure her body.

name: Confident Ascension
desc: The girl grows frailer by the day, yet always smiles at Qing. Qing silently makes a decision.

name: Late Wind
desc: The girl doesn't even wince when she drinks bitter medicine, saying she is used to this taste.

name: Song of Courage
desc: A small blue flag finally pops up in the distance. It waves twice, then quickly disappears into the night.

name: Flame Breaking Dawn
desc: Waiting is always hard. Agata and her army hide and feel excited despite the cold evening wind.

name: The Light of Victory
desc: Soon, there's the sound of driving across ice. With no transport, League Tyr's logistics have to cross here.

name: Age of Glory
desc: Agata looks more firm. She grabs her sword and listens to determine the distance. 50 meters... 30 meters...

name: Fearless Blade
desc: The vanguard cannot come back, or League Tyr will notice. If they fail... the vanguard will be all that remains.

name: Scorching Fields
desc: Agata sees blue light cover the sky. She knows what she will be facing, but she does not stop.

name: Ruler of Destiny
desc: The vanguards find League Tyr. The small blue flags are concealed and can only be seen from certain locations.

name: Chilly Wind
desc: Agata doesn't move, and the soldiers with her all remain as they are, as if they never saw anything.

name: Age of Honor
desc: Crack.' The ice snaps. League Tyr troops fall into chaos as the ice unexpectedly starts to break.

name: Light Shining Night
desc: That's all the alliance needs to surround them. The logistic troops don't even get to send a distress signal.

name: Elegant Form
desc: Rae-Anne returns to her studio after a busy day, only daring to relax after the last assistant leaves.

name: Every Second Matters
desc: Time is money in Apple Federation, the 'Commercial Paradise.' Rae-Anne's schedule is packed and always ready.

name: Shining Moment
desc: All glamour in life depends on grounded, hard work. Only by shedding sweat and tears can one reach the pinnacle.

name: Ahead of Fashion
desc: Cameras go off as Rae-Anne lifts her head. As long as she remains proud, she will be at the forefront of fashion.

name: Revitalizing Scent
desc: Rumor says that Rae-Anne is very harsh with other people, and she does not allow even the smallest mistake.

name: Splendid Dreams
desc: Rae-Anne wraps her cloak around herself. She thinks of her new home, which is only missing some interior design.

name: With the Times
desc: Rae-Anne won't waste even one minute. She reads newspapers between projects to keep up with fashion trends.

name: Perfectionist
desc: Rae-Anne must control everything. There is no 'passing grade' for her. She must make everything perfect.

name: Immaculate Aura
desc: Rae-Anne views sites to quickly pick a designer. She just needs simple designs to meet her working-from-home needs.

name: Delightful Greens
desc: Some tall plants quietly stand in the corner of the simple studio, showing aloof pride like their owner.

name: Latest News
desc: Exhausted after the day, Rae-Anne dials the number, but the name she hears isn't the shop she expects.

name: Hymn of Dawn
desc: Darkness seems to swallow all, and the silent night indicates death to all things. However, dawn will come.

name: Exuded Tenderness
desc: No one knows if Yoyo studied that magic book... To get an answer, you may try to use dried minnows.

name: Unopened Chapter
desc: Yoyo has a long way to go before she becomes the world's best, but she has done a lot to help others.

name: Fairy Tale Trip
desc: The cat replied that it was going to the cloudy universe, which required more than 100 dried minnows.

name: Fantasy Murmurs
desc: With the spell book left by grandma, she aspires to become the best magician!

name: Across Cloud Realm
desc: The cat was attracted by Yoyo's promise to 'make every wish come true'.

name: Warm Morning Light
desc: Yoyo was not able to fulfill its wish, of course. She could only buy a bag of dried minnows for it.

name: Sweet Gifts
desc: Yoyo wondered why the cat needed so many dried minnows. Perhaps it was about to embark on a journey.

name: Magic Key
desc: The cat stayed silent for a moment before it asked how Yoyo fulfilled people's wishes before.

name: Soft Cloud Voice
desc: Yoyo failed to get dried minnows for the cat. But she guessed that grandma's book will be loved by the cat.

name: Secret Words of Time
desc: The cat stayed in town. It may leave anytime, but it just couldn't leave Yoyo behind.

name: Wandering Mind
desc: Sayu shared the spell book with the cat and assured it that the book includes the most powerful magic.

name: Fantastic Journey
desc: When you see the cat, you can drop it a piece of dried minnow, so that it will take you to Yoyo.

name: Capricious Gemini
desc: Over time, the girl's theatrical soul possesses a personality. She is able to talk, listen, or debate.

name: Truth in Dreams
desc: The townsfolk are amazed by her perseverance toward theater but laugh at her 'other soul.'

name: Awakening Soul
desc: Whenever she performs, the other soul would wake. It would move and change with the characters' moods and actions.

name: Prayer Manifestation
desc: This soul should be connected to her passion and desire for theater, a manifestation of her dream to be accepted.

name: Breeze Brings Goodness
desc: Every time she herds sheep to the mountains, the breeze passes her songs to the villagers and soothes them.

name: Flowers of the Heart
desc: With the soul to help her practice, the girl is not alone in her pursuit and understands the art of the theater.

name: Admiration Song
desc: She fully expresses her admiration toward gods. Every character, dance, song, and expression of hers is perfect.

name: Called by Divines
desc: Light flows out of the divine mountain and wraps around the girl, taking her to the gods' realm as Gemini.

name: Melody of Berries
desc: Interwoven colors and happy tunes create the fantasy she had recounted many times to her lover.

name: Stainless Heart
desc: The girl finally sees the boy before the carousel. He shyly gives her a red flower, like he is offering his heart.

name: Willow Gazes
desc: Her homeland's murmur echoes in her head. It is the night wind she alone heard and the ever-flowing water...

name: Floating Lamp Dreams
desc: Then, the dawn comes and pours light on her. She says she will go far away to see new mountains and towns.

name: Embroidered Pouch
desc: The unique symbol on the bag has a lovely story. It is a pure wish sewn from moonlight by a girl.

name: Evernight Prayers
desc: Fog covers the moon, and night silently spreads. The girl prays in the empty hall for the wandering travelers.

name: Pitch-Black Style
desc: Classic colors, simple shapes. This is the Apple Apparel Group's latest project, spearheading a different trend!

name: Evening Star Glitter
desc: Under the moonlight, only a few stars glitter. The girl quickly traverses this silent city.

name: Flower in Time
desc: Humans desire roses for their beauty and form, but none can pluck this one and claim it as their own.

name: Crystallized Jewel
desc: But all roses die and beautiful faces grow old. Monesa is troubled by her fading and transient beauty.

name: Dreamy Rose in a Painting
desc: Admiring the girl's beauty, famous artists of the capital paint her on canvas to ensure this rose never wilts.

name: Evenglow Halls
desc: The young artist pours all his love into the white canvas, and a rose-colored bird passes through the spring air.

name: Fragrant Rosy Dreams
desc: Monesa receives the painting. She and the girl on the canvas are equally beautiful as if the rose is a mirage.

name: Bizarre Pumpkin
desc: Werid pumpkins were placed in yard. The girl put her beloved toy skeleton beside them. Let them enjoy party!

name: Encounter in Autumn
desc: Brown fruits fall and make thuds on the ground. If you pick them up, will brave squirrels come seeking?

name: Forest Echoes
desc: The burrow is full, and the squirrels are satisfied. They happily run in the forest in golden autumn light.

name: Sleep on Pillow
desc: Frost descends and squirrels no longer travel the frozen land. They rub their eyes and return to their burrows.

name: Hidden Spring
desc: The squirrels start to sleep. These fruits holding bright sunlight will accompany them till spring returns.

name: Traceless Feathers
desc: A clear chirp rings out. Ming Shuiyuan looks up to see a bird gracefully spreading its wings toward the blue sky.

name: Clear Sight
desc: A beam of inspiration disperses the mist in her heart. Her night-long work on the mech bird exudes unmatched charm.

name: Personality of Jade
desc: Wind stirs petals across the courtyard. The wooden bird rests under the eaves as the girl focuses on new designs.

name: Letters of Dawn
desc: Outside the window, a crow shot to the sky. Its wings cut the dark clouds, and light were shed upon the town.

name: Scarlet Legend
desc: Everyone'd heard of the rumours, but no one had ever seen misfortune. The stories scattered in the boy's heart.

name: A Touch of Autumn
desc: He's grown up, and it's time to solve the mystery. The boy gazed into the steaming syrup and made up his mind.

name: Red Moon Crystal
desc: With full-moon high and maples red, the boy set off for the forest. He went lost in mist and almost fell off the cliff.

name: Exorcism Array
desc: He thought of the elderly's saying: Sweetness may attract envy and evil, so maple town wasn't good for living.

name: Night Dream Feather
desc: Misfortune did not happen. The boy opened his eyes to see the figure of a girl waving a thin fan, dispelling the mist.

name: Sweet Night Dreams
desc: Not understanding her meaning, the boy fell asleep. When he woke up again, he was back home. It was dawn.

name: Interwoven Thoughts
desc: The dreamweaving magician made many dreams and a sincere wish for herself. Ray finally fulfills her dreams.

name: Soft Sweet Dreams
desc: The Magic League formalizes, and young magicians pick up their hope again. Ray wove the best dream.

name: Overlapping Dreams
desc: The League's founder is mysterious, yet many have seen her magical vessel — a unique black cat plush.

name: Meow Messenger
desc: A few years ago, Ray and some apprentices knocked on the Magic Association's door, but only the best were hired.

name: Duo-Colored Stars
desc: Ray is the dreamweaving magician's apprentice. She fulfilled wishes and resolved regrets, just like her teacher.

name: Cloudy Imagination
desc: The others were taken in, but Ray was surprisingly rejected. This outstanding magician then disappeared.

name: Flowing Light Wishes
desc: All magicians long for the Magic Association. Its golden doors signal peerless power and glory.

name: Dream-Weaving Toy
desc: Every year, magicians try their best to be admitted, yet the Association's golden doors gather dust.

name: Long Road of Time
desc: The ancient power and complicated rules deter many, and the critical teachers scold youth and drive them out.

name: Meow Gifts
desc: The genius Ray only managed to make a small dent in the history of magic, and her story was soon forgotten.

name: Meow Poet
desc: Meanwhile, the mysterious Magic League starts up and welcomes all magicians. Many talents join and make it famous.

name: Meow Special
desc: Tears and sweat soak her dreams, and only the black cat plush supports her. It sees Ray through difficult times.

name: Pristine Flower Crown
desc: Driven by a desire to prove her parents wrong or to honor her younger self, Pololo keeps dancing.

name: Cloud in Prosperity
desc: Pololo performs as a background dancer in her first-year showcase only for a few minutes, but her dream feels real.

name: Hanging Feather
desc: Like an innocent swan, Pololo believes she will one day become the stage's protagonist.

name: Pristine Flower Crown - Gorgeous
desc: Pololo is still a background dancer in a plain dress when she graduates, supporting the protagonist.

name: Cloud in Prosperity - Gorgeous
desc: Pololo leaves with many regrets. She recognizes who she is and leaves the school with her dreams.

name: Hanging Feather - Gorgeous
desc: Praise is always given to the protagonist. No one notices when a small swan leaves the stage.

name: Hanging Feather - Rare
desc: When dancing is not a job but a hobby, the happy little swan can still feel joy.

name: Pristine Flower Crown - Rare
desc: The protagonists wear the dresses Pololo designed and portray many romantic stories that enrapture people.

name: Cloud in Prosperity - Rare
desc: Pololo also dances a little when she doesn't work. This isn't a performance — it is only for relaxation.

name: Hanging Feather - Dusk
desc: A swan has left the stage, but it helps many other dancers to emerge. The swan will still be happy!

name: Cloud in Prosperity - Dusk
desc: Pololo realizes she almost repeated her parents' mistake by forcing her own daughter onto a specific path.

name: Pristine Flower Crown - Dusk
desc: I love dancing, but not as a career. If I work with Mom, I can show more people the beauty of dance.'

name: Time Illusion
desc: You are...,' the boy seemed to understand. The girl turned, covering her smile with the feather fan, 'sorry. It's time.'

name: Calling by Name
desc: Names mean nothing to the Winged. They live alone and have no need to address each other, ignoring names.

name: Breath of Nature
desc: The Winged need no language or history. Their words come from birds and sounds of nature.

name: Glazed Memoirs
desc: They spend their whole life writing one poem to record the views they see, and everyone hums a song to time.

name: The Last Eulogy
desc: Death is a beautiful end of the story. Everyone will head to that silent end. The Winged want no regrets.

name: Newborn Prelude
desc: Life is the first note that wakes everyone. The Winged wake alone and pay no attention to anyone else.

name: All Are Reborn
desc: All magic medicines can be made by the Winged through the golden fire they control naturally.

name: Pitch-Black Ritual
desc: When coarse and ugly notes interrupt songs, the Winged decide to change this situation, regardless of price.

name: Truth Untold
desc: The birds can understand the Winged and know their desires. They are willing to fly with the Winged.

name: Gloom and Decay
desc: Maybe there's more to life's poem beyond the black mist, or it is eternal silence. The Winged head to their goal.

name: Flowers in the Rainbow
desc: With blooming purple lilies of the valley, the fairies fly over the rainbow to the human world in search of dew.

name: Genuine Tears
desc: It is said that human tears form the holy dew, and fairies gain power from appeasing such sorrow.

name: Silent Days
desc: The fairies keep bringing happiness to people on this bright land, and their necklaces finally fill with dew.

name: Crystal Clear
desc: They gather the dew together and prepare to return home, but chance upon a blind girl dancing alone.

name: Fragrant Blooms
desc: The children previously considered young and weak can now change the weather and bloom the flowers in the garden.

name: Jeweled Heart
desc: The pinnacle of a fairy's journey is to have a diamond heart. Having seen mortal woes, their hearts indeed changed.

name: Bottle of Dreams
desc: The girl is dressed in poor clothes yet does not make a wish to the fairies, only saying others need the help more.

name: Fleeting Mortal Ties
desc: The Duan mansion finally falls into ruin. Those happy days rest deep in her memories with bygone poems.

name: Lonely Hill
desc: As trouble goes on, the prune tree in the yard is no longer attended to, and the gardens fall into disrepair.

name: Poems of the Past
desc: Duan Yue gradually understands her grandma's poems. Past glories fade into tiny streams as time flows.

name: Clouded Whispers
desc: Young and naive, Duan Yue lives through dark times as cruel reality rushes at her without the glamour of wealth.

name: Steady Flower
desc: Her heart is tenacious despite her spoiled childhood, and she becomes a famous antique dealer.

name: Fog on the Hills
desc: Mere decorations are given profound meaning in the turmoils of the world, carrying human memories and lives.

name: Echoing Hills
desc: Duan Yue moves on, knowing that all shall return to a simple end. Grandma would be proud of her.

name: Collected Beauty
desc: Duan Yue takes good care of antiques, just like her grandma did. She had unconsciously taken up this hobby.

name: Card Battle
desc: The cards the Red Queen scatters pick up sharp gems to make spears and line up to be her impressive guards.

name: Apple Castle
desc: The red apple from her hand miraculously grows into tall castles that stand in the wind.

name: Flame in Snow
desc: Roses do not bloom in winter, but because of the Queen's invite, all roses arrive and bloom in the castle.

name: Dancing Staircase
desc: The dancing rose petals become girls in red as the Queen's wand touches them. They play music and dance.

name: Red Spade Crown
desc: The Red Queen has many hair ornaments, but still wears her favorite ruby crown to show her power at formal parties.

name: Sparkling Gem
desc: Sometimes, she wants to see red snow. She levitates a ruby and shines it on the snow.

name: Scarlet Secret
desc: She prepares masks with red and white clothes for the visitors so as not to disrupt the colors in the hall.

name: Crimson Treasure
desc: The marvelous gems on her fingertips are a memory of feasts. She gives them to visitors for a good memory.

name: Conductor's Hand
desc: Snow fairies brush off snow from the visitors and lead them to the feast, tending to guests' every need.

name: Frost & Snow Magic
desc: Invited guests arrive via flying chariot or teleportation portal, not leaving any signs on the snow.

name: Wand of Majesty
desc: The Red Queen was born with her power, but she feels it looks more elegant and powerful to wave a wand.

name: Glorious Starfire
desc: Even at night, her palace needs no light. Gems and snow reflect the moonlight and illuminate all corners.

name: Laughing Banquet
desc: The wine glasses hold molten snow, and the guests converse elegantly as laughter rings over snow.

name: Magic Feast
desc: After the feast, the Red Queen waves her wand and removes all traces of her miracle, but people remember.

name: Frozen Bloom
desc: For the long-lived Animus, all appear naive. They do not look down on lives and equally love all.

name: Crystal-Clear Ice
desc: There's an ancient myth in the Glazed World that black mist sits above the sky and will slowly corrode it.

name: Forgotten Snow Plains
desc: The black mist also conceals a terrifying truth, and the masks will drive the mist to destroy the Glazed World.

name: Lost Butterfly Fog
desc: Many races live in this art-like world, and they develop and grow into their different fates.

name: Icy Feathers
desc: The Animus and Acolytes preserve their contract and join hands to protect the Glazed World's barriers.

name: Barren Rituals
desc: A white bird once stopped on the spring. As the water dries, the bird leaves as well.

name: Timeless Glaze
desc: Their soul contains an unquenchable belief, and they seek the happiness of their race.

name: Cloudy Flower Crown
desc: As the black mist descends and corrodes the crystal sky, there's not much time left for the Acolytes and the world.

name: Brief Whisper
desc: Older Acolytes struggle to move around, and the rulers plan for them to escape in exchange for information.

name: Fog Concealing Light
desc: All Acolytes have a summoning staff that they make themselves and form the tightest bond with.

name: Shimmering Light
desc: The valley the Acolytes live in has a fountain. It gradually loses its brightness and dims.

name: Golden Flower Splendor
desc: The innocence of young Acolytes should be protected. The rulers don't show any stress and keep smiling.

name: Gap to Otherworld
desc: Mrs. Slant was so frightened by the rumors. she pulled the curtain and disappeared into the darkness.

name: Broken Spell
desc: Your soul will be captured by a glance. She seals those poor souls and stores them in her art gallery.

name: Prisoner Whispers
desc: Ordinary people have been bothered by the children but Mrs. Slant just looked at them quietly with smiles.

name: Unreal World Soul
desc: The children laughed and shook their heads. The witch in the story is always old and ugly and has no patience.

name: Rare Classic Treasure
desc: The art gallery in front of you is as solemn as a castle. The signboard of this newly appeared art museum is old.

name: Sign of No Words
desc: The leading child knocked on the door lightly. The door was opened, and there was a bright and spacious hall.

name: Dragonshard Glow
desc: Mrs. Slant walked down the stairs. Seeing these innocent kids, she seemed a little surprised but soon smiled softly.

name: Ambiguous Truth
desc: She welcomed everyone with smiles and took the children to see the countless rare collections in the hall.
