name: Blossom Pact
desc: During a break, a raccoon brought her a fragrant cake. She took a bite—it was Grandma’s fruit mille-feuille!

name: Silky Splendor
desc: A bamboo basket floated down the glittering river, and upon a closer look, Anya saw a bunny lying in it.

name: Gleaming Fluff
desc: The basket floated up and down with the weak bunny quivering helplessly inside. Anya immediately held it in her arms.

name: Lovely Snowball
desc: The bunny lay in her arms, trembling unconsciously. Anya's heart ached when she saw a ghastly wound in its leg.

name: Silky Splendor - Heart
desc: The bunny suddenly stood up, the worn cushion anew in a flash of light and twirling around her in the air.

name: Gleaming Fluff - Heart
desc: Anya felt the worry in the bunny's tone and nodded. It patted her, a starlight mark appearing in the palm of her hand.

name: Lovely Snowball - Heart
desc: Anya and the talking bunny teamed up. She even sewed a cape for it and set out with it riding on the flying cushion.

name: Dream-Weaving Flowers
desc: Peachy tulle flowers decorate the white dress with gorgeous shape and movement, showcasing the designer's skill.

name: Childhood Innocence
desc: With much wine in her stomach, she strode confidently to challenge the girl but fell asleep in the backyard instead.

name: Artless Shifting
desc: She sneered at the free lunch, head held high, but still gorged on the food before falling asleep soundly.

name: Brisk Chime
desc: In her dreams, she was still a naughty tanuki a few months ago. No one could keep a rein on her despite her pranks.

name: Dangling Leaves
desc: The girl was always friendly to her and even gifted her a leaf umbrella, which sheltered her from many rains.

name: Clear Moonshine
desc: She strode to the village when the girl smiled and shared food and wine with her instead. She was drunk in no time.

name: Bamboo Dewdrop in Breeze
desc: She didn't live in the bamboo shelter the girl built because of pride, but she would often take naps inside.

name: Springwater Relish
desc: It was the tanuki's prized homebrew with an intoxicating smell, a treasure only shared with true friends.

name: Guardian Tanuki
desc: The clever girl caught her in one try and then set her free after knowing she didn't mean harm. What a peculiar human.

name: Fuzzy Sway
desc: Seeing the girl in her sleep, she blushed, aborted the plan to pull pranks, hopped out of the window and ran home.

name: Wisteria Charm
desc: Mira used to make childish designs with wisteria, which sparked her decision to leave home and pursue her dream.

name: Ripple of Vines
desc: Her parents have sent a letter with wisteria blooms. Away from home, Mira shares the same beautiful view with them.

name: Echoes of Truth
desc: Mona loves the town and her life. It's quiet and peaceful, as if the world was filled with goodness at every moment.

name: Puzzle Solver
desc: Through thin clouds, the silver moon shines on the empty streets, as she pursues the truth among the shadows.

name: Case Breakdown
desc: The culprit is in handcuffs when she catches up, and a handsome officer tips his hat, 'Detective, you're late again.'

name: Brocade in Spring
desc: Walking through the alleys with friends at dawn, sounds can be heard from the academy. Spring is a time to study.

name: Enchanting Zither Song
desc: The strings of the zither tangle as kites fly low. One suddenly breaks, floating in the wind, then disappearing.

name: Splendid Cut
desc: Sadness is a farewell, and melancholy is common. Why try to grow up when you can fly kites and look at the sky?

name: First Blossom
desc: Some sigh, but some children celebrate that the kite is free. A childlike heart is something unique to this world.

name: Drifting Butterfly
desc: Paper butterflies can surf the wind and land on clouds. Joyful and happy, they return to dance like flying fairies.

name: Song of the Fairies
desc: Colorful kites float into the sky. Ever present is the desire to be a bird kite, soaring over rivers and mountains.

name: Devout Blossom
desc: Elba immersed herself in books, where she saw rivers and seas, deserts and forests, like blooms scattered in text.

name: Dozing Grace
desc: Elba received interviews and commissions as her words had spoken to many, but it was then she hit writer's block.

name: Forgotten Chapter
desc: The once fluent flow of words was no more and the fascinating ideas turned into single notes that made no tunes.

name: Reverie Brushes
desc: Elba would stay in her room for a whole day without progress, to the point where she considered giving up writing.

name: Wondrous Fantasy
desc: Her friend brought her the latest product of the Apple Apparel Group, said to create beautiful dreams for the user.

name: Devout Blossom - Dream
desc: Fragmented stories pieced together the only truth. Elba came to her fictional world and met the protagonist, Sui.

name: Dozing Grace - Dream
desc: It was a time of war and conflicting ideas, breeding worries, but also hopes and heroes in the dark before dawn.

name: Forgotten Chapter - Dream
desc: Elba moved from place to place, as thrilling scenes from her books unfolded before her own eyes.

name: Reverie Brushes - Dream
desc: She followed Sui through gunfire in alleyways and over towering mountains, feeling as free as a bird.

name: Wondrous Fantasy - Dream
desc: In dreams, Elba walked the earth and grew alongside Sui in battles, blossoming like a flower atop mountains.

name: Devout Blossom - Still
desc: Every word she wrote hopped out and glowed the brilliance of dream and freedom as if they came to life.

name: Dozing Grace - Still
desc: Elba tightened her grip on the pen with a clear answer in mind. She would write the most fitting ending for Sui.

name: Forgotten Chapter - Still
desc: She will never give up writing. Her stories will continue on with a bright future for every character she has created.

name: Reverie Brushes - Still
desc: A weakened doesn't trap a free soul, and even the tiniest seed burgeons under the sun one day.

name: Wondrous Fantasy - Still
desc: Elba thanked her friend for bringing her hope, who then pulled her into a hug and held her hands as encouragement.

name: Sound Asleep
desc: Imogen doesn't know what the dream will be about. Busy with work, she hasn't had a good sleep or dream for a while.

name: Infinite Memory
desc: The pillow floated away like a cloud, leaving nothing to support Imogen as she fell into the dream world.

name: Sound Asleep - Repose
desc: Her grandma held Imogen's hand, telling her to pursue her dream and that she had always been proud of her.

name: Infinite Memory - Repose
desc: The familiar words questioned Imogen's sense of reality. Which version of her is the truth?

name: Sound Asleep - Peace
desc: Even though her grandma's hat no longer warmed her, the words of love would forever be the greatest power in her.

name: Infinite Memory - Peace
desc: Imogen still dreams of the past, but she never indulges in them. There is an old dream that she must chase.

name: Nightfall Dance
desc: People roamed the streets at sunset before heading home. Dressed luxuriously, the girl walked into an evening dance.

name: Chaste Blossoms
desc: Jade and blossoms in her hair and a warm smile on her face, she stands elegantly in the snow.

name: Flowery Flair
desc: As the saw-wings return in early spring, raindrops gather in puddles, heralding the burgeoning of lives.

name: Floral Luster
desc: Above the hazy water chirp the finches, as flowers bloom on the banks, like the fine lady in the mirror.

name: Azure Plume
desc: In a plain dress with feather-like frills, she recalls the departure of a friend under blooming flowers at sundown.

name: Autumn Stroll
desc: Golden leaves glisten under the autumn sun. The girl and the fox saunter around and watch every sunset.

name: Cherry Candy
desc: The aroma and ample flesh of the cherry linger at the tip of the girl's tongue. She will forever remember the taste.

name: Dearest Friend
desc: They share the purest love. The girl hugs the fox and smiles, promising it will never be alone again.

name: Cherry Messenger
desc: The girl has roamed the world and walked paths unknown, but now she is willing to stay in the bright autumn.

name: Leisure in Woods
desc: As the twilight fades and the foggy forest rustles in the wind, the girl and the fox fall asleep in the moonlight.

name: Lasting Longing
desc: Even though once tainted with lies, the lamp of longing never dims, guiding the lost souls home.

name: Candid Hope
desc: Departure leads to growth while reunion brings hope. She continues to seek truth, stronger with each passing day.

name: Kindred Echo
desc: The memories turn into journals as she writes them down, leading to the fortress where she protects her world.

name: Jovial Moments
desc: Every encounter is worth remembering and sharing, and every page is a pleasant memory of a precious soul.

name: Rainbow Candy
desc: The candy's flavor fills your mouth. The iced sweet and sour soda tastes like rainbow after summer rain.

name: Truest Thoughts
desc: Away with the old boring sayings. There is no room for frustration and regret. I am free and unbound.

name: Spicy Sweetheart
desc: Put forth your infinite passion for creativity and enjoy life's every moment. I am ready for a brand-new adventure.

name: Colorful Release
desc: Say goodbye to your old self. Each day is a breath of fresh air. The colors of the sun invigorate my story.

name: Dark Lightning
desc: The blackbird is a serious opponent, its black feathers cloaked in sunlight, its small body packed with power.

name: Above the Clouds
desc: Her elegant and powerful broom flight awes many. Like a happy little bird, she dashes toward the big blue sky.

name: Proof of Strength
desc: The Starlight Magic School principal left behind important notes. Yunnie is able to return them in no time.

name: Flight Regulations
desc: After completing the impossible quest, the principal not only pays Yunnie, but also offers her a job.

name: Pure Pursuit
desc: But I have nothing to teach the children. All I can do is fly as fast as I can.' Yunnie says, embarrassed.

name: Forest Encounter
desc: The principal stands up and pats Yunnie on the shoulder: 'Then teach them to enjoy flying as you do.'

name: Birds of Dusk
desc: Even the broom in Yunnie's hand wants to challenge the confident opponent. Who's faster, Yunnie, or the proud bird?

name: Moon Seeker
desc: Not many can keep up with Yunnie's speed. Still, a flap of the blackbird's wings is enough to match the fastest winds.

name: Gentle Shadow
desc: The Magic Biology Studies classroom is outside the old school castle. The children are excited to be here.

name: Gentle Courtesy
desc: There are various magical creatures here, ranging from cute snowflake hares to giant armored wolves!

name: Wavering Blossom
desc: Hey! Look! Someone is getting close to a fluffy sheep!' A child shouts in surprise as his classmates glance over.

name: Fragrance in the Wind
desc: That's too dangerous! The children's faces fill with worry. 'We should get the teacher...' says one of the kids.

name: Soft Clouds
desc: Soon, the students realize that the fluffy sheep wasn't aggressive — she was the teacher, Professor Ronna.

name: Star Magnificence
desc: Oh, right! Today's the freshmen's first class.' Ronna turns around and is stunned to see the students.

name: Stargild Night
desc: The first class has ended. The students have a new opinion of Ronna. She's forgetful, cute, and very intelligent.

name: Magical Flower Paper
desc: Although Ronna is clumsy and forgetful about herself, she never forgets anything about the magical creatures.

name: Magic of Time
desc: The freshmen all want to know the secrets within but find a witch in a black long dress casting a spell instead.

name: Phantom Lullaby
desc: The freshmen carefully make their way through the castle corridor. Their footsteps echo through the hall.

name: Shackles of Time
desc: The corridor remains dark as the walls block the sunlight, there is only light from the candle holders to the side.

name: Silent Wish
desc: The stories from the upperclassmen echo. The corridors are eerie and daunting, even in the company of friends.

name: Cage of Darkness
desc: However, the frightening days quickly come to an end. The candles start to light up whenever they pass through.

name: Soundless Prayer
desc: The small magic circle emits a powerful light. The witch contently turns around... Ahh! It's Professor Miranda!

name: Soundless Blessing
desc: Proud as always. The keen children notice something different... The slow-paced footsteps are now in a panic.

name: Childhood Glee
desc: Squares drawn on the ground with crayons send us back in time to the childhood free of worries.

name: Joyous Colors
desc: Momo, why did you draw the pink balloons?' 'They're not balloons! They are grilled fishes shaped like balloons!'

name: Erudite Mind
desc: After reading a book on dreams, Misha heard that the Apple Apparel Group was recruiting testers for a new fabric.

name: Astral Dream
desc: It is said that whoever wears a blindfold made of this fabric will experience the best dream they can wish for.

name: Blessed Chance
desc: Her dream came true! One week later, inside Misha's mailbox lay a reply letter and a blindfold for the trial.

name: Erudite Mind - Orange
desc: She didn't know what to do or why her dream would be like this. Misha couldn't believe this was what she wished for.

name: Astral Dream - Orange
desc: Misha's rainforest adventure didn't get off to a good start, but she managed to find a place for rest before dark.

name: Blessed Chance - Orange
desc: Misha finally built a simple stone hut, where the smell of roasted mushrooms emanated from a small campfire.

name: Erudite Mind - Red
desc: Sitting on the back of the tiger under a starry sky, Misha realized for the first time that she could be so brave.

name: Astral Dream - Red
desc: She roamed freely in the jungle and even learned to swing like a monkey. Here, she could do anything she wanted.

name: Blessed Chance - Red
desc: This was a life that Misha had never experienced. She made up her mind to go out to see the world after waking up.

name: Flowery Swing
desc: The birds led the way for Rhea as they talked the whole way to the forest. In front of her was a swing of flowers.

name: Ivy Crown
desc: A beautiful red bird fell in the yard. Rhea scooped it up in her palms and built a warm new nest with twigs and hay.

name: Warbler's Message
desc: Rhea had been getting more requests since then, surrounded in the yard by birds chirping to tell her their wishes.

name: Dreamy Handwriting
desc: Color has no boundaries. She is a traveler in the kingdom of dreams, composing a poem with magnificent colors.

name: Pen of Memories
desc: She's seen the greatness of mountains, streams, and the sky. Her favorite is the unexpected flower of friendship.

name: Transparent Feelings
desc: She met a girl with a pure heart, reflecting worldly essence. However, her courage inside still shines.

name: Colorful Shadows
desc: She has seen the gentle winds above the clouds. An infinite amount of imagination pours from her heart and fingers.

name: Weaving Inspiration
desc: Groundbreaking designs all come from a moment of sudden inspiration derived from consolidated experiences.

name: Sound of Chess
desc: That person cheated more than just the merchant. There hasn't been any evidence until this ledger.

name: Files and Ranks
desc: The scammer was sent to the authorities and the debts are cleared. The merchant's business takes off immediately.

name: Talking to Oneself
desc: However, something looks different... He notices an old booklet that wasn't there before. It's a ledger!

name: Unexpected Breakthrough
desc: The merchant is a little confused and returns to find Ping but only finds the chest board and cooled tea...

name: Ping's Words
desc: The girl bows to the merchant and introduces herself as Ping. She thanks him for his care and wants to help.

name: Gold Corners
desc: Though incredible, the merchant was not stunned by the treasure he has collected. He asks Ping for a way out.

name: Focus in Silence
desc: Ping smiles but does not speak. She grabs another board and set of chess and signals for the merchant to play.

name: Unforeseen Moves
desc: The merchant is usually careless and loses ground frequently, but today, he plays with confidence and swiftness.

name: Calming Wind
desc: The two played all night around the dim candlelight. As the sky brightens, the match comes to an end.

name: Close Match
desc: The last piece is set, and the two ended in a draw. The merchant opens the door to find it being morning already.

name: Black and White Heron
desc: The black and white pieces sit tidily on the board. Life is a strange game that passes by in the blink of an eye.

name: Tempest Surge
desc: The traitor that coveted the treasures and summoned the beast died in raging waves with his accomplices.

name: Spiritual Beacon
desc: Love and hate were buried in the dark tide, but the guilt ate away at her even after centuries.

name: Stormy Ocean
desc: She was sent away on a boat. As a traveler saved by the captain, she shouldn't be involved in the pirates' scheme.

name: The Vast Journey
desc: She remembered clinging onto the gunwale and looking back at the captain, as he held his sword in the raging storm.

name: Misty Radiance
desc: She shook her head to get the images out, but the memories and emotions felt so real as if rooted in her soul.

name: Echo from Deep
desc: The passengers wept and cried as the ship wobbled. She stumbled onto the deck, as if she were in those memories.

name: Spiritual Whisper
desc: A monstrous beast emerged as the waves raged on, dragging the lives on the ship to a bottomless nightmare.

name: Uncertain Fate
desc: In the vision, the captain she admired also fell into the waves after a brutal fight with the beast from the deep.

name: End of Storm
desc: As she swung the sword at the dark, it shone brilliantly, turning gems into dust and burying the beast in the deep.

name: Green Wisps
desc: The next day, Little Empress decided to scale Mt. Luoyun with Jade, curious about the breathtaking view.

name: Bamboo Aroma
desc: After falling into a pile of snow, Little Empress was rescued by a girl named Jade and soon befriended her.

name: Spring Hiking
desc: Little Empress followed Jade on her mountain hikes. They picked flowers and fruits and wrote poems about spring.

name: Brook Gurgle
desc: Little Empress was confused about the stacked rocks in the river. Jade explained that dams prevented floods.

name: Floating Duckweed
desc: In autumn, Jade brought Little Empress across golden fields to experience the joy of harvest with the farmers.

name: Jadestone Luster
desc: Hidden in the study were the journals of their memories together and the wonders they'd seen on their adventures.

name: Emerald Grandeur
desc: They walked among the crowds at the lantern festival, when fireworks bloomed in the night sky and lit up their eyes.

name: Kiss of Rain
desc: The storm died down when she heard a sigh. In the quiet moonlight, one last raindrop kissed the corner of her eye.

name: Silky Splendor - Wish
desc: The fruit gave Anya incredible strength. She defeated the pursuing mist with ease and sent it fleeing in shame.

name: Gleaming Fluff - Wish
desc: The mist faded as the ancient tree gleamed. The Rabbit Queen stood with her people, offering to grant Anya a wish.

name: Lovely Snowball - Wish
desc: Anya wished to cure Granny Leigh, so the Queen gifted her rabbit hair with a magical power that cures everything.

name: Soaring Up
desc: At the joyous celebration, Momo rode on a rocket up the starry sky, drawing images of fine blessings.

name: Midnight Fairy
desc: Basking in the moonlight, the black cat played with Anne. They were both fairies of freedom belonging to the sky.

name: Kitten's Wish
desc: She made me a bed as soft as a cloud. Come again if you miss me.' Anne waved its tail and rubbed the girl's shawl.

name: Stellar Encounter
desc: When light reveals the cloud castle, Anne returned to Beverly and the black cat asked, 'Are you staying there?'

name: Dream Prelude
desc: Beverly was making a kitten dress when she heard a knock on the window. As she opened it, a black shadow sneaked in.

name: Sparkle at Night
desc: Beverly dreamed of Anne bringing her upon a cloud to a magical castle in the sky where cat fairies resided.

name: Midnight Light
desc: She isn't in a hurry to leave Losol City, so she decides to meet with Geena and reveal her identity.

name: Well-Informed
desc: Welton receives the intel, and Rheta's mission ends. With newfound fame, she is awarded the highest honor.

name: Exquisite Writing Desk
desc: Rheta is already gone when the enemy comes in, leaving a seemingly untouched manuscript and no trace of her presence.

name: Images of Time
desc: Disguised as a journalist, Rheta heads to the intel center hidden in a coffee shop. She recognizes the manager.

name: Red Signal
desc: All girls experience the same pain and hope. After determining where her loyalties lie, Rheta asks Geena for help.

name: Pale Brilliance
desc: Her old friend from the orphanage is the owner of this coffee shop. Rheta sees her own surprise in Geena's eyes.

name: Perfect Manners
desc: A pretty girl becomes a regular at the coffee shop. No one knows what the owner and the journalist talk about.

name: Momentary Confrontation
desc: Rheta joins the auction with the invitation from Geena. She sneaks into the workshop and retrieves the manuscript.

name: Deception and Fraud
desc: There is a sudden knock at the door — the enemy. Rheta anxiously extracts the intel from the manuscript.

name: Anecdotal News
desc: She had already guessed Rheta's identity, but Geena is grateful for her honesty. Still, she declines to go to Welton.

name: Gentle Atmosphere
desc: Her old friend is already a senior intelligence officer for the Apple Federation, but Geena declines to go to Welton.

name: Deadly Accuracy
desc: The coffee shop owner already sees Losol City as her home, where she can be free to do as she pleases.

name: Tomorrow's Invitation
desc: News from Welton comes quickly, and everything is seemingly over. However, Geena receives an invitation from Rheta.

name: Dashing Illusions
desc: Geena receives news that the mission was successful. When Rheta walks into the shop, the two share a knowing smile.

name: In the Name of Freedom
desc: The coffee shop acts as the intelligence center. Countless customers come and go, all under Geena's watchful gaze.

name: Discerning Eyes
desc: A journalist arrives in Losol. When she enters the cafe and meets Geena's gaze, Geena can't help but smile.

name: Destined Reunion
desc: It is Rheta, the girl she grew up with. Geena realizes that she is in disguise, so she does not reveal her secret.

name: Uncrowned Game
desc: The owner and the journalist enjoy a nice chat in the cafe. After this, Geena understands that Rheta is not hostile.

name: Assistance without Hesitation
desc: The eve of the auction, Rheta receives a beautiful invitation with a secret letter. It contains a map of the auction.

name: Shadowy Alliance
desc: An auction will be held in Losol where a manuscript with a secret message determines the future of the federation.

name: Silver Revolver
desc: Secretive Tale' has ended, but the heroines' story continues to move readers. Look forward to a possible sequel!

name: Partner in Crime
desc: If the world crumbled in an instant, and your love and hate immortalized, don't forget we were partners in crime.

name: Destined Promise
desc: Their souls resonated, but hidden beneath the murky darkness was a deeper connection to never be uttered.

name: Destined Confines
desc: Noah didn't think it was love as people say, but he couldn't define that thrill stemming from deep within his soul.

name: Caged Feathers
desc: To Bobo, Noah was like an elusive black cat, mysterious, independent and always contemplating his next move.

name: Burning Facade
desc: He found it hard to feel emotions or connected to people. His heart was an amalgam of chaos and darkness.

name: Moonlight Curse
desc: Noah felt that his heart of chaos was changing and becoming even uglier, but he couldn't deny it felt something.

name: Silent Disguise
desc: Noah didn't want to admit his attraction toward the naive girl, so he began teasing her to see her reaction.

name: Splendid Fetters
desc: Noah thought of himself as an observer, but the fetters of fate loosened as he learned to feel emotions.

name: Epilogue of Schemes
desc: Neither Bobo nor Miraland fell into the embrace of the dark. Noah couldn't help but feel disappointed.

name: Thorns of Agony
desc: He began to take Bobo's pure power seriously. The dark tide ebbed as the pale moonlight shone on the shore.

name: Wings of Embers
desc: Noah felt something in his heart about to break free at any moment. He gazed at the moon like it was the end of time.

name: Misty Butterfly
desc: His pranks were kitten scratches that never hurt. Like a cat, he would also curiously observe people's reactions.

name: Divine Promise
desc: Noah almost never stayed in one place for long. His gaze was fixed on anything that he found intriguing.

name: Embrace of Glows
desc: Everything faded into the dark, no moonlight, no stars, only the ancient wind playing the last lament.

name: Feathers of Time
desc: Bobo could see the dangerous patterns in Noah's behaviors, but of course, he never thought it like that.

name: Colorless Requiem
desc: Darkness engulfed the calm sea when night fell. Bobo gazed into space, imagining a vortex that would devour it all.

name: Tranquil Water
desc: Little Empress woke up still in the palace, now in a state of majesty and grandeur, as if it had been refurbished.

name: Archives of Land
desc: Little Empress became engrossed in the Cloud Annals. To her, the emerald shadow still roamed the mountains and rivers.

name: Royal Etiquette
desc: Servants stepped in as the morning bell rang, following an elegant lady exuding nobility and confidence.

name: Lotus Fragrance
desc: Little Empress stepped closer, certain that the lady was herself. Unsurprised, the lady invited her to walk together.

name: Stately Marvels
desc: The Empress sat on her throne, as the officials took their bows to show their respect for a wise empress.

name: Esteemed Virtue
desc: In the face of fierce arguments, the Empress mediated between officials and made wise decisions.

name: Jadeite Glamor
desc: Little Empress returned to the study, where piles of documents awaited review, beautiful handwriting in each one.

name: Cloud Grandeur
desc: A peaceful nation needs good governance. The Empress unfolded a memorial and explained the affairs to Little Empress.

name: Distant Reverie
desc: Perhaps fate saved them time, and they might meet again where no one knows them and share stories of the past.

name: Bamboo Wonderland
desc: Little Empress would gaze from the palace tower, wishing to one day stand somewhere higher to look upon the world.

name: Imperial Amethyst
desc: As the bell tolled, Little Empress saw the same childish face in the mirror, but now with determination in the eyes.

name: Fluorescent Frost
desc: A beam of light shone when the girl jumped into the abyss with her arms open for him, but it was all a dream.

name: Tangled Predicament
desc: Noah even closed his eyes to feel his heart beating. He looked forward to the changes Bobo would bring to his fate.

name: Frosty Dream
desc: He would meet her again someday, Noah thought with a smile, leaning by the window. Such a future might not be so bad.

name: Emotion in Sync
desc: Master fixed the structural problem of the boy's sand castle. The system reads the boy's emotion as 'Excited.'

name: Optical Echoes
desc: I created a new humanoid for Master using the emotion detector. The system reads his emotion as 'Scared.'

name: Mind Spectrum
desc: Master built an emotion analysis system back in the virtual space. Images flash by and pause temporarily.

name: Special Connection
desc: Emotions may also be passed on to others through language or facial expressions. Mark that down, Eleven.'

name: Accurate Analysis
desc: Unlike in Ruin Island, activities in Welton don't have many regulations. My database is soon flooded with random events.

name: Secret Presence
desc: Rescuing a dog, watching a different live performance, and being forced to build a sand castle with his peer.

name: Jade Feathers
desc: Neva fell into sleep as she bathed in the gentle breeze, moonlight, and the beautiful rhymes.

name: Spirit Bird
desc: She's asked a lot of people about a song but no one's ever heard of it, as if it was lost in the passage of time.

name: Luxuriant Greenery
desc: While patrolling around the City, Neva recalled fumbling her way through the dark corridors as a little girl.

name: Sound Sleep
desc: A familiar voice was coming from ahead. She stood up and lurched forward, only to see two distorted faces.

name: Hazy Mist
desc: They knocked her down in the mud. Muffled voices echoed in her ears, and she sensed a looming thirst for blood.

name: Drizzle of Rain
desc: Those two figures turned into giant beasts, and then into dark mists that lunged at her, trying to engulf her.

name: Azure Jade
desc: Neva escaped her illusions, sweating heavily. The guards offered to call the doctors, but she refused.

name: Flickering Trail
desc: After checking with Royce, Neva received a gift box with a grinning white cat in a yellow cloak painted on the face.

name: Color Overflow
desc: The blindfold in the box is the latest product of the Apple Apparel Group, which customizes your dreams.

name: Lingering Fragrance
desc: Neva stared at the nightstand. She knew there was a hair clip with frayed edges in a box in the bottom compartment.

name: Sun Glow
desc: Neva failed to immerse herself in the customized dream. She felt as if she were an actress reading her lines.

name: Clusters in Bloom
desc: She saw those two faces, somehow familiar, in all those scenes, and they always reached out their arms to embrace her.

name: Flowing Mist
desc: When she woke up from her dream, it was only daybreak. The world was shrouded in mist, but her mind is clear.

name: Shiny Crystals
desc: She wiped off the tears, took out the hair clip her mother left her, and put it on her jewelry stand.

name: Accompanied Trip
desc: Rhea, you finally woke up! Put on your best outfit and let's go to the forest. We have something for you!'

name: Poetry of Soul
desc: Some birds liked dry hay while some preferred twigs. Rhea did her best to make nests tailored to each of their needs.

name: Chirping Finch
desc: Rhea liked building nests for the birds and listening to their ideas, for she also found new inspirations.

name: Floral Glimmer

desc: Belinda felt a little uneasy and went to Adessa's room the next day and found that she was having another nightmare.

name: Tranquil Dream
desc: Belinda cast a spell and created a sweet dream for Adessa. Adessa's relaxed face told Belinda her magic had worked.

name: Midnight Slumber
desc: Every time Adessa was troubled by a nightmare, Belinda would come to help even if Adessa would never know it.

name: Stellar Moon
desc: Belinda realized that Adessa had a lot more nightmares than most people, and she and Bellucci could help with that.

name: Tea Invitation
desc: Adessa fell into her sleep in the warm moonlight with a faint smile on her face, as if she was expecting someone.

name: Companion Forever
desc: Adessa made a handkerchief and put it on the bed to show gratitude to the fairy who had been helping her.

name: Soft Sleep
desc: Her sensitive mind had troubled Adessa, but had also allowed her to feel the existence of fairies.

name: Fantasy Steps
desc: With the fairy's company, Adessa was no longer afraid of sleep and instead, expected to meet her friend in dreams.

name: Quiet Slumber
desc: This was the first time Adessa didn't wake up from a nightmare. She felt ever so relieved the next morning.

name: Gentle Weep
desc: The next evening, Adessa felt much more relaxed before sleep. The night had become less intimidating to her.

name: Echo of Thoughts
desc: To her surprise, today's nightmare was again dispersed. Adessa realized that someone might be helping her.

name: Eternal Watch
desc: Adessa's mind was wandering in dreams, but she could feel that there was a fairy on her side.

name: Promise of Dream
desc: Adessa slept very well at night for the next few days. She tried to concentrate on learning more about the fairy.

name: Dreamy Slumber
desc: Finally, Adessa met this fairy, who'd protected her, in her dream one night and learned her name was Belinda.

name: Song of Flower
desc: The once silent dreamland was now filled with laughter. Adessa would tell Belinda about her life on the ranch.

name: Remaining Voice
desc: In the silver moonlight, the fairy stood among the trees alongside her deer, staring at this uninvited visitor.

name: Flag of Past
desc: The shadow of the flag divided the world into two: One illuminated by the moon and the other covered in a dark mist.

name: Phantom of Past
desc: Legends had been told of a black deer that fed on people's terror. And its appearance was an ominous sign of warfare.

name: Thorny Crown
desc: She followed the sound in a daze and woke up when she heard a yell. She realized she was at the edge of a swamp.

name: Shackle of Memory
desc: O my brave warriors, may you rest in peace in the blessings of the forest.'

name: Endless Torture
desc: The fairy stared at the warrior's back as she left, and thought of her people's eyes when she left the clan.

name: Distant Song
desc: When the war was over, the soldiers returned and were surprised to find that the forest had become a bare mountain.

name: Trust of Life
desc: The soldiers had just left the mountain when they heard her screaming, and so they returned and rescued her.

name: Thorny Spear
desc: There was a brave fairy soldier named Cecilia. She held their position until the forest was engulfed in fire.

name: Shimmer of Faith
desc: She asked around and learned that this vast, beautiful forest had seen warfare in the past.

name: Spirit of Realms
desc: The Pigeon Kingdom wasn't short of legends. What fascinating stories would these ancient books hold?

name: Light Search
desc: The train had arrived. The girl stepped off the train and confidently walked off into the crowd.

name: Worries in Words
desc: She chose to work in the dress store, which gave her better pay. Her dreams seemed to be a beautiful lie.

name: Begin of All
desc: Over the next six months, she wrote many letters to her parents, describing how vibrant Widmore was.

name: Youthful Years
desc: But she'd never mentioned her own life. No matter how vibrant the place was, she had nothing to do with that.

name: Youth Buds
desc: The train attendant let her touch the dolls, and an idea formed in her mind from there.

name: Unyielding Faith
desc: Even when she grew up, she believed that there was a great wealth of dolls, castles and the like in Widmore.

name: Child's Dream
desc: The dresses were of course beautiful, but the girl only wanted to make dolls because that was her childhood dream.

name: Blossom Companion
desc: When she turned 20, she decided to take the train to Widmore. The train attendant kept her company as she left home.

name: Original Wish
desc: Even the attendant believed in that dream. How could she give up? She felt a little ashamed and went back.

name: Rambling Journey
desc: The girl fell asleep on the train and dreamed of a lively city and beautiful dolls, singing cheerfully around her.

name: Closer to Dream
desc: Then, she worked in a doll shop. She worked during the day and studied at night. She knew she'd realize her dream.

name: Silent Past
desc: But she had once felt lost when many designers said she always criticized others and didn't understand anything.

name: Instant Inspiration
desc: So she changed her way. She no longer criticized anyone in public but discussed ideas with them instead.

name: Moonlit Ceremony
desc: But people came to realize that she wasn't really against anyone in particular; she was just so obsessed with design.

name: Exiled Memory
desc: Years later, the name of Cecilia had been forgotten; only in that barren land, her people still expected her return.

name: Smooth Thought
desc: She came to realize that the world had so much fun to offer, which she had ignored all her life.

name: Snow Butterfly
desc: She loved the roses in bloom and the clear rivers. She played the instruments whose name she didn't know.

name: Ticking Time
desc: She felt something different and asked to leave the capital. She wanted to explore the world.

name: Dream Afar
desc: The royal members agreed to her request. They would love to see her happy doing what she really loved.

name: Misty Branch
desc: The long-lasting peace ended one day in the morning. A nearby country invaded the kingdom to seize resources.

name: Nocturnal Butterfly
desc: But the enemies came prepared. After several fierce battles, the kingdom was a little overwhelmed.

name: Dance of Butterflies
desc: The royal members headed to the front lines. They summoned fire and frost to protect their land.

name: Serene Chill
desc: The armies stood vigilant before dawn, knowing that their victory lay in this one final battle.

name: Warm Care
desc: Renya slipped and fell. She tried to encourage herself and saw a band-aid handed over: Her friends were here!

name: Strawberry Bear
desc: After the game, Renya ran toward the bear dolls in the audience, who celebrated the victory with her.

name: Course of Stars
desc: The audience cheered. Renya hit a home run and sealed the victory for her team!

name: One Last Hit
desc: She clenched her teeth and hit the ball the opponent threw at her. The ball flew into the sky like a shooting star.

name: Orange Bear
desc: Renya felt a pain in her wrist and was a little overwhelmed. Suddenly, she saw a few bear dolls in the audience.

name: Tender Heart
desc: Tears welled up in her eyes. She didn't want to let them down but wasn't sure if she could beat such a strong team.

name: A Sound Sleep
desc: She was tired and soon fell asleep, with the bear doll in her arms. She dreamed about playing baseball with the bear.

name: Clear Vision
desc: The bear doll was her favorite cartoon character. She loved how brave it was and got into baseball because of it.

name: Lovely Bear
desc: Her parents thought it was just a whim and that she would give it up in a few days. But her friends supported her.

name: Candy Bat
desc: The match had come to a critical moment. Renya cooperated with her teammates, but the opponents had good defense.

name: Sweet Moment
desc: Renya exercised alone after school. There wasn't a baseball club, so she adopted the training methods she read.

name: Scattered Stars
desc: Prove yourself to us one more time!' The bear doll handed the bat to Renya and gave her a high five.

name: Untold Lie
desc: It breathed fire, roared like thunder and forbade trespassers. Granny Rianne's arm was injured because of it.

name: Memory of Thrills
desc: Granny, how did you escape?' Reshia loved listening to Rianne's story, and her answers were always different.

name: Sincere Pledge
desc: I shall venture into the woods and challenge the dragon!' Reshia promised as she blew out her birthday candles.

name: Innocent Days
desc: As time went by, Reshia grew up and Granny Rianne aged more. Reshia made a decision the day she came of age.

name: Dearly Remembered
desc: She trained her body and will in the woods, but she also needed strategies against the dragon.

name: Fearless Quest
desc: Reshia was dying to know the truth. Did Granny escape because of her wits or the stupidity of the dragon?

name: Untold Lie · Blue
desc: The darkness swallowed the light from Reshia's lantern. She groped in the dark and suddenly felt jewels and gems.

name: Memory of Thrills · Blue
desc: The stolen treasures! Indignantly, Reshia put them down and continued when suddenly, the lights came back.

name: Sincere Pledge · Blue
desc: Are you Rianne's friend?' the young man asked with hope in his eyes, 'She came here a long time ago.'

name: Innocent Days · Blue
desc: He looked kind but pale and weak, the shadow of a snake curling around his left arm like silk.

name: Dearly Remembered · Blue
desc: The snake fairy kept watch over the treasures in the mountains, but he would grow weak on full moon nights.

name: Fearless Quest · Blue
desc: My apologies. I thought you were an invader.' A handsome young man stood in the luxurious hall, smiling sheepishly.

name: Viridescent Frost
desc: The doctors and their prescriptions were of no use against the plague, so people could only pray for a miracle.

name: Moonlit Linger
desc: She trekked across mountains and woods and never gave up on finding a way to save her family from the plague.

name: Palace Melancholia
desc: She turned and realized she and the herbalist were among the stars and clouds, away from the realm of mortals.

name: Midnight Shroud
desc: She visited hermits in the woods and asked anglers by bubbling brooks. None knew where the moonlight peony was.

name: Windswept Glide
desc: One day, a herbalist told her the moonlight peony grew only on a snow-covered peak where no one ventured.

name: Silken Breeze
desc: She climbed one peak and saw the next towering in the clouds, but nothing could deter her now.

name: Wintry Haze
desc: Many never returned from the snow-covered mountains teeming with ferocious beasts, but she was determined.

name: Splendor Cluster
desc: The Mountain Spirit protected the precious flower and tempted or threatened her to leave.

name: Evanescent Wish
desc: It was a full moon when she finally reached the peak and saw the peony, blooming in its moonlit grace.

name: Blooming Viridity
desc: The plague stopped. People built a temple to worship her, and eventually the village became the Moonlit City.

name: Faded Candlelight
desc: As flowers bloomed in the snow, the herbalist, dressed in gilt robes, revealed himself as an immortal.

name: Moonlit Return
desc: She saw it in a vision that the city would be destroyed in a flood, so she sacrificed herself to keep it safe.

name: Wilting Cirrus
desc: She lived in solitude in the Moon Palace and helped those in need praying most sincerely for her assistance.

name: Oceanic Haze
desc: She looked most forward to leaving the mountain, even though the fox would always beat her with its tricks.

name: Traceless Squall
desc: But one year, her mentor seemed distracted and said she could no longer stay if she lost the fight.

name: Billowing Mist
desc: She befriended spirits and still felt inadequate. The fox didn't care and always called her its servant.

name: Cliffside Terrace
desc: One day she overheard that the herbalist had to cut all secular ties to seek the truth of cultivation.

name: Veiling Mist
desc: She bowed and announced her name when the fox attacked her by surprise, saying there were no rules between spirits.

name: Cloudless Rhymes
desc: The fox had a mesmerizing smile and pink fur between its brows. She stared until the fox took her hand to play.

name: Somber Yearning
desc: Life flourished in the green mountains. It was miles of green and blooms that she had never seen before.

name: Virid Serenity
desc: As the herbalist grew busier, she was often left alone on the snowy mountain, missing the lushness and the fox.

name: Callous Withering
desc: Spirits would compete for the treasured jade and the champion would become the ruling Mountain Ghost.

name: Swathing Haze
desc: She lost the fight. Her mentor let her go when the Spirit Herb shook its leaf and took her as its second disciple.

name: Ethereal Strings
desc: She stopped sobbing and asked, 'Am I the eagle?' The fox yawned and leaped down, 'Who knows? It's just a story.'

name: Vernal Evergreen
desc: Thunder blasted for three days and when she woke again, there was no grass or mentor to be found.

name: Mirrored Ripples
desc: A few days later, the spirits gathered early for the contest. She usually enrolled but stayed silent this time.

name: Spring's Whisper
desc: It told its mentor about everything outside the cave, and its mentor would always say it was slacking off.

name: Moonlit Longing
desc: It became the Spirit Herb's disciple and it never expected that its mentor was the Mountain Ghost.

name: Doleful Glance
desc: On the Spring Equinox, it picked a peach blossom and raced all the way back to show its mentor.

name: Rejuvenated Verdancy
desc: Her mentor saw her in her human form and smiled, 'So you made it, even though you were always slacking off.'

name: Eons of Delight
desc: Her mentor said that she was gorgeous by the standard of humans and promised to gift her something later.

name: Pavilion of Verdure
desc: Since then, she would make jokes about how her mentor's leaves hadn't grown much for so many years.

name: Idyllic Breeze
desc: Her mentor seemed to have never taken it to heart, but she would see mist around her mentor's leaves late at night.

name: Fallen Pearl
desc: When thunder struck, spirits all hid behind rocks, but she rushed up the mountain to be with her mentor.

name: Dashing Star
desc: She saw a beautiful woman in front of the cave when lightning struck. Then everything went quiet, and she fainted.

name: Pendant Amore
desc: Her mentor asked amusedly what she would do if her mentor finally turned human and became even prettier than her.

name: Thawing Blooms
desc: She thought to herself that her mentor would be prettier than her when it finally turned human.

name: Ribbon of Frost
desc: A group of birds offered her a gauzy gown on the day of the contest. She put it on and everyone praised her in awe.

name: Sylvan Zephyr
desc: It felt it wasn't running fast enough and realized it was running on human feet, which were far slower than a fox's.

name: Color of the Soul
desc: As the soul grows and the light changes, it makes sense that one's reflection in a mirror looks familiar yet strange.

name: Fashion Elements
desc: Some think she's only seeking attention, but Rise doesn't care. She chases every idea in her mind and realizes it.

name: Flashy Visuals
desc: Despite her boldness, Rise has some timid fans. They face many obstacles in their pursuit of dreams.

name: Colorful Ending
desc: Rise likes that characters in black-and-white films eventually live colorful lives, so she chases her dream.

name: Fashionable Trends
desc: Rise believes that every style has a meaning. The most honest pursuit of a dream has the beauty of a great story.

name: Everlasting Connection
desc: Some beauties are destined to last. They are framed in time and last for evermore in fleeting moments.

name: Fashion Storm
desc: Rise tirelessly encourages her fans to find and express themselves and to ignore the criticisms and malicious attacks.

name: Foretime Recall
desc: As her sister petted the kitten, Minna gently put her handmade cat-ear beanie on her sister's head.

name: Farewell Present
desc: An elegant pink dress with blue flowery patterns. Minna would forever cherish her sister's present.

name: Guiding Morningstar
desc: The morning star shines at dawn, guiding seafarers like her through waves and storms.

name: Tide Chaser
desc: The ship cleaves a way through turbulent waves, as she steers it confidently in the face of challenges.

name: Bygone Songs
desc: When a new day dawns, a warm breeze awakens me from my dreams. I write this letter to share the story with you.

name: Gaze of Curiosity
desc: Adventurers use it to gaze at the land afar. Inside its view is the great unknown, waiting to be explored.

name: Terrene Bloom
desc: After the flood, they rebuilt their houses and planted plume trees, the blooms of which were as soft as feathers.

name: Euphoric Marvel
desc: Jane woke up to rain seeping through the windows. They packed up in haste and silence, ready to evacuate.

name: Floral Orison
desc: Jane waded the currents when a wave toppled them off the ground. Jane tried to get up but only floated further away.

name: Rueful Lament
desc: The older generations believed a flood was coming. Jane still remembered the terrible disaster in her childhood.

name: Ardent Fervor
desc: The rain stopped, but all plume blooms withered overnight. Jane and the other villagers all went to thank the trees.

name: Fervent Devotion
desc: The world suddenly went quiet. Jane felt the currents turning slow and gentle, even carrying a floral fragrance.

name: Blooming of Life
desc: She opened her eyes to a golden beam shining from above. The storm stopped and the water turned into plume blooms.

name: Spirit Companion
desc: Angelia looks up: the glazed window shines still. The mirage is gone, but she can feel the angel's gaze on herself.

name: Silent History
desc: She wears the same necklace as the angel. Although she only caught a glimpse of the mirage, she's sure she's right.

name: Descending Stars
desc: I've seen it, Angelia.' The girl speaks shortly after. The kids and the teacher can't help but laugh kindly.

name: Glistening Crown
desc: The teacher's story arouses laughter among the kids, but Angelia only looks up to admire the glazed window.

name: Letter in Courtyard
desc: A relic from the past, still impressive as it had ever been, seems to show her a real starry sky with a faint glow.

name: Stellar Cycle
desc: Silence sets in, and the twinkling stars illuminate the path to the past and future amidst the hazy clouds.

name: Radiant Reflection
desc: In the sea of stars, Angelia sees a little angel, who waves her feathers and smiles at her.

name: Vaporizing Dream
desc: Angelia feels warmth in her heart: the angel looks familiar, but she only hears laughter when she focuses on thinking.

name: Flame Brilliance
desc: Seeing Angelia still at a loss, the teacher asks, 'Did you see anything extraordinary in the glazed window?'

name: Tender Buds
desc: As the kids gather, the mirage disappears after the little angel smiles, signaling Angelia to keep it a secret.

name: Destined Dream
desc: Is that angel Angelia's future self, or a shadow from a past life, offering guidance in her present life?

name: Echoes of Dreams
desc: Angelia closes her eyes and feels as if she were back at the window. An age-old mystery awaits her answer.

name: Firmament Haze
desc: When Becky delivers medicine to the girl, she realizes the cats made the wish as they meow to thank her.

name: Kitten Fluff
desc: Becky walks to the room and sees two cats lying beside a sick girl, meowing in a hurry to beckon her inside.

name: Kitten Wisdom
desc: To Becky's surprise, no one exclaimed over her miracle. Then she hears a weak cough from inside the room.

name: Fairytale Trance
desc: Stars speak endless wishes: dwarves wishing for treasure, princesses wishing for peace, poets wishing for love.

name: Cordial Faith
desc: Mages in fairytales always help those in need. Becky wanted to help too, but her cleaning magic couldn't do much.

name: Guileless Wish
desc: A wish to keep the house always clean,' while the stars make this simple wish, Becky is already on her way.

name: Magic Duster
desc: Becky lands in front of a house and summons her white duster, waving it with her magical dance steps.

name: Astral Echo
desc: The evening breeze sometimes shares whispers of the stars, and maybe a story about a Dusting Pixie and cats.

name: Florescent Journey
desc: Snow melted into brooks, carrying the Queen's message everywhere. Leaving the castle, she embraced a new kingdom.

name: Burgeoning Dream
desc: The girl was a seed sent by the Goddess of Spring. She would bloom every year on this colorful land.

name: Hedge of Thorns
desc: Flowers even bloomed on the royal guards' swords. They took off their helmets and saw each other for the first time.

name: Snowmelt Mirth
desc: Melted snow flowed by everyone's feet. They could feel their hearts and minds warm up like the coursing water.

name: Billowing Buds
desc: Kesha met the flower girl with a cold face, but the girl ran to her excitedly and shoved the basket into her arms.

name: Candescent Dream
desc: When the girl held Kesha's hand, she saw a sunlit meadow full of life, with deer leaping over bubbling creeks.

name: Snowmelt Ardor
desc: The girl described a charming spring vista, captivating the officials and bringing warmth to the iron palace.

name: Emerald Torsade
desc: The castle shook violently as snow fell, revealing a dark grey that was soon covered by brighter colors.

name: Dewdrop Bloom
desc: The fragrance soothed the Queen. She touched the petals and felt the dew on her fingertips.

name: Flowery Braids
desc: Then the girl presented a wreath to the Queen. With a clear ring, the ice covering the Queen's heart started to melt.

name: Sylvan Hymn
desc: Maybe only change would bring hope and prosperity. Opportunities would pass by for a heart buried in the snow.

name: Bedewed Bloom
desc: The Queen returned to her throne in the wreath instead of her crown. Flowers gathered around to offer her tribute.

name: Sprouting Rebirth
desc: Burgeoning grass drove away the last bit of cold. Together the people walked into a new life in a green kingdom.

name: Twilight Silhouette
desc: Only her brothers had the chance to show their talent. As time passed, Vena learned her heart's desire.

name: Dust Evanescence
desc: She learned to do a lot of things, to know the world, to fight, take, conquer, and to get everything she wanted.

name: Transient Dream
desc: Vena knew that she wasn't born to rule the world. She was taught to follow rules, not to fight for power.

name: Foregone Past
desc: Soon rumors fell quiet. People realized the duke's wealth seemed to end up in the hands of one person, Vena.

name: Hazy Greensward
desc: The duke's two fledgling sons had their ambitions. They tried to control every aspect of Vena's life.

name: Elegy of Glimmers
desc: Vena couldn't care less about their fight. The love letters she received were full of empty promises and cheap love.

name: Hidden Floriography
desc: Love is the most useless in our family.' the duke and Vena's brothers told her so, and deep down Vena agreed.

name: Eternal Florescence
desc: My daughter, I will pick the most suitable suitor for you!' the duke waved one letter after another at her.

name: Dubious Oath
desc: Vena only stared in silence as usual. She always appeared obedient to her father's and brothers' orders.

name: Nighttime Aroma
desc: One by one, the sons got into accidents during a fight and a hunt. Their businesses went downhill while they rested.

name: Unanswered Riddle
desc: The family's fate started derailing when the duke was involved in a serious political scandal.

name: Night Bell
desc: Melissa watches the people among her crimson roses as they leave. The bell on the tower rings as a new day starts.

name: Final Cure
desc: People leave with relief and their emotions nurture the roses. Melissa collects a few of them in a glass container.

name: Eternal Secret
desc: A girl, looking haggard, falls to her knees and asks Melissa to rid her of the love that's distorted her mind.

name: Pain Redemption
desc: A medic cries and asks Melissa to let her forget those she couldn't save and give her the courage to face life again.

name: Shackles of Revenge
desc: A pallid boy asks Melissa to remove the hatred in his mind which has exhausted him so that he can regain peace.

name: Crimson Mark
desc: Emotions can never be restored once removed. Melissa always makes sure if that's what people really want.

name: Tender Crimson
desc: When Melissa finishes her work, people will open their eyes again and enjoy the peace of their new lives.

name: Fiery Rose
desc: People have broken free of the exhausting love, the unbearable sorrow, and the overwhelming hatred and moved on.

name: Fall of Dawn
desc: The one lying out there is the ghost hunter. Solace knows nothing of her intention and prepares herself to fight.

name: Final Path
desc: The ghost hunter had some trouble and came here for help, but she thought Solace's master was still the owner.

name: Night Talks
desc: It's not until Solace lifts the formation that the ghost hunter realizes that she's been maintaining the temple.

name: Final Dust
desc: The fight is intense. They attack each other with mesmerizing spells and later stones. No one dares to come near.

name: Whirling Stars
desc: She's come to visit an old Taoist, but she's surprised to find that many people haven't heard about the temple at all.

name: Glowing Spell
desc: Despite her calm nature, Solace excels at spells. She keeps a low profile and takes on nearby evil spirits alone.

name: Voice of Soul
desc: What will they do after that? Perhaps they'll come back to the temple. Someone needs to take care of it, after all.

name: Boundless Snow
desc: The ghost hunter senses the formation surrounding the temple and decides to stay here and wait for the owner.

name: Life of Dream
desc: Days ago, Solace learned of a stone in the mountains that could enhance the formation and went in search of it.

name: Future Oracle
desc: Now she's obtained the stone and come back, only to find someone with an aura around her lying in front of the temple.

name: Star Swirl
desc: She knows it has a long history and used to be a bustling place, so she wonders how it ended up like this.

name: Dim Glow
desc: With such a low-key leader and the exuberant trees around, the temple is almost forgotten. Peace seems only natural.

name: Dream Thoughts
desc: This story is the only one about Solace in Tales of the Shadows, but has become one of the classics.

name: Miracle Spell
desc: She isn't ignoring her master's request but has a more important task: to sort out the literature left at the temple.

name: Dessert Hunter
desc: Keep the spell in your mind and grab the fork in your hand. Let's go find the best dessert in this feast!

name: Midnight Repose
desc: There was no green in Kesha's kingdom. The people grew numb in the dreary snow and only worked day after day.

name: Spirit Wind
desc: Flowers glow with dim blue in the cold light of the moon. Liz's skirt flutters in the wind as she dances with Vanis.

name: Perfect Dance
desc: A perfect dance with Vanis has become Liz's dream. And Liz has made up her mind to confess her love after that dance.

name: Final Departure
desc: The sorcerer, who hurt Vanis' wings, suddenly appears and enchants Liz's mind with spells, making her a puppet.

name: Dream Weaver
desc: The butterfly with a pair of glowing wings can transform, too. To cure him, Liz has asked a lot of friends for help.

name: Wind Whisper
desc: Liz talked a lot with Vanis during their time together. Vanis has seen a lot and everything he says is amazing to Liz.

name: Graceful Wind
desc: The leaves flutter in the wind and the birds perching on the nearby branches watch the lovers with joy.

name: Nocturnal Dance
desc: Vanis has fully recovered. As Liz hesitates to ask him to stay, she hears him ask her to dance in the moonlight.

name: Enthralling Heart
desc: Liz, who's never danced before, takes Vanis' hand, determined to try her best, but can barely control her legs.

name: Mist of Dream
desc: After the dance, Liz can't remember how many times she stepped on Vanis and apologized, but Vanis only smiled.

name: Dance Mirage
desc: They dance to the sounds of cicadas for countless days after that. Liz has improved a lot under Vanis' teaching.

name: Shared Wish
desc: Next time, I'll try harder and won't step on you again, I promise.' 'Alright, let's try together. We've got time.'

name: Mark of Past
desc: Liz can always feel peace of mind when she's with Vanis, even when they do nothing and simply watch the clouds.

name: Fluttering Skirt
desc: In the moonlight, the pale spider weaves the web mechanically. Those who get caught can only accept their fate.

name: Thoughts on Web
desc: Sometimes Vanis feels that his heart was tied to Liz the moment he fell into her web.

name: Love Rapture
desc: The sorcerer rages at what happened in vain: Liz ties him to the center of the web. Punishment awaits him.

name: Heart to Heart
desc: You'll have to look after me again...' Vanis holds Liz's hands, his voice feeble. Liz wipes off her tears and nods.

name: Final Content
desc: It's the dance that they did on the first day they met. But this time, Liz's moves are so smooth and elegant.

name: Glowing Wings
desc: Liz always thinks she's a bad dancer, but Vanis tells her that it's the person who he dances with that matters.

name: Pairs and Couples
desc: The clouds have dispersed and revealed the bright moon in a clear sky, celebrating the reunion of the lovers.

name: Decisive Dance
desc: He wishes he could dance with Liz forever, and that she would love dancing and finally understand him.

name: Downturn Melody
desc: His dream fails when the sorcerer, who's been hunting him down, breaks into this tranquil mountain.

name: Eternal Memory
desc: The sorcerer controls Liz to weave toxic webs to hunt the prey. What should Vanis do to save her?

name: Soul Seizure
desc: Vanis manages to get away, but the sorcerer takes Liz's soul instead and makes her a puppet, and Vanis is heartbroken.

name: Memory Crate
desc: The shop owner made fluffy marshmallows for the grandpa that reminded him of his long-forgotten childhood.

name: Amorous Reunion
desc: A happy smile is sweeter than candy—gummy bears that protect children's teeth, diamond rings wrapped up for lovers.

name: Rejoicing Moment
desc: They would chuckle when kids came trick-or-treating and put the most popular sweets in their baskets.

name: Parting Gift
desc: It was time for the girl to leave. The shop owner locked herself in the kitchen to make a special candy for her.

name: Sincere Ardor
desc: Melted sugar was poured into different molds and then stored in colorful glass jars shaped like the shop sign.

name: Magic Candy
desc: The girl scooped a handful of candy as the shop owner wished her happiness and a hopeful future.

name: Wicked Tail
desc: The girl stared at the colorful candy, as if her wonderful memories at the candy shop were forever saved in time.

name: Treasured Collection
desc: The candy tasted sweeter than ever. The girl left the last one in the jar and carried it around at all times.

name: Signal of Glee
desc: If you also like strolling around Candy Town, you may have stumbled upon a candy shop that sells happiness.

name: Token of Felicity
desc: Kids would see smiling faces on the coins. They aren't enough for toys, but they can pass on happiness.

name: Cubic Merriment
desc: Nika lost the piggy bank after a house move. She no longer collected coins, but still felt empty and frustrated.

name: Buoyant Piglet
desc: The yellowed piggy bank would look at Nika with its never-changing smile. It always cheered her up.

name: Childhood Echoes
desc: Finally the piggy bank became too full and heavy for another coin, so Nika took all out to buy her favorite toy.

name: Sweet Concord
desc: Her mother's encouragement and friends' envious looks were nothing compared to the moment she bought the toy.

name: Untroubled Hope
desc: As Nika grew up, she could finally afford things she wanted and fill up her room with cute toys.

name: Gunfire Thrill
desc: Nika worked in an amusement park and always led parades. She would hold up a toy gun and shoot coins into the sky.

name: Fairyland Bestowal
desc: Nika was the kids' favorite performer who always gave the kids what they wanted and brought them the purest joy.

name: Innocent Calling
desc: Happiness has always been within reach. It's in the kids' quirky presents and their genuine smiles.

name: Waterlily Breeze
desc: The Prankster's Day is a picture book that teaches kids to do simple tasks such as brushing their teeth!

name: Faerie Guardian
desc: Alouette remembered the whole town would be here for the school chorus the next day and regretted pulling the prank.

name: Jovial Renewal
desc: One day, Alouette chanced upon a delicious black magic candy that had one small side effect.

name: Crystalline Wish
desc: It would dye everything black! But to Alouette, it was a perfect present from the god of pranks, so he hatched a plan.

name: Magic Coagulation
desc: He sneaked it to school and mixed it in the afternoon desserts. All classmates exclaimed, 'Monster!' after eating it.

name: Vernal Meadow
desc: Everyone's mouth was dyed black, revealing black teeth and tongue. 'Hahaha!' Alouette burst out laughing.

name: Cleansing Rebirth
desc: After sharing a laugh together, his friends started to frown and sigh over an important event the next day.

name: Sparkling Cosmos
desc: There was a new girl in the arcade center. She always kept to herself with the visor of her cap low.

name: Fateful Fervor
desc: Venian wanted friends, but as a newcomer in town, she was always on edge and standing awkwardly in corners.

name: Quirky Gashapon
desc: Kids liked to pile up their toys and imagine that they had made a lot of new friends as they grew up.

name: Bear Gashapon
desc: After her parents passed away, Venian moved to a new town and felt insecure and lonely in her foster family.

name: Sunward Flight
desc: It was Venian's first birthday there. The shopkeeper gave her a game coin, but she shook her head and ran away.

name: Fortune Spark
desc: One ordinary night, Venian decided to leave town and return to her homeland which was buried deep in her memories.

name: Quirky Pastime
desc: Warm light shone from the Bunny House. Venian stood in front of the toy machine and put in her only token.

name: Infinite Auspice
desc: Hesitantly Venian opened a toy ball, when a golden light shone through and pulled her into the world of toys.

name: Prismatic Wish
desc: A teddy bear in a helmet showed up, 'Are you the friend I've been waiting for? Great! Come and join my adventure!'

name: Favorable Chance
desc: Venian thought she'd used all her luck after surviving the fire. Could she really become friends with a cute toy?

name: Sincere Silence
desc: The Mouse King Momo orders the little mice to take away Nutcracker Nikki: she'll cook grilled fish only for him.

name: Frosty Wishes
desc: The Deer waves goodbye to Nutcracker Nikki. Debbie hasn't said a word throughout the ball to maintain her persona!

name: Melody of Mirth
desc: As the birds tweet amongst themselves, the curtain rustles in the breeze and wakes up the world.

name: Departing Wings
desc: People started building canals and finally, rain fell on the parched land. The silversmith felt the rain and smiled.

name: Springtime Pendant
desc: The silversmith saved a white swallow that fell from the sky when a naughty child hit its left wing with a slingshot.

name: Indigo Tinge
desc: The people prepared to set up an altar and pray for the Sparrow God, who brought rain to sincere worshippers.

name: Cloudward Chirp
desc: Sparrows chirped and hovered over the altar before a white one descended, transforming into a young man.

name: Guiding Chime
desc: On the day of the ritual, sparrows hovered over the altar and a white one flew down and turned into a young man.

name: Plumed Brocade
desc: The silversmith gazed as the white sparrow flew away. The corner of her lips curved as she whispered, 'It was you.'

name: Ethereal Chant
desc: A song for the sea inspired by nature. Felien, famed for her imitation of sea creatures, is showing her latest work.

name: Earthen Descent
desc: In a slow and lilting song, dancers in gauzy sapphire dresses float down like ethereal fairies from the sky.

name: Twiddled Ripples
desc: Felien waves one hand as silver ribbons spread out in an instant, like water rippling in the shimmering sea.

name: Fluorescent Dream
desc: One by one, Felien and the dancers throw umbrellas into the air, capturing people's imagination like fishing nets.

name: Azure Breath
desc: As if the theater were submerged in water, dresses take on an azure hue like moon jellies chasing the light.

name: Delirium Dive
desc: The light changes color again. Moon jellies' tentacles can sting, creating beautiful dreams or horrible nightmares.

name: Duet Interlude
desc: An elegant yet dangerous and untouchable creature, it ascends from the sea, creating endless awe and fascination.

name: Moonlit Tide
desc: Finally, she reached Aram in its slumber. Her tireless search for a way to awaken Aram turned fruitless.

name: Midnight Glaze
desc: The man grew old as his youthful face started to wrinkle, but he returned to the shore every day without fail.

name: Swirling Surge
desc: She returned and told the man she had found Aram. He was beyond excited, listening intently to her story.

name: Bejeweled Ride
desc: Fascinated by the legend, Coraline began searching for Aram, as she could easily explore where no man ventured.

name: Luminous Pearl
desc: As promised, Coraline would ride the tide at dusk and meet with the man near reefs where no one could see them.

name: Lucent Chapter
desc: Coraline wiped the stone clean and wished for the prophecy to come true that mermaids could live among humans.

name: Temporal Grandeur
desc: Rivers coursed through Aram, where sea creatures swam freely within, and mermaids lived among humans.

name: Starlit Nocturne
desc: The man smiled and turned to Coraline. If the prophecy was true, maybe they could have a happy ending after all.

name: Lucent Rhyme
desc: The human had a wonderful voice and told Coraline that there was an ancient kingdom called Aram in the distant sea.

name: Pristine Gleam
desc: The island shook and started to sink with the violent changes in the ocean. A devastating disaster for Aram.

name: Mossed Abyss
desc: Gardenia was the golden-tailed daughter of sea and the queen of Aram, revered as an almighty goddess by her people.

name: Oceanic Swim
desc: In the heavy storm, people gathered around the once-clean square and looked with hope at the woman on the throne.

name: Foregone Ruins
desc: But one day, the rain kept bucketing down as if the sky was poked open, covering the kingdom in a gray shade.

name: Whirlwind Wave
desc: You can leave if you want to.' Gardenia's voice was calm, without a hint of panic in the face of the disaster.

name: Mermaid Echoes
desc: Humans and mermaids lived together in Aram as friends, lovers and families... They loved each other and the country.

name: Fateful Ripples
desc: I swear to protect Aram until it resurfaces thousands of years later. Then we will reunite in the new world.'

name: Aureate Shells
desc: Mermaids didn't fear the fall of the island as their home was the sea. They stayed because they were part of Aram.

name: Pearl of Time
desc: The storm raged on as rain blurred everyone's vision. They looked to Gardenia, waiting for her last command.

name: Hazy Wreath
desc: Gardenia finally spoke in a soft but determined voice, unwavering in the storm, 'Sleep now, my people.'

name: Mended Mirror
desc: So the people of Aram all sank into dreams, where humans and mermaids all became beautiful fish.

name: Abysmal Swim
desc: Unlike the rest of Aram, Olivia had eternal life. She once felt lost, but luckily Aram accepted her unconditionally.

name: Brocade Scales
desc: She would return to the sea and find a quiet corner for slumber. The ocean would grant her a new life.

name: Whirlpool Journey
desc: Her people were gone when Olivia looked back at the sea. Those glowing jellyfish dived deeper into the ocean.

name: Glazed Effulgence
desc: The light was golden scales' dream. The mermaid queen's song gave Olivia a soul and accepted her into Aram.

name: Pearl Gloria
desc: When she awoke and swam excitedly to the surface of the sea, she saw nothing but water where Aram had been.

name: Tidal Echoes
desc: Olivia didn't know what happened to Aram or where she should go. She wandered and searched in vain.

name: Sunlit Tempest
desc: As sails flapped in a raging tempest, a stranded sailor was finally rescued by Olivia after days out on the sea.

name: Dewy Breeze
desc: But Gardenia's prophecy said that Aram would resurface thousands of years later and all its people would be reunited.

name: Iridescent Frost
desc: Knowing Olivia's confusion, the sailor told her that Aram was engulfed in water centuries ago.

name: Glistening Haze
desc: Olivia had her answer and sent the sailor to shore. There he would find a small town, bustling unlike the cold sea.

name: Effulgent Crystal
desc: One day, she felt the sea's calling and bade farewell to her friends, before returning to peaceful slumber again.

name: Primeval Echoes
desc: —An excerpt from The Old Epochs: The Lost Kingdom, archived in the United Library of Pigeon Kingdom.

name: Lingering Tides
desc: The weather at sea can be cruel but it's always beautiful after a storm. Sailors have learned to respect nature.

name: Coral Fairytale
desc: Caravans passing through here enter an underwater world in their sleep, where fish dance and corals shine like gems.

name: Seashell's Murmur
desc: Oh the lively fish and beautiful shells; oh, everything so wonderful there.' The sailors' song represents their hope.

name: Legend of Sea Deity
desc: The sky darkens as clouds overhead grow gloomy. Sea birds fly low; all signs indicate that a storm is coming.

name: Distant Calls
desc: In the storm, a staff breaks through the rain and clouds, sending forth a powerful light, illuminating the world.

name: Flowing Spindrift
desc: Was that just a dream? Or is this a reward for the truly brave souls? The sailors gaze at the sea, not having a clue.

name: Festive Feast
desc: Even evanescent fireworks last forever in memories, and happiness will eventually arrive with beautiful dreams.

name: Temporal Memento
desc: Journey through the meadow of time, and in a gentle breeze, the brightest moments will be imprinted in her memory.

name: Glutinous Snowball
desc: The koala felt as smooth as velvet and so warm in my arms. It looked up at me, its eyes full of curiosity.

name: Daydream Respite
desc: The koala soon fell asleep on my shoulders. It was like a torch in the dreary winter, driving away the lonesome chill.

name: Wooden Repose
desc: Don't fret if you missed the vernal breeze, summer blooms or autumn harvests. Nature has something else in store.

name: Origin of the Journey
desc: Zhu Ruosheng: It's a beautiful idea to record the feelings at the moment in a video. Happy birthday, Nikki.

name: Shadow Prism
desc: Nancy: I'd still be trapped in the memories if it weren't for you. Thank you, Nikki, and happy birthday.

name: Time Envoy
desc: Bestt & Besan: The location of the gift is hidden in the password at the top of the video. Figure it out!

name: Trace of Spacetime
desc: Annabelle: I drew this cute little cartoon for you, Nikki, because you're the cutest one in Miraland.

name: Tacit Moment
desc: Ace:My sister and I picked these roses for you in our garden. I hope you'll like them. Happy birthday!

name: Bright Rainbow
desc: Mr. Lancelot: Meeeeeow! Meow-meow, me—

name: Crystal Stream
desc: Mela: The lyrics could've been improved, but I'll write you a better one next year. Happy birthday!

name: Eternal Fondness
desc: Yue Qianshuang: Happy birthday, Nikki! I'm sorry I can't be with you because of work, but I've got a gift for you!

name: Miraculous Exploration
desc: Winter: I like this way of sending wishes! Hold on, let me check the lines again. I've got so many people's wishes.

name: Sincere Bond
desc: Timi: Glad to have met you and seen so many miraculous designs. Happy birthday and stay passionate!

name: Adorable Wink
desc: Aron: It's the City Square behind me, can you see that? Join me in jogging next time. Happy birthday!

name: Heart in Heart
desc: Starlet: Go, go on with your journey. You won't be lost for the stars will shine for you.

name: Reverse Prism
desc: She knew neither her appearance nor the meaning of her existence. She called out, many times, to no avail.

name: Reverse Prism - Virus
desc: The larger world she yearned for was quietly opened to her. All the information that flooded in fascinated her.

name: Wandering Feather
desc: The girl in crystal shoes leaned on the gunwale and raised her glass to the trapped sailors with a faint smile.

name: Effulgent Orb
desc: Call that ship!' the sailors cheered and slowly navigated to the ship, planning to follow it out of the fog.

name: Endless Swirl
desc: The giant ship cast a long shadow over the lost sailors, and like a warning, the smile vanished from the girl's face.

name: Wandering Feather - Golden
desc: A century ago, a rich man built a cruise ship for his daughter's birthday that vanished in a heavy fog.

name: Effulgent Orb - Golden
desc: Did they see the cruise ship that was lost for a hundred years or was it just a mirage in the fog?

name: Endless Swirl - Golden
desc: Nobody knew the answer, and the encounter at sea became a new myth as time passed.

name: Wandering Feather - Green
desc: The scene was so eerie that the sailors stopped the ship. Someone tried to call for help, but the girl shushed him.

name: Effulgent Orb - Green
desc: A mysterious force stopped them from calling for help. Then the girl whisked them away as if to direct them.

name: Endless Swirl - Green
desc: Should they trust the girl or risk it? The captain made the decision to leave and saw sadness in the girl's eyes.

name: Stellar Pearl
desc: The special fabric drew the attention of many traveling merchants and was finally sold at an exorbitant price.

name: Cirrus Wreath
desc: It barely left a ripple in her life. She still sat by the sea and gazed up to capture more beautiful clouds.

name: Stellar Pearl - Purple
desc: To everyone's surprise, the painting turned blank the night it was stolen, as all the colors returned to the sky.

name: Cirrus Wreath - Purple
desc: The girl never thought of selling her paintings and only wished to show these tranquil views to everyone.

name: Stellar Pearl - Blue
desc: The miraculous beauty was meant to be shared, so people offered it to the king, leaving the blue in an art museum.

name: Cirrus Wreath - Blue
desc: The girl didn't accept any reward. All she wanted was for more people to appreciate the beauty of the peaceful sky.

name: Oceanic Core
desc: Sailors navigated the sea following their fathers' footsteps. It was where they came from and would eventually rest.

name: Seashore Chant
desc: Through peaceful water and stormy waves young sailors found the courage and resilience in their souls.

name: Tempest Shadow
desc: A steam whistle announced the departure of a giant ship. No one thought it would be dangerous until the storm came.

name: Oceanic Core - Golden
desc: The sailor remained quiet and looked down. The golden scale had vanished at some point, and no one knew when.

name: Seashore Chant - Golden
desc: The sailor traveled many seas and became a reliable veteran. Only sometimes he would space out gazing at the sea.

name: Tempest Shadow - Golden
desc: Young men on board were all intrigued by his experience, so the story in the storm traveled with him.

name: Oceanic Core - Azure
desc: The sailor fought the angry waves with all his strength, but the sea pulled him into a darker and colder embrace.

name: Seashore Chant - Azure
desc: The sailor heard the creature in the myth sing and saw the golden scale gleam faintly on his chest.

name: Tempest Shadow - Azure
desc: He passed out in the golden light. His grandpa gave him the scale for good luck, saying it was a gift from the sea.

name: Sweetheart Companion
desc: Though the past's bustle had faded, Yonie was not alone—she whistled, and flower-sniffing pups leapt into her arms.

name: Cartoon Sticker
