desc: As Yonie traveled, she embraced new sights, realizing the past was behind her—new wonders always waiting ahead.

name: Adorable Partner
desc: With each stroke, Yonie turned memories into pages—her story with the pups became a picture book to share with all.

name: Puppy's Choice
desc: Suddenly, Yonie heard a faint whimper. Following the sound, she found two weak spotted pups in a worn cardboard box.

name: Gleaming Surprise
desc: Feeling their fur, Yonie was moved by their warmth. She took the pups home and cared for them with gentle devotion.

name: Traveler's Bags
desc: Yonie decided to travel with the pups to burn off their energy. Seeing her pack, they spun excitedly around her.

name: Fluffy Buddy
desc: New to pet care, Yonie was often flustered. But the pups trusted her, patiently waiting as she prepared their meals.

name: Florid Wish
desc: Ace brought a rose from the royal garden, still blooming in this season like Nikki who never feared challenges.

name: Sincere Gifts
desc: Inside the gift boxes were friends' best wishes. Kimi even designed a package that matched her gift.

name: Bow of Wishes
desc: Bobo tied ribbons and laces around her box. A carefully tied bow stands for one's good thoughts and wishes.

name: Dream Compilation
desc: Momo showed precious photos that were taken without anyone noticing, jogging everyone's memory.

name: Timeless Bloom
desc: Winter and sisters made bookmarks from fallen blooms, forever beautiful like Nikki's smile.

name: Rosy Timekeeper
desc: Starlet's pocket watch lay quietly in the box, symbolizing the stars' wish that Nikki would never lose her way.

name: Chocolate Cube
desc: Debbie designed a party popper filled with rose petals. She would surprise Nikki with a shower of flowers.

name: Pearl of Memory
desc: The past was not only precious memories but a guide for Nikki's future—an especially bright and hopeful one.

name: Scented Envelope
desc: Mela played Nikki a special birthday song while Bestt drummed and made faces behind her back.

name: Fervent Boon
desc: Nikki felt every carefully wrapped present with her hand. They filled the room with her friends' good wishes.

name: Whispered Ardor
desc: Bai Jinjin sent unique paper cranes with beautiful wishes written beneath their wings.

name: Heavenly Abode
desc: Back then, she was just a set of data, a virtual character showing the music and dance of the Cloud to visitors.

name: Lotus Altar
desc: She didn't know the name people gave her: 'Lotus Fairy'; all she knew was the girl who called her 'Sister Fairy'.

name: Digital Illusion
desc: She learns of the beauty of music and dance from visitors' emotions. And she meets the girl who sees her as a deity.

name: Grand Vision
desc: The little girl with braids grabbed her garment, insisting that she was a celestial being living above the skies.

name: Enchanting Deity
desc: Some scorn 'Lotus Fairy,' saying it's all thanks to technology. But a sage responds, 'One who saves lives is a fairy.'

name: Celadon Grace
desc: Her data transforms magically as the girl gazes at them. An initial negation is rephrased, 'The time is not yet ripe.'

name: Cool Moon
desc: Sick in bed, the girl often tells her mythical tales: the fairy who seeks rain and the fairy who awaits its friend.

name: Auspicious Grass
desc: You dance exactly like the fairies! Mom says only fairies know where the healing herb is. Can you show me?'

name: Kitten Selection
desc: The girl rolls up her sleeves to build a cat tower. When she finishes, kittens have already claimed it as their turf.

name: Starlit Skyline
desc: Mimisi collects the cat hair and crafts it into needle-felted cats. Her works are quite popular among her customers.

name: Childhood Friend
desc: After she finally recreates the kitten from her memories, she chokes up a little petting the doll's head.

name: Relived Dream
desc: Mimisi is trimming a kitten's nails when a messenger waves outside her window and passes her a curled-up envelope.

name: Origin of Memories
desc: As Mimisi grows older, the kitten seems more like a distant memory, a tiny dot at the back of her mind.

name: Warm Corner
desc: As design guides fill her desktop, her memo-filled books about pets are pushed to the side but never covered in dust.

name: Promised Day
desc: On her graduation day, Mimisi tells her parents about her plan, who show their support with warm and knowing smiles.

name: Lazy Afternoon
desc: The girl hurries to take the letter before the cat can shred it to pieces: 'To Mimisi... in Ten Years?'

name: Unique Dream
desc: Mimisi finally decides on the cat cafe's location. Soon, there is soft decor and unique yet friendly kittens around.

name: Undying Vigor
desc: In the flickering green light, she found that it could be refined into purer metal to make more tools for survival.

name: Chime Messenger
desc: The scrap was made into a copper bird to scan for resources nearby and sound an alarm when it detected danger.

name: Fluorescence of Hope
desc: The navigational beacon was modified into a pair of wings that could carry her to find materials in the woods.

name: Wasteland Workshop
desc: When the ship crashed, she saved the tools, recycled everything in the rubble, and made them into her workshop now.

name: Refinery Goggles
desc: She would think of her old friends and wondered if they were living a new life now after jumping off the ship.

name: Furnace Shield
desc: She made careful preparations before exploring a new area. Her tools helped her survive all kinds of situations.

name: Symphony of Gears
desc: In deep caverns she found clean spring water with green orbs floating above, driving away the darkness.

name: Bizarre Wheels
desc: She collected these orbs in flasks and poured them into a glass tube. They shimmered like fireflies at night.

name: Skillful Artisan
desc: Planning to return home in the near future, she worked hard to collect resources and save food and energy.

name: Steam Chapter
desc: After studying the samples, she realized it was a special source of energy that could power the workshop.

name: Metallic Wings
desc: The steam from the metal wings pushed her up in the air. She held her scanner to explore deeper into the woods.

name: Mechanical Wings
desc: In a remote forest stood a workshop. A survivor from an air crash had created a world of her own.

name: Wilting Flowers
desc: A year on the earth passed by quickly, but the joys and sorrows were forever ingrained in her heart.

name: Aura of Death
desc: The central stardust was white like a cloud made of stars, governing death.

name: Merciful Savior
desc: It was another cycle of the seasons. She walked the wheat fields in the countryside and gazed at the world in silence.

name: Immortal Ascent
desc: From behind her mask she saw trees and flowers budding in spring breezes and children flying kites.

name: Gloom Echo
desc: The evening breeze carried a ring to her ears, like a sorrowful windchime from days of yore.

name: Nostalgic Rhyme
desc: She saw carps swim and cicadas buzz in shadows of the deep green and under the scorching summer sun.

name: Frosty Jade
desc: The last streak of green was wiped away from the frigid soil, leaving only the color of life in crystal-clear jade.

name: Quaint Whisper
desc: In the wind was another clear clang that was a distant promise between mankind, the stars and the seasons.

name: Prism Variation
desc: The band changed the tempo for the next movement. The princess sauntered among the crowd like a fluttering butterfly.

name: Aureate Stairway
desc: The princess danced cheerfully to the band's rejoicing melodies and became the center of attention.

name: Rain of Flowers
desc: Friends threw petals up in the air while a bird carrying a crown in its beak put it gently around the princess's head.

name: Ballad of Fantasy
desc: She talked excitedly about her long journey. All the fascinating encounters became a chapter of fun adventures.

name: Chapter of Turmoil
desc: Everyone was touched by those fateful encounters, while the dangerous accidents put them on the edge of their seats.

name: Sunlit Seasons
desc: The introverted girl grew into a self-assured lady. She would forever treasure the experiences along the journey.

name: Journey Companion
desc: Where are we going next?' the little one says, 'You're right, the customers' smiles are really the best reward.'

name: New Gift
desc: No one knows how the merchant got those goods, except her long shopping lists, filled with cherished memories.

name: Journey Through Memory
desc: A lively figure rushes into the little girl's arms. The merchant smiles, 'It got lost, but you guided it back home.'

name: Silken Box
desc: Neon lights cast a vibrant glow over the goods. The merchant, wearing a shawl, strolls down the street amid the crowd.

name: Astral Blaze
desc: As silver stars strew the velvety sky, the princess saw her friends off and silence returned to the palace.

name: Future Aspiration
desc: A new journey would begin soon. Imagining what could happen, she smiled and fell sound asleep under the moon.

name: Fluffy Bunny Pom-poms
desc: A white pom-pom with two rubies makes a cute bunny hairpin! As always, her sisters can't wait to put them on.

name: Charming Snowball
desc: Mao Ling styles her customers' hair to match the hairpins. Almost every girl wears a bunny hairpin on Long Street.

name: Daydream Whisper
desc: All the headpieces are sold out. Mao Ling knows she could see her sisters' smiles when she gives them the lanterns.

name: Gluttonous Bunny
desc: Life's flavors are in each bite and sip,' Mao Rui starts her lecture, though others are too busy eating her skewers.

name: Midjourney Yearning
desc: On her travels, Mao Rui met many who loved poetry and skewers, but she most enjoys her sisters' company.

name: Aspiring Dream
desc: As more tourists flock, Mao Rui keeps her eyes on the bunny lanterns, perfect gifts for her skillful sisters.

name: Sugar-sweet Berry
desc: Mao Rui also makes sweet and tangy tanghulus for her customers, a refreshing treat after spicy skewers.

name: Heavenly Reunion
desc: She sees the two most familiar faces at the ceremony. The three tie for first, sharing a knowing smile on stage.

name: Zephyr Companion
desc: The three sisters hang the bunny lanterns at the gate. The light shines on their love for their family.

name: Tendril Glimmer
desc: As the train picked up speed, she stood up—the girl chased the train, her pink dress flowing in the wind.

name: Entwining Bloom
desc: When she said she'd pick the prettiest tulip, the boy shook his head, saying he liked flowers in their natural state.

name: Soundless Echo
desc: The girl had long had a crush on him and decided to tell her feelings when he gave her the prettiest flower.

name: Floweret Parable
desc: The girl left the manor for the first time when he left. The train station was crowded but he was all she could see.

name: Spectral Blossom
desc: But before she received the prettiest flower, the boy came to bid her farewell as he was needed at home.

name: Game of Snow
desc: Unlike humans, the squirrel didn't like the food stored underground; instead, it preferred nuts.

name: Warm Hearth
desc: When Ella didn't feel like cooking, the squirrel would hop onto her lap, which always lightened her up.

name: Breath of Frost
desc: The squirrel didn't like sleeping in the fallen leaves; it would hop around Ella's bed and sleep beside her pillow.

name: Sun Chaser
desc: In this forest devoid of warmth, Ella and the squirrel would dance in the sunshine as it cast through the leaves.

name: Wilderness Trip
desc: One morning, they strayed a little too far from home and lost sight of their hut when the sun was setting.

name: Wild Berries
desc: Ella wanted to return, but the squirrel ran into the depths of the forest and picked some berries for her.

name: Glint of Spring
desc: In the squirrel's company, Ella had brightened up and, one day, finally left the forest and saw the distant fields.

name: Cordial Invitation
desc: Behind was the misty forest, where she had spent all her life; before her were the fields, where spring was in bloom.

name: Furry Warmth
desc: As Ella hesitated, she felt warmth on her cheek — the squirrel was rubbing against her, encouraging her to move on.

name: Journey Together
desc: Ella reached out her hand, feeling the warmth of the sun, and decided to embrace the world with her little friend.

name: Breath of Wind
desc: The sun cast its light on the meadow and the flowers, but only a faint touch of warmth could penetrate the forest.

name: Departing Melody
desc: Their laughter and songs dissipated into the sunlight. The sweet days that wouldn't last were Nehemia's final gift.

name: Golden Deer
desc: Now a graceful young lady, Ella failed to grasp the spells, and Nehemia's face was devoid of traces of time.

name: Flowery Utterance
desc: Nehemia tried to teach Ella spells, but however hard she worked, she couldn't establish a connection with the snow.

name: Verdure Cypress
desc: While Nehemia was busy, Ella had put on ribbons and bells on the tree in the yard and decorated their little hut.

name: Dazzling Heart
desc: To help Ella, Nehemia consulted the Ancient Tree, who answered all the questions, but Ella didn't understand a word.

name: Frosty Crystal
desc: Nehemia went back and made some scrolls, which, miraculously, enabled Ella to cast a few basic spells.

name: Prelude of Finality
desc: Nehemia said that human life would end at the age of 100. Much like snow melting, Nehemia would one day be gone.

name: Radiant Shadows
desc: 99 — Nehemia wrote down her age in the snow and told Ella that she must find a way to leave the forest.

name: Sole Star
desc: What were humans? And what was the curse? Ella knew nothing, except that she wanted to stay with Nehemia.

name: Dance of Snowflakes
desc: Nehemia got carried away with her work, and Ella strolled in the forest alone and shared her stories with Nehemia.

name: Silence of Snow
desc: The unrelenting snow had stopped. Ella ran back to tell Nehemia, only to find her collapsed in the Circle.

name: Finale of Night
desc: Another snowy dusk. Ella was on her way back when she saw a gleam from the hut, illuminating the entire forest.

name: Prepared and Ready
desc: She had even attached a nametag on each seat for the guests. But surely this was no surprise.

name: Cypress in Bloom
desc: Her well-tended red flowers echoed with the evergreens, adding a wonderful touch of nature to the stage.

name: Chime Variation
desc: Ria had carefully chosen a selection of music. Whatever the tempo, she was confident she would have a perfect dance.

name: Sweet Infatuation
desc: Lady Ria, admired and loved by all, also had a loved one, whom she met at last year's ball and immediately fell for.

name: Winter Love
desc: As Ria danced alone to the upbeat music, she glanced at the young man and caught a hint of surprise in his blue eyes.

name: Hope of Reunion
desc: Ria didn't know if he was a resident of the town. So, she planned for this year's ball, just to meet him again.

name: Cheerful Tune
desc: As the music cheerfully floated in the air and the snow gracefully fell, she finally saw that familiar figure.

name: Destined Meet
desc: A faint smile crossed Ria's face—she was hoping that the young man, whom she had only met once, would love her dance.

name: Blooming Life
desc: The most attractive red flower, however, was burning on her chest, making her the only star of the night.

name: Endearing Moment
desc: The yearly ball had always been the most exciting event in the town, and this year, Lady Ria would be the host.

name: Walking in Light
desc: Let the rising sun witness my change as I chase my dream and compose the song of a brighter future.

name: Springtime Imprint
desc: We trace the path of time as leaves drift in a gentle breeze, moving into the embrace of spring and blooming flowers.

name: Poised Moment
desc: She held me next to the fire and dried my fur. Since then, she has let me stay by her side for many years.

name: Spring Strawberry
desc: Time flew as we sat by the fire watching seasons change in the yard. Strawberries in spring were the best for wine.

name: Dune Mirage
desc: Scorpions from the sand answered the girl's whistle and swarmed toward the soldiers, breaking them apart instantly.

name: Scorpion Heart
desc: The girl rushed home only to see soldiers in the village, a sword raised high and swung at an innocent villager.

name: Predator Scorpion
desc: The scorpion in her palm pointed its stinger at the mayor's throat. In fear the mayor swore to never do it again.

name: Dreadful Shadow
desc: Being forced to pay heavy taxes, the hopeless villagers had to seek help from the girl living in the mountains.

name: Mist of Illusion
desc: They begged the girl to drive away the soldiers like how she fought off robbers, but the girl did not answer.

name: Aureate Crescent
desc: The next morning, the girl showed up at the mayor's manor and claimed to have intelligent scorpions to show him.

name: Dreamland Marvel
desc: The mayor only showed interest in the scorpions and patronized the naive-looking girl, inviting her to stay.

name: Astral Glory
desc: The girl protected the village again and gave them courage. Together they ended the dark night and welcomed dawn.

name: Myriad Echoes
desc: Qiu Ren goes off, leaving Qiguan Yu speechless with the piece of paper signed by Qiu Ren which weighed a ton.

name: Gold Silk
desc: The guard snaps, 'Why did you promise him those benefits? You wouldn't be wronged if it wasn't for the Qiu family!'

name: Silk Embroidery
desc: The master of the Qiu family has been ill. The family, entrenched in internal strife, is on the verge of collapse.

name: Deep Pockets
desc: Soon, footsteps approach the door. A middle-aged man walks in with a hunch. 'I'm Qiu Ren. You were looking for me?'

name: Encircling Haze
desc: Qiguan Yu sighs, 'Eventually, the truth can be revealed.' 'What about the Qiu family? Do we just let them get away?'

name: Glittering Earring
desc: Qiguan Yu smiles, 'Qiu Ren is shortsighted. With him being the new head, the family will fall apart soon.'

name: Gleaming Bead
desc: The guard seems to have more to say but Qiguan Yu waves him off. After examining the books, he turns to the innkeeper.

name: Sealed Night
desc: The innkeeper takes the books and leaves the room. He feels puzzled — no one had known Qiguan Jin had a brother.

name: Stellar Fields
desc: The innkeeper probes, 'Are you from the Zephyr Hall?' Qiguan Yu only hands over the books, 'No mistakes, well done.'

name: Thriving Orchid
desc: As night falls, the bustling city quiets down. But the sound of wheels comes as a carriage stops before the Grand Inn.

name: Moon in Hand
desc: It's a clear, cool night. Qiguan Yu steps into the garden; a woman is standing under the trees, staring into the sky.

name: Stirring Seas
desc: The flute resonates through the clear night. As it concludes, Qiguan Yu sheaths his sword and looks back at Ji Tu.

name: Daylight Lanterns
desc: He must have had other names than Kong Kong'er; he could be one of the seniors, trying to conceal his true identity.'

name: Distant Dreams
desc: Another asks, 'Where is Kong Kong'er?' Ji Tu smiles, 'Must be laying low for a while.'

name: Exquisite Brocades
desc: He's always been quite proud of himself: he returned the design and gave us evidence. He thinks we're even now.'

name: Clear Rainbow
desc: They leave the estate shortly after having achieved their goal and return to the Grand Inn without any delay.

name: Spot of Red
desc: Once he's gotten our letter he'll surely come to witness the truth of this matter, using a different identity, though.'

name: Echoes of Years
desc: Ji Tu starts writing to the Mayor of Luoyan City — Kong Kong'er has been wanted by the Mayor for many years.

name: Melancholic Moon
desc: A disciple hesitates, 'Although we've sent out invitation letters, what if no one comes? What should we do then?'

name: Crimson Silk
desc: We've been preparing for years,' Ji Tu replies with finality, 'Don't overthink it; I know what I'm doing.'

name: Tinkling Bracelet
desc: With solid evidence in hand, the slander against Qiguan Jin and the Zephyr Hall will come to an end tomorrow.

name: Spare No Expense
desc: Invitations have been sent to martial sects, prominent families and even the government — everyone they can think of.

name: Daylight Crown
desc: The long performer's block almost cost all her faith. She's suddenly afraid she'd never enter the great hall of music.

name: Faith Adrift
desc: She puts her cello aside as if she lost her soul, when a voice suddenly urges her to a journey of self-discovery.

name: Space Resonance
desc: Two musicians communicate in the grand symphony a century apart, their souls infinitely close.

name: Lightyear Ramble
desc: She returns to the start of everything, turning into the child that first learned the beauty of music decades ago.

name: Lilt of Time
desc: Perola plays the tune gently with her eyes closed, the sonorous sound of cello reciting the poetry of time.

name: Echoes in Time
desc: Applause only sounds after a long stunned silence. Someone has finally claimed this crown of classical music.

name: Silent Eulogy
desc: The first time Perola heard the variation, she felt like floating in space, her heart struck by the infinite grandeur.

name: Mellow Wonder
desc: Who could refuse such a customer? She invited the bunny to sit and thought she might wake up anytime now.

name: Snowcream Hare
desc: She opened her eyes to see the familiar bedroom. As the wind blew, she saw a crystal snowflake on the window sill.

name: Dazzling Meteor
desc: Felicia finally found the girl's star among numerous sparks. She flew toward it and scooped it up.

name: Ephemeral Radiance
desc: Countless memories flooded in: all the rehearsals, the anticipation for the show, and suddenly falling ill...

name: Tranquil Breeze
desc: Felicia flew between shooting stars. She would pass by wishes that glowed brightly and flew further up the sky.

name: Lilting Chant
desc: Felicia remembered how she made a wish on her birthday this year that she would become a great actress on stage.

name: Dreamcatcher Net
desc: The star net could only be used once, so Felicia kept searching for the girl's wish that she promised to realize.

name: Feline Violinist
desc: A cat plush looked around, puzzled. Then, a girl stepped onstage and handed it a wooden violin.

name: Feline Trombonist
desc: It felt like magic—plush toys floated down with instruments, lifting fuzzy paws to wave at the crowd.

name: Genuine Curiosity
desc: “Welcome to the Laurel Puppet Show.” The girl turned, tipped her hat to the crowd—and cheers rose as the spell broke.

name: Seating Etiquette
desc: The girl removed her hair bow and tossed it high. It spread into a canopy above—as seats filled the plaza below.

name: Snowfall Viridescence
desc: Snow blocked by the canopy, warmth filled the air. The girl tossed her emerald—and the bare stage bloomed with green.

name: Fluffy Stamp
desc: The audience felt that Laurel's greatest magic was this: bringing warmth and joy, letting music soothe weary hearts.

name: Score of Wonder
desc: Lights flared like fireflies, scattering then circling back to Laurel's palm—forming a scorebook and a baton.

name: Beats of Magic
desc: Laurel raised her baton, tapping each puppet's head. The playful toys quickly lined up, instruments ready to play.

name: Spotlight Spell
desc: Flowers dressed the stage. As Laurel spun, her citrine crystal flashed, casting dazzling light across amazed faces.

name: Sweet Endearment
desc: Young love is often tested with time. When beauty and youth are no more, will love still be the same?

name: Fond Infatuation
desc: The Love God's arrow is the key to opening hearts, awakening one's feelings as they take the first step to true love.

name: Heartfelt Fancy
desc: Feelings turn into songs at the Love God's fingertips, watering souls like morning dew and warming hearts like sunset.

name: Budding Affection
desc: The Love God's magic doesn't always work, not on a kitten who only cares about fish or a certain dorky little dwarf.

name: Manifesto of Love
desc: Love can sometimes be a trap, and when the trapped one sees through the lies, they'll grow and embrace a new life.

name: Arrow of Devotion
desc: With gems of laughter and tears on her arrows, the Love God draws stars and lovers' dreams with gentle moonlight.

name: Eternal Love
desc: Love can be fleeting or last a lifetime, but true love stands even the test of death and becomes eternal.

name: Passion Spell
desc: The magic of the arrows comes from the heart. Never forget to seek inward for answers and love yourself.

name: Sweet Enchantment
desc: Love can be subtle poems or grand gestures. The Love God likes all forms of endearment brimming with love.

name: Magic Assistant
desc: Through poisonous swamps and thorny bushes, Tritty finally sees the rumored witch's violet mushroom house.

name: Messenger of Joy
desc: Tritty's unannounced arrival startles the eccentric witch, as she almost trips and falls into her brewing pot.

name: Dancing Blossoms
desc: Tritty doesn't want to miss any chance, even if hope is like a firework in the dark sky, brilliant yet distant.

name: Wishing Strings
desc: The witch is still upset after Tritty's apology, because she doesn't have enough energy of joy for the ideal potion.

name: Emerald Streak
desc: Tritty proposes to the witch, 'If I could perform at the festival, I might be able to gather energy of joy for you.'

name: Eureka Fountain
desc: With the witch's potion, Tritty turns into a pretty girl, but whatever she does, she can't hide her beautiful tail.

name: Quilled Wand
desc: To hide her tail, she takes inspiration from parade dancers and designs a gorgeous dress with feathery fleeces.

name: Echoing Wishes
desc: Before that, she wants to join the festival with Tritty. What is it like? The witch couldn't help her curiosity.

name: Warbling Finch
desc: Gwen could understand the white bird's changing chirps and imagine a broader world through its singing.

name: Everlasting Bloom
desc: In spring, wisteria would grow into cascades of purple around Gwen's home, guiding the white finch when it returned.

name: Ceaseless Cycle
desc: As long as Gwen's magic and beautiful things existed, her spinning wheel would never stop working.

name: Embroidered Nest
desc: Gwen and the white finch were always together. She weaved the finch a warm and beautiful nest next to the wisteria.

name: Canopied Woodland
desc: She had an idea to make fallen leaves into translucent gauze and weave it into a beautiful dress of nature.

name: Buoyant Blooms
desc: She also made flowers brought by the white finch into fragrant brocade that changed color with the seasons.

name: Beaded Fragrance
desc: The white finch was Gwen's only friend in the secluded forest. They talked from flowers to the secrets of color.

name: Finch's Bloom
desc: The white finch would help Gwen weave, either picking up a thread or singing to the rhythm of the spinning wheel.

name: Honeypot of Dreams
desc: The colorful sweets in the bear's pocket are sour, sweet or refreshing. She's always looking forward to the next one.

name: Bubble Glitter
desc: When the last bubble breaks, she wakes up to her usual room, the doll smiling at her on her night stand.

name: Carefree Companion
desc: She dances with the bear as the sunflowers sing. The bear is happy to make a new friend and accept her honey gift.

name: Blossom Choir
desc: She follows the sound to see sunflowers rejoicing in the sun. She lies among the blooms as they share their stories.

name: Heartwarming Aspiration
desc: If she could stand again, would her life be as colorful? She dozes off in the warm sunlight with such hope.

name: Joyous Melody
desc: Her wheelchair is somehow gone. She tries to take a step, her feet in ballet shoes, leaping briskly on the ground.

name: Haven of the Soul
desc: She's now wearing the doll's white dress, with a sea of sunflowers like the fairyland in her imagination.

name: Colorful Fairyland
desc: She dances in the fragrant breeze and blooms, as colorful bubbles float and decorate the field as a fairyland.

name: Sunlight Streak
desc: She lies on the grass and basks in the warmth of the sun, as butterflies whisper secrets to her ears.

name: Gilded Rainbow
desc: She rides the wind above the clouds, collects golden candy in the rain and rests sometimes on the rainbow bridge.

name: Free Saunter
desc: She feels the ground tremble from afar and passes a portal to see a crowned bear in her handmade overalls.

name: Future Marvels
desc: She plans for the next picture book with hopes for the future, an interesting and joyful story forming in her mind.

name: Shards of Dreams
desc: A sound of sleds broke the silence of winter as a couple emerged from the dark and dusted snow off their clothes.

name: Elysium Star
desc: Maggie woke up and found that the snow had stopped. She ran downstairs and saw the goddess' gift by the fireplace.

name: Snow Feather
desc: Before going to sleep, Maggie made her wish innocently. Then she dreamed about her parents, holding her in their arms.

name: Auspice of Snow
desc: Maggie unwrapped the gift, her grandma lovingly watching her, and saw a beautiful scarf and a star-shaped hair clip.

name: Hug in Snow
desc: Maggie put on her new scarf and waited for her parents, who didn't show up even when the stars had risen.

name: Starry Gift
desc: Tears welled up in Maggie's eyes. Looking at the frozen forest, Grandma patted her back, but she refused to go to bed.

name: Dream Watch
desc: And the stars had indeed been the best gift, for they had guided innumerous souls in the darkness of winter nights.

name: Stellar Ceremony
desc: When the snow stopped, Maggie's parents decided to hurry back. In the vast snowland, the stars had been their guide.

name: Sweetest Hope
desc: All kinds of sweets wrapped in colorful packages with adoring affection. Special gifts for the special person.

name: Blooming Years
desc: As she skates down the shaded street, her hair flutters in the wind; every turn she takes becomes part of her memory.

name: Hues of Adolescence
desc: The gentle spring sunlight casts on her skateboard and her classmates wait for her to join the graduation ceremony.

name: Mellow Zephyr
desc: Stars scattered across the sky as the evening breeze sang. Children closed their eyes, falling into beautiful dreams.

name: Veiled Scorpion
desc: The grateful villagers offered the girl a beautiful bouquet. She held it in her arms and gently touched the petals.

name: Whirling Clouds
desc: An elder Zhu, aided by a servant, took out a manuscript, revealing the man in red in the painting as his uncle.

name: Ode to Love
desc: People dismissed the story. Mr. Spring was a person of arrogance and solitude, never treating others with hospitality.

name: Ink Painting of Tiger
desc: Years later, the Zhu family shocked their guests at an event by revealing the other half of Ban Yin.

name: Yin Yang Harmony
desc: The painting revealed another mystery: two figures in white and red admiring the red plum blossoms.

name: Azure Waters
desc: I heard a mountain under the Bay of Cang River shared my name I became hopelessly lost'

name: Circling Clouds
desc: The person who saved me wore a calm nonchalance on his face before introducing himself as Mr. Spring.'

name: Encaptivating Words
desc: I'm invited to his residence. I was impressed by the stacks of fragrant scrolls and the vivid drawing of red plums.'

name: Destined Encounter
desc: Mr. Spring showed equal interest in my travels. We became friends as we shared an admiration for each other.'

name: Faraway Ambition
desc: Everyone in my tribe believed that east was the direction where one would find truth and the gods.'

name: Mountains and Rivers
desc: Following this creed, I traveled to White Rock City and Rolterdan. As I journeyed, I found another also headed east.'

name: Magical Journey
desc: Mr. Spring and I promised a reunion each year, a promise that we have always kept no matter how far we were.'

name: Lifetime Story
desc: The elder and his uncle were close. Upon his uncle's passing, he found these travelogues that mentioned Mr. Spring.

name: Soaring Hearts
desc: You are intrigued by the afar, while I am fascinated by the mountain. We simply share the same love.'

name: Plum Blossom to Give
desc: I chose not to persuade further. As I left, he gifted me a painting of plums. It's been my treasure ever since.'

name: Silent Utterance
desc: The two halves of Ban Yin were finally reunited, displaying its beauty to all those who beheld it.

name: Painting of Hearts
desc: Insight can gained from observing Forward. Unlike Surel's early work, this one does not depict the Vien Manor.

name: Eternal Blossom
desc: The large waves and dark colors accentuated the sole sail in the tempest using seemingly useless brushstrokes.

name: Inseparable Companion
desc: The conversation between Surel and the fairy is so mysterious that even her parents didn't mention it in their memoir.

name: Magnum Opus
desc: On this special afternoon, when Surel uncharacteristically put down paintbrush, her magnum opus, Forward, was born.

name: Rural Beauty
desc: Her work covered every inch of Vien Manor. From the pond of still water to the midsummer night trail.

name: Esteemed Fame
desc: As Surel's work gained fame, so did the manor, welcoming countless guests to behold its beauty.

name: Country Tale
desc: Surel smiled at her parents with her easel on her back. Perhaps a polite fairy will ask her for a portrait today.

name: Midnoon Adventure
desc: No cicada chirp or fluttering of wings could interrupt Surel from painting, until she felt a pat on her shoulder.

name: Fairy Dwelling
desc: The forbidden palace of the Fairy King was illuminated last night in its full glory.

name: Mirage of Life
desc: The young girl frowned as she stared at the man's pointy ears. He bowed and apologized politely for interrupting her.

name: Wintry Surge
desc: No longer being at a loss, Satiel would still choose those silvery figures as she secretly returned to the hill.

name: Perceptive Deer
desc: The birds and the gentle zephyr would play with her braids as she hung the decorations on the Ashen Deer's antlers.

name: Glacial Summit
desc: The villagers, believing it to be a divine sign, braided her hair and wrote the name Satiel onto her palm.

name: Woodland's Depths
desc: Satiel had a difficult time understanding the human tongue as she tried her best to mimic their moves and words.

name: Grace of Nature
desc: Before Satiel realized it, the night had already fallen. Panicked, she ran toward the village at the hill bottom.

name: Enlightened Radiance
desc: Seeing Satiel and the Deer emerge from a bush sent relief to the anxious faces of the villagers searching for her.

name: Tale of Life
desc: The Spirit Birds and the Ashen Deer helped the villagers forage, while Satiel would often bring them a lot of food.

name: Dawn Till Dusk
desc: Satiel's stomach growled. The villagers held her hand as they took the journey back on the torch-lit trail.

name: Circle of Life
desc: Even as Satiel grew up, she still trod between the deer pack and the village, almost like a bridge connecting them.

name: Eternal Dream
desc: Satiel never had to speak in front of the Ashen Deer and the Spirit Birds. When she did, she felt strange.

name: Bells of Old
desc: The villagers sat by the dying flame, unsure where to go next. Yet, idle waiting would only spell certain death.

name: Endless Snow
desc: That day, the snowstorm became ceaseless, slowly enveloping the mountain and blowing aside the meager tents.

name: Enchanting Ceremony
desc: Every time the villagers invited Satiel to perform, she would bury her face into a deer's soft fur with a blush.

name: Glimmering Candlelight
desc: The Holy Maiden braided the young girl's hair as she whispered into her ear, her eyes glimmering as she nodded.

name: Echoes of the Void
desc: The table shuddered as the girl embraced the young woman, making her father look both embarrassed and flustered.

name: Steps of Wishes
desc: The little girl could hold her curiosity no longer. 'O' Holy Maiden. What hast the gods whispered to thy ears?'

name: Majestic Crown
desc: The child leaned on her father's shoulder and asked what the divine gods had revealed with their revelations.

name: Veiled Mist
desc: Doves flew across the sky. As the crowd admired the flock, a girl, clad in white, began to walk toward them.

name: Divine Whispers
desc: The child's father stroked her hair as the crowd laughed, jokingly telling her to ask for herself at the ceremony.

name: Concert of Shadows
desc: She needed no introduction. To everyone, she was the definition and the indisputable image of the Holy Maiden.

name: Ashen Hymn
desc: The girl radiated with a divine radiance as she chanted the story about a divine ship heading to the east.

name: Between Light and Darkness
desc: The Holy Maiden sat at the feast, patiently and lovingly answering the questions from the crowd gathered around her.

name: Silent Prayer
desc: The young lady walked toward the candle-lit podium, gently lowering her head as she beckoned toward the crowd below.

name: Crown of Nights
desc: The young lady walked onto the podium basked in the sound of pious prayers and the shimmering candlelight.

name: Veil of Dreams
desc: The young lady knew where she came from, and she also knew where she should lead her people.

name: Secrets of Divinity
desc: With her hands clasped together, she whispered her yearnings and devotion to the true deities residing in her heart.

name: Waters of Clarity
desc: Under the distant chants, the young woman began to dance under the veil of stars, her eyes shimmering like the ocean.

name: Stellar Path
desc: As the world fell into a hush, the young woman and her companions dove into the night as they chased the morning sun.

name: Spiritual Enlightenment
desc: The young woman stood under the stars, the wind swept through her hair and brought her the secrets hidden by time.

name: Symphony of Stars
desc: The young woman finally broke her shackles and retrieved her soul. She now yearns to be reunited with her friends.

name: Silent Questions
desc: The man followed the army into the snowy North Kingdom, only the stars in the sky knew of his true destination.

name: Secret of Ages
desc: The once foreign girl was not closely intertwined with this land, her eyes resolute and glimmering with confidence.

name: Fortune's Signs
desc: The diligent queen and her sister would sometimes lie in each other's embrace as they gazed into the stars.

name: Stellar Brilliance
desc: Each card glowed with an inscrutable intent. Let fate guide your hand, and the stars will reveal the secret within.

name: Flowering Romance
desc: Returning guests would often share the location of flowers with the smiling girl. Soon, a voice called out to her.

name: Blooming Patience
desc: Mina always paused to listen to these stories, her flowers standing as a silent witness to sincerity and affection.

name: Dream of Blossoms
desc: Mina always carried a small basket of flowers for each season. She firmly believed in waiting for a flower's bloom.

name: Flowering Romance - Indigo
desc: The young girl who would often buy the small flower fell ill, her face pale as snow when Mina visited her.

name: Blooming Patience - Indigo
desc: The girl spoke feebly to Mina, hoping to once again feel the touch of the yellow flower she first received from Mina.

name: Dream of Blossoms - Indigo
desc: Yet, those delicate flowers would only blossom in summer. What should Mina do to fulfill her wish?

name: Flowering Romance - Warmth
desc: A moment of brilliance erupted on Mina's face. She kissed her mother before rushing to her little greenhouse.

name: Blooming Patience - Warmth
desc: Euphoria washed over Mina as the yellow petals broke through the bud. She placed the flower in her embrace and ran.

name: Dream of Blossoms - Warmth
desc: The little girl awoke to find the yellow flowers in front of her, vibrant and filled with comforting solace.

name: Driving Thunder
desc: Zhichen commanded the power of nature. People believed that the echoes of clapping thunder were his wrathful roar.

name: Into the Clouds
desc: Inspired by the thunderclap, craftsmen added bear paws and eagle claws to the statue to exude its divine might.

name: Soaring Dragon
desc: Commanding the rain, the craftsmen also added aquatic elements, in the form of winding whiskers and glimmering scales.

name: Glimmering Scales
desc: Zhichen would call down rain in times of drought, as he would protect the city in stormed by a raging tempest.

name: Mountain of Fortune
desc: Curious about his image in the people's minds, Zhichen often came as he observed the puny creatures and big creations.

name: Idyllic Pavilion
desc: Crafting a statue the size of a mountain was a generational endeavor, with each craftsman adding details bit by bit.

name: Dragon's Descendants
desc: The most skilled craftsmen were chosen as they trekked from far and wide to work on this colossal statue.

name: Kaleidoscope of Clouds
desc: Each worker devoted their life to the statue's making, manning every task with almost pious diligence.

name: Fortune's Evanescence
desc: Centuries have come and passed, the once barren mountain was slowly transformed into its new form.

name: Serene Quietude
desc: The statue's unique appearance pleased Zhichen, who imprinted his form upon the stone outcrop.

name: Azure Expanse
desc: The statue slowly began to take shape. Its mysterious appearance is accentuated by the mountain's misty veil.

name: Unseen Lurker
desc: The statue towered into the clouds, leaving only its majestic claws visible for the mortals to behold its grandeur.

name: Divine Genesis
desc: The statue took many forms, the antlers of deer, the scales of carps... It was like an amalgamation of nature itself.

name: Empyrean Soar
desc: Suddenly, mountains shattered to reveal the glimmering scale underneath Zhichen leaped into the air in his new form.

name: Cosmic Destiny
desc: With his new form, Zhichen soared through the heavens, displaying his grandeur to those who helped shape him.

name: Lunar Floriography
desc: The fairies tried to stop Elina. Without Lake Bovaly, there were terrible dangers lurking in the depths of the woods.

name: Wishful Tolls
desc: Elina's songs were filled with hope and excitement, 'Do not worry for me, for the moon will bestow me with courage.'

name: Aria of Sorrow
desc: Elina departed into the strange forest under the worrying gaze of her friends as the flowers waved her goodbye.

name: Aureate Touch
desc: Standing at the mist-enveloped entrance, Elina stopped to ask a wandering goose for directions.

name: Symphony of Petals
desc: Elina did not feel lonely in the forest. Moonlight guided her as she sang with the flowers and the chirping birds.

name: Effulgent Gossamer
desc: The Jungle of Thorns offered little reprieve. Elina followed the river forward until she finally saw moonlight.

name: Effulgent Dream
desc: Across the river and through the thorns, where the moonlight quietly awaits the next adventurer.'

name: Wondrous Odyssey
desc: It's said that the Moonlight Flower only blossoms at the river's beginning, blessing those who see it with courage.

name: Ballad of Love

name: Tale of Ripples
desc: Isabelle would meet her love from dawn till dusk, not even the ocean could separate their beating hearts.

name: Pearly Tears
desc: The tempest subsided, but her lover would never return again. Tears of sorrow streamed down Isabelle's cheeks.

name: Cirrus Lament
desc: The lantern was stolen and her lover was gravely injured. As Isabelle slowly sank, even the sea wept tears of sorrow.

name: Plumes of Reunion
desc: To awaken Isabelle, the sailor traveled far and wide, eventually finding a way from the mouth of a witch.

name: Call of Sincerity
desc: The sailor rowed his lonely boat as he braved the waves and the thunderstorm, feeling no fear in his heart.

name: Plumed Memento
desc: Without the protection, the sea bellowed ceaselessly, destroying all ships that dared to venture too close.

name: Radiant Promise
desc: The sailor possessed a lantern that exuded divine powers in Isabelle's hands, drawing malicious eyes upon it.

name: Poem of Reunion
desc: Ships once again began to frequent these waters. Isabelle once again surfaced, this time singing the sailor's song.

name: Agate Crystal
desc: The closer she came to home, the more familiar faces greeted her along the way.

name: Sweet Nectar
desc: She rushed into the arms of her grandmother, who sat smiling outside the decorated house.

name: Plump Fruition
desc: Spring buds bloom in summer. Autumn fruits hang from branches, ripening into red persimmons by winter.

name: Persimmon Lantern
desc: The persimmon-shaped lantern casts its warm glow, guiding people into a dreamy wonderland as they soundly sleep.

name: Nightmare Resurgent
desc: The priestess chant continued until a beam of light pierced through the clouds like the sharp edge of a blade.

name: Guarding Oracle
desc: Eons had passed, yet the seed of hope traded with countless lives had long taken root in these lands.

name: Sanguine Rose
desc: As the chants faded, the priestess fell from the altar, charred plumes turned into roses as darkness became light.

name: Nocturnal Rhythm
desc: She would walk from table to table with a smile, her affectionate personality radiating toward each delighted guest.

name: Euphoric Rhythm
desc: The bar had a large round table, large enough for all guests to sit around Matina as they chattered among themselves.

name: Silent Cosmos
desc: Matina had a knack for creating drinks from seemingly unrelated ingredients, often resulting in unforgettable tastes.

name: Glowing Star
desc: The guests' eyes fell upon Matina, who stood up with a small shrug.

name: Midnight Melody
desc: That time of the day again? Very well. One more drink and I'll share a few encaptivating tales.'

name: Moonlit Veil
desc: Fatigue was nonexistent on Matina's face, her eyes glimmering as she spoke with an affectionate smile.

name: Nocturnal Rhythm - Rose
desc: It was a long time ago,' she said, 'a fortune teller told me that I should stay away from music for my own good.'

name: Euphoric Rhythm - Rose
desc: I did not believe her. To prove her wrong, I began to sing in her shack. Gave her quite a scare.'

name: Silent Cosmos - Rose
desc: I sang with my heart. I didn't care whether it was going to bring me misfortune. I wasn't scared one bit.'

name: Glowing Star - Rose
desc: I told her that music has brought me joy my entire life. That's why I will never give up singing!'

name: Midnight Melody - Rose
desc: Matina smiled confidently. 'I am the performer of my own life, after all. Only I define its magnificence.'

name: Moonlit Veil - Rose
desc: Little did I know, my song attracted a lot of guests to the shack. I ended up making quite a pretty penny that day.'

name: Nocturnal Rhythm - Fragrant
desc: But the feeling didn't last,' Matina continued mysteriously, 'because I found a way. I returned to school.'

name: Euphoric Rhythm - Fragrant
desc: What?' Shock rang through the crowd as Matina explained the thick tree growing just outside her classroom window.

name: Silent Cosmos - Fragrant
desc: It started out well. The leaves were thick, and nobody noticed me hiding just outside the window.'

name: Glowing Star - Fragrant
desc: But that didn't last. One day, I fell from the cracked branch.' Matina continued.

name: Midnight Melody - Fragrant
desc: That's how my teacher found out about me. She paid for my treatment and let me back inside the classroom.'

name: Moonlit Veil - Fragrant
desc: Give me some snacks and a bottle of water and I could sit in a classroom learning for days.'

name: Fishy Contemplation
desc: Between leisurely pleasures, she would sneak a peek at the worshipers here to piously make their wish.

name: Calming Nonchalance
desc: The Fish Spirit believed that wishes were a sign of greed and true happiness is only gained by those with few needs.

name: Fateful Romance
desc: Excited, the Fish Spirit lined up. When she met the Stargazer, she learned that a tale of love was about to unfold.

name: Destiny's Beckon
desc: But she didn't want to be part of a love story. Yet, the stargazer smiled and told her that fate cannot be defied.

name: Fishy Contemplation - Crimson
desc: One day, the tranquility of the temple was broken by thieves, who laid their eyes on the beautiful carp.

name: Calming Nonchalance - Crimson
desc: Just as the Fish Spirit pondered, the bamboo on the bank lashed out and struck the thieves.

name: Fateful Romance - Crimson
desc: Pleased with the outcome, the Fish Spirit stared at the bamboo as a realization struck her.

name: Destiny's Beckon - Crimson
desc: The bamboo shifted slightly before taking up the shape of a person. The Fish Spirit smiled. Fate was one step ahead.

name: Fishy Contemplation - Cerulean
desc: She almost tripped and fell until someone saved her, the pleasant smell of bamboo drifting into her nose.

name: Calming Nonchalance - Cerulean
desc: The Fish Spirit thanked her savior. The young man nodded as he shook a fan with bamboo drawn across it.

name: Fateful Romance - Cerulean
desc: The dog said that meeting a person repeatedly is fate at work. This was the third time that their paths had crossed.

name: Destiny's Beckon - Cerulean
desc: The young man yielded the candy to her. Watching him leave, she quickly blushed and ran off with the sugar painting.

name: Auspicious Clouds
desc: People admire the plum blossoms while drinking tea. They invite Kiri to join them, but she smiles and then leaves.

name: Charm Earring
desc: She strokes the plum blossoms and plucks petals from the branches—she's going to make honey plums for the festival.

name: First Snow
desc: When dusk falls, Kiri has a full basket of petals. She waves goodbye to the others and sets off on her way home.

name: Eternal Prosperity
desc: Kiri is also a famous cook in the town: the unique flavor of her rice cakes and cookies is her trademark.

name: Abundant Blessings
desc: She makes pastries for her friends every year and also receives the best cuisine and scented pouches in return.

name: Fragrance Hall
desc: The townsfolk love sharing things with each other, and a joyful mood has filled up the air across the town.

name: Festive Scents
desc: Smoke rises from the town. As soon as Kiri arrives, she's engulfed by the smell of pork and fish...

name: Longing Vignettes
desc: The girl told Jin Meng that she was leaving soon. Jin Meng expressed regret that she had yet to prepare a present.

name: Spring of Wonders
desc: She told Jin Meng that meeting her was the best present she could ever receive.

name: Carp of Fortune
desc: It was the holidays again as Jin Meng and the girl walked hand in hand, just like the first time they met.

name: Glimmering Opulence
desc: To repay her, she cast a spell and turned all the rice in her house into glittering gold.

name: Auspicious Wisdom
desc: At the moment of farewell, Jin Meng gave the girl her prized goldfish pendant and decided to continue her training.

name: Sunset's Veil
desc: When the young girl discovered the gold, she bowed to the sky and vowed to share this gift with the less fortunate.

name: United Perseverance
desc: The girl was soon appointed as Sikong, praised and loved for her diligence and devotion to the people.

name: Joyous Reminiscence
desc: Jin Meng gasped, she revealed herself and explained what had happened, to which the girl only smiled faintly.

name: Ebbing Ripples
desc: It's said when a carp grows to a century old, it will be able to morph into a human. Jin Meng was such a curious carp.

name: Sylvan Rhythm
desc: The girl wanted to be a minister and help the people. Despite being friends, Jin Meng did not know how to repay her.

name: Current Tracing
desc: Jin Meng did not leave. She made up an excuse so she could stay by her side and find out her true aspirations.

name: Night of Solace
desc: As she handed her present to him, she suddenly noticed a beautiful hairpin lying in his palm.

name: Night of Joy
desc: As she walked toward the old bridge under the beautiful fireworks, she saw his figure walking slowly toward her.

name: Blissful Chant
desc: As dawn neared and the crowd thinned, she said her farewells to him beside the bridge where they first met.

name: Preordained Fate
desc: It was a new year, and Long Street was decorated anew. This year, she was determined to tell him her true feelings.

name: Emerald Verdure
desc: She would often remember that night as the exchanges in letters between him and her became increasingly frequent.

name: Distant Reminiscence
desc: She would place her tender thoughts into each gift, careful to not reveal too much affection in each one.

name: Gilded Brilliance
desc: Goddess flickered her hand, in a mere instant, they were both thousands of miles away.

name: Baroque Lantern
desc: She traveled with Goddess, her amazement turning into disarray as she witnessed the desolation across the land.

name: Misty Lotus
desc: She approached Goddess, only to be stunned by the beautiful jade pedestal she was sitting on.

name: Undying Light at Night
desc: Goddess grinned, tapping her on the forehead. Instantly, she levitated as if a weight was removed from her body.

name: White Phoenix
desc: Is this real?' She nodded. 'I want to help them.' Her voice trembling with emotions.

name: Spinning Plumes
desc: You should do something. I know you can.' Goddess stroked her hair gently. 'Come. We should head back.'

name: Sparrow's Shadow
desc: Back in the capital, it was a different scene. The city was shining opulently, as if no suffering ever existed.

name: Radiant Pearl
desc: She stared at the most opulent building inside the palace and asked Goddess who lived there.

name: Divine Omnipotence
desc: Goddess stared at her, asking who she thinks could live in a place more extravagant than the emperor's own residence.

name: Radiant Extravagance
desc: She suddenly felt a rush of air brushing past her as she closed her eyes to the nauseating sensation.

name: Silent Radiance
desc: As she went to bed, something weighed on her heavily. She knew she had to do something.

name: Cosmic Splendor
desc: Cosette was determined to swim against the current and make a name for herself in this city.

name: Brilliant Beyond
desc: Starnight Hotel was Cosette's great work. Today was its grand opening, and every famous name was going to be there.

name: Lustrous Trail
desc: She lived by the creed 'Go out, walk forward.' She started as a mere waiter and slowly accumulated her success.

name: Night City
desc: Many years ago, Cosette was just a farm girl. Yet unlike her peers, she harbored great ambitions and a big dream.

name: Radiant Chrome
desc: There are many girls just like Cosette in the city. They became friends in life and partners in their pursuits.

name: Silent Tide
desc: Cosette had a shrewd business mind. Despite the hardships, she built one of the most successful brands in the city.

name: Effulgent Year
desc: Cosette's affluent friends came to congratulate her, each a testament and success story in their pursuit of dreams.

name: Nightly Stars
desc: The road to success is often paved with failures. The perseverance burning in Cosette was unyielding.

name: Paean to Time
desc: Standing at the summit of success, Cosette's eyes shimmered slightly as she gazed resolutely into the distance.

name: Eternal Chapter
desc: There are many women who came to this city in search of success, and Cosette was the most known out of them all.

name: Radiant Altar
desc: People dared not look into those resolute eyes under the crown, nor stare into the burnt skin underneath those robes.

name: Sorrowless Crown
desc: Pain and suffering often go hand in hand. When the king died, Serena became the one to shoulder the burden of war.

name: Glacial Identity
desc: Dauntless, her bravery exceeded even that of her father. Yet even such high praises did not move Serena one bit.

name: Northern Prophecy
desc: Serena still remembers the day her father died. It was a quiet evening, a flock of ravens were flying across the sky.

name: Overwhelming Might
desc: That night, Serena charged into the enemy's ranks and ignited the enemy's banner into a fireball of light.

name: Medal of Fire
desc: Serena charged with unmatched ferocity, her might seemingly unstoppable as swung her blade.

name: Badge of Thunder
desc: As the arrow pierced the heart of the enemy's general, so did Serena's name echo through countless ears and hearts.

name: Sun's Descent
desc: The enemy fell back. The once invincible seemingly melted away as Serene unleashed an arrow filled with vengeance.

name: Crimson Ember
desc: Some say a cold throne can only be warmed by a compassionate heart beating for the people.

name: Burning Resilience
desc: As Serena ascended the altar, the priest bestowed her father's scepter of power solemnly into her waiting grasp.

name: In Her Name
desc: As Serena's just crusade gained fame, many factions sought to ally themselves with Queen Serena.

name: Supreme Protection
desc: Even as the struggle for power raged on in the North Kingdom, Serena's sword will always fight for peace and justice.

name: Verdant Gleam
desc: When war was waged, she helped to quell the strife and restore peace. Cheers echoed throughout the land.

name: Ominous Sign
desc: As the pandemic loomed, she dispersed people's fear and grew herbs in their soil, bringing forth hope.

name: Plume Hat
desc: During the Light festivals, people hold grand parades and sing prayers in the bells. She, too, blends into the crowd.

name: Slumber Veil
desc: Those who trace her steps would seek the darkness; for she always stays with those in need and fosters hope in them.

name: Dark Messenger
desc: Blackbirds are usually ominous, but for the blessed, birds with green feathers from the darkness are a strand of hope.

name: Dawn of Tomorrow
desc: No matter the hardship, always remember that the darkest nights always prelude the brightest dawn.

name: Echoing Sea
desc: The idyllic tunes seemed to slow the passage of time as they danced elegantly in a sea of wondrous dreams.

name: Seaside Adventure
desc: Swimming into the glimmering light and guided by the cerise whale, reaching for the bright and brilliant beyond.

name: Dream's Embark
desc: Once she had made a decision, Cosette would see it through, no matter how tempting any alternatives may seem.

name: Mystic Dream
desc: The glimmering stars and the dashing neon lights quietly shone for the girl who turned nothing into everything.

name: Chapter of Destiny
desc: The stars beckoned toward the future and the past as the chapters of fate unfolded under a starry sky.

name: Special Gift
desc: This bag takes inspiration from a gift bag. The classic colors mixed in with a dash of red fit it perfectly.

name: Poetic Elegance
desc: Despite only releasing for a week, the new fan from the Apple Apparel Group has made it the latest fashion hit.

name: Velvet Bunny
desc: Her arrival drove away Cintra's solitude. Unlike Cintra, her cousin was a carefree flower, blooming in vibrance.

name: Graceful Elegance
desc: She took Cintra to a cherry grove, where they found an injured rabbit, likely abandoned by its owner.

name: Heartwarming Secret
desc: They patched up the rabbit before hiding it inside her cousin's room. For Cintra, it was a wish come true.

name: Wishful Future
desc: When she left, her cousin told Cintra that the friendship and courage the little rabbit signified would never fade.

name: Velvet Fun
desc: Unwilling to separate the puppies, Ira handed Chinchel some persimmon treats as he quietly thanked her.

name: Trail of Hearts
desc: Surprised by his courtesy, she turned to see his cheeks blush. She quickly turned away, blushing slightly.

name: Auspicious Occurrence
desc: Hearing a bark, Nini ran to the sound. Turned out Chinchel brought back a dog. The two of them instantly got along.

name: Chasing Laughter
desc: If Ira pretended not to hear, a pebble would land squarely beside her foot, giving her a startle each time.

name: Longing Solitude
desc: Ira would often enjoy the evening sitting in the yard. Chinchel would often use this chance to call out her name.

name: Youthful Love
desc: The two would pull tricks and pranks between each other, slowly growing up with no clear winner.

name: Ebbing Heartstrings
desc: He's not my best friend. He's a troublemaker!' Chinchel froze uncharacteristically at the sound of Ira's words.

name: Unspoken Feelings
desc: Chinchel slowly became reserved and began to avoid Ira, as if trying to hide something from her.

name: Gentle Warmth
desc: Ira's mother delegated persimmon treats to her again this year. Hesitant, Ira still left the house with Nini.

name: Long Street Persimmon
desc: Nini always walked in the front, and her loving nature won the hearts of everyone in the neighborhood.

name: Happy Trick
desc: Stay wise, use your creativity and enjoy the festival! Forget about your worries and spread laughter across the world.

name: Faraway Longing

name: Prismatic Love
desc: He'd tell Kiri his next destination so she could write back, sharing fun stories and views.

name: Special Sincerity
desc: Every postcard seemed like a bridge between them, and Kiri now looked forward to receiving her own letters.

name: Endearing Vow
desc: Kiri had to run her shop and the photographer continued his journey, but postcards became a bond between them.

name: Reminiscent Time
desc: The young man would send postcards with travel logs or photos, all of which Kiri treasured with heart.

name: Fond Echo
desc: A new letter's here.' Kiri heard a knock and looked up to see the man holding a postcard with a bright smile.

name: Wood Fairy

name: Tree of Dreams
desc: Abby smiled as she read the poems from the past.  Basking in the warm afternoon sun, she began to feel drowsy.

name: Graceful Petals
desc: When she and Tara were young, they built a secret tree house that none of the adults knew about.

name: Sunny Aria
desc: Even after Tara moved, Abby would still sometimes come here by herself and spend the night under the stars.

desc: Abby squeezed into the tree house as wind flipped through the pages of slightly yellow pages of a poetry book.

name: Special Companion

name: Misty Umbrella

desc: A student of her father's had exceptional talent. He could always think of the most beautiful rhyme on the spot.

name: Blossom Mirage
desc: The students exchanged looks when they saw Shuangyi. Though the young man didn't look back, his ears had reddened.

desc: Shuangyi picked a peach blossom as a hair accessory that filled the grove with aroma, ready to compose a poem.

desc: Shuangyi quickly turned away and left before her father could scold her. He was very strict in class, after all.

desc: The young man never gained any titles but left famed poems and paintings, of which Shuangyi was always the subject.

desc: Generations of hatred might have put a wall between them, but couldn't stop the pull they felt.

name: Starlit Meadow
desc: The buoyant songs stopped and the young man lowered his hand as the fairies' chattering sound came closer.

desc: She waited for the night, listening to the footsteps of patrolling fairies, and believed Eric would keep his promise.

desc: She hoped that Eric didn't keep his promise and moved into the Shadow City, instead of being killed by a cold arrow.

name: Trace of Promise

desc: The next day, Cloudria rowed out again to look for the man, but he had already set out on his way home.

name: Sunward Relish

name: Honey Torsade

desc: In a brilliant show, the glory isn't just for the lead; every honeybee deserves the audience's applause and cheers.

name: Starlight Shimmer

name: Circle of Winds

name: Moonlit Crown

name: Crystalline Sound

name: Dream-chaser Wing
desc: The moonlight shone on the puppet for the unique solo performance. Andrea felt her eyes brimming with tears.

name: Creative Vision

name: Fledgling Dream

name: Jovial Concerto

name: Consonant Echo

name: Sparkling Song

name: Fluttering Rhythm

name: Daylight Melody
desc: An all-new attempt and a different song. The conductor forgot all disappointments and immersed himself in music.

name: Splendid Plume
desc: Surprisingly, the boy had rabbit ears. He spoke sheepishly and asked the girl about her thoughts on the gallery.

name: Breezy Dream
desc: The girl praised the gallery, saying that she had felt as if on a special journey since she walked in.

name: Serene Fantasy

name: Rabbit Mask
desc: A painting of a beautiful rose hedge was hanging on the wall beside them. The gate was open, beckoning them inside.

desc: In a golden light, she put her hand in his and closed her eyes. Together they stepped into a world of wonder.

name: Springtime Overture
desc: Everything she saw felt extremely familiar, as though she had experienced it all a long time ago.

desc: The moment she picked up her paintbrush, it felt alive and naturally recreated every wonder in this world on canvas.

name: Breezy Dream - Poem
desc: The garden, tea party, and animals were all worth painting, but only the Hedge of Roses eventually showed on paper.

name: Serene Fantasy - Poem
desc: It is our secret. Maybe...' the girl blinked and flashed a smile, '...we'd meet again here one day!'

name: Rabbit Mask - Poem
desc: After a dizzy spin, the girl and the boy were back in the gallery. The gate in the painting was closed again.

name: Springtime Prelude - Poem
desc: The boy wasn't human. Perhaps he had waited for countless springs for this eventual reunion.

name: Springtime Overture - Poem

name: Natural Tunes

name: Floral Festival
desc: Under the twinkling stars, people lit the bonfire, sending sparks and brightening every smile around.

name: Vivid Spring
desc: People would dress up like wild animals for the festival and share the bright and warm spring with cute animals.

name: Hopeful Longing
desc: In songs and sounds of laughter, friends would hold her hand, telling her their beautiful hope for the future.

name: Pastel Green
desc: Budding grasses kissed her naked ankles, as the wind caressed the hem of her dress, inviting her to a dance.

name: Vernal Embrace
desc: She danced holding hands with her friends, their songs and laughter the loveliest sounds of spring.

name: Spring Sweetness
desc: In the shade of a tree, she took a bite of the flower cake, feeling the sweetness of spring between her teeth.

name: Spring Inebriation

desc: Filda gripped the coin as water gushed in. If she was to die on the ship, at least let her bid farewell to Lofn.

desc: The coin let out a soft glow as she was losing consciousness. Again she heard a mermaid's gentle and comforting song.

name: Tender Cuddle
desc: O Jolly Times was sung softly in the storm, and each note in the cheerful tune felt full of power.

name: Lazy Dreams
desc: Sorry, but this will be our last lesson. Dear Filda, I'm glad to have met you and you'll always be in my heart.'

name: Miraculous Reunion
desc: Filda fell asleep in a numbing warmth. It was Lofn's love and blessing, saving her across time and space.

name: Seaward Cruise

name: Kindred Spirits
desc: Lofn and Filda shared everything with each other, their hearts growing closer even if they had never met.

name: Ethereal Tune

name: Merry Moments
desc: Lofn would flap her tail hearing Filda's jokes and then hope she could splash water on Filda's face in retaliation.

name: Billowing Dance
desc: Filda practiced swordsmanship to protect her crew, and when asked, Lofn proudly said she had powerful magic.

name: Gleeful Scales
desc: The first time they talked, Lofn knew there was not only space between Filda and her, but a great amount of time.

name: Inseparable Dream
desc: Lofn was also interested in the treasures from Filda's hunts and hoped to join her squad if possible.

name: Sterling Heart

name: Silent Rainfall
desc: Lofn felt an endless source of power overflowing, her face pale as she almost lost her grip on the coin.

name: Sunken Treasure
desc: Lofn decided to teach Filda the song, but the captain would sing out of tune and try to brush it off with jokes.

name: Everlasting Hope
desc: Our time together will forever be in my heart. May sunny days and cozy wind be with you on every voyage.

name: Seal of Time

name: Blossom of Dreams

desc: Prairie never made her grandma worry. She would hurry home at sunset, humming a cheerful song slightly out of tune.

desc: Lofn worried when she heard Filda's ship was caught in a storm. Filda commanded her crew while gripping the coin.

desc: Did you get lost? Purin petted the deer, but it was too scared to say anything and only shuddered in her arms.

name: Woodland Wonder
desc: Purin pressed her forehead against the deer's head to listen to its heart. Please, tell me what happened.

desc: She'd sometimes recall that dance when she sat under twinkling stars, fantasizing about a more magical time.

name: Zephyr Guardian
desc: Even though she can't travel, Fauna never feels lonely, for she has a garden and flowers to talk to.

name: Tender Feeling - Wind
desc: Fauna, thank you for caring for the flowers and sharing the delicious pollen. You can have my power of flying.'

name: Rosebud Feeling - Wind
desc: As the fairy held Fauna's hands, she felt warmth flowing into her palms and suddenly grew a pair of butterfly wings.

name: Fragrant Comfort - Wind
desc: Fauna broke free from her illness. She could now soar under the azure sky, exploring places that she had dreamed of.

name: Zephyr Guardian - Wind
desc: Fauna shares her journeys with the flowers every time she returns, while the blossoms dance in the wind in response.

name: Entwined Snake
desc: The witch touched the petals with a sigh, 'Courage and fear are inseparable. They give rise to each other.'

name: Innocent Gaze
desc: Covered eyes see not the present, but the past and future. However, not everyone sees the truth in the witch's eyes.

name: Shackles of Love
desc: With courage, fear follows. Only a tempered mind and body learn how to live with pain and suffering.'

name: Scarlet Cycle
desc: The witch watched as the hero regained his determination and left. He would not stop here despite the twists of fate.

name: Sacrificial Love
desc: As roses stretched the petals, the witch walked among them with the hero's sword, humming an ancient tune.

name: Fate Epilogue
desc: On the December Troupe's stage, the curtains drew and the witch took her bow, basking in the standing ovation.

name: Oath of Finality
desc: The witch is everywhere and nowhere. The gate only opens if you are willing to sacrifice what you cherish the most.

name: Chapter of Grace
desc: The sword was bloodthirsty in nature. Its blade destroyed all that it touched, slaying souls in the ancient kingdoms.

name: Gilded Splendor
desc: To subdue the roaming sword, the two kingdoms' empress and general negotiated peace and set up an altar together.

name: Bygone Ballad
desc: The war spread to even the trade routes, reducing all to ruins and staining the grounds with blood.

name: Graceful Hymn
desc: The kingdoms prayed together. As the sky cleared, a goddess descended from the clouds in ethereal garments.

name: Lingering Tune
desc: As the song ended, the goddess sheathed the sword without being harmed and quietly rode the cloud away.

name: Sword of Lotus
desc: Only the sword was left behind and turned into a pure lotus as the crowd watched, all the malice gone with the wind.

name: Snowfall Gale
desc: All were in panic when the sword arrived, but the goddess danced with her blade, landing graceful yet mighty strikes.

name: Radiant Feather
desc: Light and dark are two sides of the same coin. Born in darkness, Ernis symbolizes arrogance and chaos.

name: Calamity's Shadow
desc: Lurking in shadows, Ernis learned the law of the time, while darkness taught her deception, betrayal and temptation.

name: Lightward Feather
desc: Drawn toward Sully's light, Ernis kept destroying the world protected by wisdom and hope.

name: Sinful Feather
desc: Without sunlight and water, plants withered, leaves drooping and petals fading in lifeless stillness.

name: Nocturnal Gleam
desc: Ernis lurked in shadows where Goddess Sully couldn't see—darkness spread insidiously across the land.

name: Aureate Admonition
desc: A strange disease spread among the animals. They grew agitated or slept all day, no longer roaming the land with joy.

name: Wings of Confession
desc: Ernis inflamed the greed and hate in humans, sparking endless plunder and wars that raged across the land.

name: Shackled Heart
desc: Ernis fueled arrogance and rage and planted seeds of doubt in humans, trapping them in an endless cycle of revenge.

name: Sword of Peace
desc: Sully felt responsible for the tragedies, but her dwindling light left her too weak to fight Ernis alone.

name: Light of Enlightenment
desc: Sully heard faint prayers from humans who hadn't lost reason, wishing to repel darkness and rekindle hope.

name: Chaos Origin
desc: Ernis made humans slothful, so they neglected work and farming while famine and chaos prevailed.

name: Chanting Praise
desc: Sully's blade shone again as a familiar force filled her—human faith had reignited her dwindling hope.

name: Enigmatic Breath
desc: Noah seldom dreamed, but when he did, he felt wrapped in flowing chaos—warm, safe, and strangely familiar, like home.

name: Chapter of Doom
desc: He kept playing even after the last note dropped, lost in the nameless melody echoing in his mind.

name: Immersive Silence
desc: During a tour meeting, Noah guessed each member's thoughts before yawning and passing by without a word.

name: Endless Rhythm
desc: He filled every note in the roulades and staccato with emotions, as the piano lid shuddered with his movement.

name: Somber Curtain
desc: Behind the dusty curtains were covered statues. In the moonlight, he saw dust in the air and vague contours.

name: Praise of Thorns
desc: Vines crawled through stained glass cracks. Noah reached out, nearly pricking his hand on a sharp thorn.

name: Lotus of Rebirth
desc: Surprised by the piano's unique tone, he placed both hands on the keys and played the suite from the Troupe.

name: Silent Echo
desc: Dust covered the choir's old piano. Squinting, he struggled to read the faded sheet music on its yellowed pages.

name: Midnight Aroma
desc: Silence returned as the wind blew through the ajar gate, scattering rose petals across the fallboard.

name: Crimson Dance
desc: In the confession room, he switched between the roles of priest and penitent, curtains brushing against his face.

name: Nocturnal Treasure
desc: It seemed to be a very unique matter that would change its form between liquid, gas, and solid.

name: Lost Memories
desc: Charlene finally knew what beckoned her here—a widespread force had awakened the Nether Lord's Sigh.

name: Bygone Era
desc: It was a divine relic that contained incredible unknown energy, which must be sealed as no one knew how to use it.

name: Memory Seal
desc: As colors shifted, shimmering lights sparkled within before fading, mesmerizing like a fleeting dream.

name: Lost in Fate
desc: The Keeper is the guard and warden of the collections, so Charlene prefers being called the Collector instead.

name: Cursed Plume
desc: The night sky resembled an iridescent mirage, as dazzling hues gathered and formed luminous nebulas.

name: Golden Echo
desc: Behind the heavy door lay a penthouse with a glass dome and an exquisite, semi-circular balcony.

name: Unsolved Lie
desc: In the soft light, the collection room was spotless, its floor polished and mirror-like.

name: Forgotten Glory
desc: A glazed bottle lay there, the colors changing inside: from scarlet to indigo, from brilliant gold to midnight dark.

name: Ruthless Truth
desc: As Charlene stepped in, the door slowly closed. She walked to the center and scrutinized the black velvet box there.

name: Scepter of Order
desc: The Phantom Thieves had speculations about its changing color, but none of their theories had been tested.

name: Lasting Yearning
desc: One day, Lily told Ayla that the man who ended the continental war would come to the school for a speech.

name: Casket of Yore
desc: Lily took Ayla home, dressed her, and taught her culture, art and formalities. Ayla became Lily's best friend.

name: Chapter of Love
desc: They'd have morning walks in the garden and then afternoon tea, enjoy literature and music at dusk, and cuddled at night.

name: Innocent Fantasy
desc: Late to the speech, Lily climbed onto a tree and sat there gazing at the man surrounded by the crowd from afar.

name: Whisper of Dawn
desc: Born in war, Lily had a tragic childhood where she lost her family one by one. Peace had always been her dream.

name: Rejoicing Ballad
desc: Lily told Ayla that she met the man on campus. Unlike his serious look on paper, he seemed more like an artist.

name: Farland Zephyr
desc: Ayla didn't understand anything, let alone love. Even Lily's existence seemed more like a master to her.

name: Close Confidante
desc: Things didn't last long after Lily's wedding. She started dozing off for no reason, and no cure was found.

name: Floral Repose
desc: Respect and admiration—feelings that she couldn't put a name on grew. Lily told Ayla that she had fallen in love.

name: Romantic Flutter
desc: The adorable creatures flapped their wings, disappearing at the edge of the woods and carrying Winnie's wishes afar.

name: Strings of Past
desc: Peace prevailed in a song of triumph. Plants thrived and withered in the flow of time, but the song never changed.

name: Emerald Vitality
desc: Budding flowers swayed in the wind, feeling Winnie's sorrow and keeping her company on the lonely nights.

name: Reunion Promise
desc: Winnie and her love met under the tallest cedar in the woods. It was also where they promised to reunite.

name: Vivid Whisper
desc: The warmth in the song melted the snow. Winnie plucked the strings, guiding her love to the cedar of their promise.

name: Aeriel Breeze
desc: Snow covers everything in the winter, except for one evergreen cedar where the fairy Winnie sits at the top.

name: Iridescent Oath
desc: Winnie couldn't leave the forest. In the soothing tune, they promised to meet again under the cedar tree.

name: Glimmering Wings
desc: Winnie watched her love leave and shed no tears. She stepped back into the woods, believing her love would return.

name: Iridescent Wings
desc: No more songs could be heard in the woods, but the cedar still stood tall in the forest, guiding every lost soul.

name: Strings of Yore
desc: When travelers got lost in the woods, a distant yet pleasing song would miraculously guide them out.

name: Heroic Protection
desc: Perseverance and wisdom endure through disasters, guiding hopeful souls back toward the light.

name: Dream Loop
desc: As lights twinkled in the cheerful music, the carousel horses morphed into fantastical shapes in the uncanny dream.

name: Box of Mirage
desc: A lot of items can be produced from other magic boxes, but only this one can be used to fetch anything you want.

name: Chrono Record
desc: There is a special record player in the December Troupe that, when played, only produces a blooming rose.

name: Celestial Crane
desc: On his return, the young man looked for the girl on the hills, but even the house was nowhere to be seen.

name: Phoenix Embroidery
