desc: The next morning, the young man was ready to leave for his exams and agreed to visit her again on his return.

name: Hazy Days
desc: He got lost in the dark, not sure if he was in the right place, and had to leave reluctantly.

name: Everlasting Brocade
desc: Inside the house was an exquisite loom with a half-weaved piece of cloth in gorgeous colors and patterns.

name: Embellished Grace
desc: Years later, another traveling student fell from the hillside and couldn't move due to the injury.

name: Frigid Mist
desc: A girl came to his aid and brought him back where she lived. The medicine she used miraculously healed his wound.

name: Ambrosial Silk
desc: The student was curious why she loomed alone here. The cloth she weaved could be sold for a fortune in the capital.

name: Bloodstained Tear
desc: The girl chuckled, saying the cloth wasn't for sale. It was the afterglow she'd woven to hang in the sky tomorrow.

name: Jadestone Haze
desc: The student was astounded. The girl continued, saying he resembled someone she'd met before who never returned.

name: Encounter of Amore
desc: Brocade Clouds is a classic opera in the Cloud that tells the story of a human's encounter with a goddess of brocade.

name: Veiled Melody
desc: The tune lifted Ayesha up like gentle hands. It was her haven, inspiring her in moments of weakness.

name: Visions of Yore
desc: Jafar talked with Ayesha under the starry sky. They just met each other and already felt like old friends.

name: Stellar Nocturne
desc: Jafar saw Ayesha off when the troupe left the tribe. They promised to meet again under the stars.

name: Memory Recall
desc: The song reminded Jafar of her mother, bringing tears to her eyes. Then she saw the same glint in her father's eyes.

name: Sound of Solace
desc: Jafar asked about the song after the banquet, and Ayesha told her the truth: Jafar's mother sang it to her.

name: Melancholic Daze
desc: Jafar's father apologized to Ayesha and invited the troupe to a banquet. Still bewildered, Jafar joined the banquet.

name: Sonorous Affection
desc: As the song turned to a gentle lilt, Jafar was surprised to recognize it as the very tune her mother used to hum.

name: Banquet Chord
desc: Cheery notes danced as Ayesha played. Unlike the other performances, the song sounded familiar to everyone there.

name: Dancing Rapture
desc: Momo can't wait to try out Nikki's gift. 'Go! Get over what stands in your way and finish all the grilled fish!'

name: Best Product
desc: It was finally time for the festival. Ambera's special brew captivated the customers with its sweet and rich flavor.

name: Special Ingenuity
desc: To give the beer a unique flavor, Ambera added orange peels and ginger to accentuate the malty and spicy smell.

name: Candied Gift
desc: A gingerbread vendor stopped Ambera while she sold her beer, handed her a gingerbread and wished her good luck.

name: Ornate Surprise
desc: Leave yesterday's worries behind on this jolly day! No matter what happens, we have the golden brew in our hands.

name: Bottoms Up
desc: Here's a toast! To the joyful and wonderful time you will spend on this grand festival!'

name: Wildland Sprout
desc: A song of joy breaks the silence of the wild. Travelers from faraway lands hum an ode to life.

name: Dearest Companion
desc: Whenever they rehearsed their songs, the camels swayed to the music as if they understood the lyrics.

name: Untethered Sand
desc: The wild wind blew up sand, covering the troupe's footprints and leaving no trace. Such is the power of nature.

name: Silken Twirls
desc: When Ayesha returned home, Princess Jafar came, asking the troupe to perform a song that met her standards.

name: Olden Memories
desc: Ayesha gazed into Jafar's eyes and remembered a song that had never been played, written by the chieftain's wife.

name: Gilded Emerald
desc: The confrontation was put to an end by the chieftain. He stopped Princess Jafar and treated the troupe to a feast.

name: Pellucid Strings
desc: The audience was enraptured by the tune Ayesha played. Jafar came up and asked Ayesha where she learned the song.

name: Wishful Notes
desc: Ayesha didn't play the song for the banquet, but to console the princess like the chieftain's wife did for her.

name: Wildland Song
desc: The troupe visited many places in the desert, and people looked forward to their captivating performance.

name: Rejoicing Waltz
desc: Ayesha fetched her instrument when the banquet started. She had never played the tune from her memories in public.

name: Homeward Trek
desc: It was an ode to childhood, home and friendship for Ayesha that gave her the courage to chase her dreams.

name: Foregone Memory
desc: Beneath the stars, they talk on and on, knowing that they'd become good friends without having to confirm.

name: Golden Banquet
desc: Ambera named the beer 'Orange Joy', for she wished that every guest at the festival could share the joy all day.

name: Flowering Basket
desc: Every morning, Shauna arranges flowers by the door while her friends, the playful kittens, chase butterflies nearby.

name: Weaved Spring
desc: She lets the kittens choose their favorite flowers from the garden; soon each one's got a vibrant flower crown.

name: Virescent Gate
desc: One day, a kitten returns with two friends hoping for Shauna's blessing. She happily crafts flower crowns for them.

name: Dewdrop Garden
desc: Shauna once thought she'd scared the kittens away, but before long, three little heads popped up on the garden wall.

name: Bouquet of Blooms
desc: The beauty is beyond words and reminds the kitten of the sunset glow and shining ripples on the lake.

name: Strings of Spring
desc: The kitten, enchanted by the flowers, finally asks, 'What are these?' Shauna looks around but sees no one.

name: Weave of Youth
desc: Seeing the kitten's eager nods, Shauna laughs and decides to crown the kitten with a floral wreath.

name: Foxy Spell
desc: Each flower carries a different blessing: some for longevity, others for purity, or for wealth,' explains Shauna.

name: Spring Frost
desc: Are you looking for me?' The kitten tugs at her skirt, 'I'm here!' Shauna soon realizes it's the kitten!

name: Graceful Bloom
desc: Pick flowers, match them, and place them on your head—there you have your hairpiece.' Shauna points at her head.

name: Peaceful Years
desc: We have different flowers for all seasons, but our good wishes stay the same.'

name: Foxy Enchantment
desc: Anyone passing by is drawn to the sight of a young girl wearing a floral crown, surrounded by playful figures.

name: Frigid Breath
desc: The fairy stays silent as a staff forms in her hand. Under the boy's gaze, frost slowly shifts into a delicate rose.

name: Glorious Coronet
desc: She understands what the boy seeks but knows all too well that in this frozen land, there's no rose blooming forever.

name: Dusk Snowfall
desc: She's always been in the snowfields as she remembers—until she found the boy unconscious at the edge of the tundra.

name: Frost Glimmer
desc: He comes for a legend, one that fairies could not comprehend.

name: Pristine Vow
desc: They walk together through icy lakes, deserted valleys, and snow-covered plains, but find nothing.

name: Frosted Rose
desc: Finally, the boy stops, a bitter smile on his face. 'There's no such rose, is there? Just a foolish fantasy.'

name: Splendor of Frost
desc: The fairy hands him the rose. 'There is. But you need a fairy's approval. Didn't your legend mention that?'

name: Promise of Frost
desc: Then the fairy falls into slumber and traces of the boy disappear in the snowfields. It's as if no one had ever come.

name: Astral Guide
desc: In the daytime, the girl leads the villagers in the early construction. At night, she goes over her plans alone.

name: Vivid Mind
desc: When the project is finally completed, the village chief offers her a reward. The girl smiles and shakes her head.

name: Radiant Path
desc: Though the drought in this village has been alleviated, others still suffer. She knows it's time to set off again.

name: Glowing Glimmer
desc: There is no one-size-fits-all solution to drought. She does research and crafts the best plan for each village.

name: Limpid Mirror
desc: Wherever she goes, clear streams nourish the earth and green shoots sprout from once barren lands.

name: Infinite Source
desc: The implementation is difficult but the people who have suffered from drought share her belief and work with her.

name: Spring of Aroma
desc: She proves the feasibility of her plan to the chief. In return, the chief gives her full support.

name: Foliage Whisper
desc: Coo, coo,' Glenna holds her breath, listening intently to the squirrel. 'Help, please help!' She understands it!

name: Lost in Dreams
desc: It turns out that the squirrel wandered out of the forest and got lost. 'Let me take you home!' Glenna volunteers.

name: Aromatic Embrace
desc: Here, here!' Two big squirrels come running. Glenna puts the little squirrel down and it runs toward its family.

name: Dream Captor
desc: As a river blocks Glenna's way, her basket magically grows larger, allowing her and the squirrel to float across.

name: Pasture Breeze
desc: Time flows quietly, and these bright scenes become cherished memories. She smiles and moves toward the future.

name: Feast of Delight
desc: Perhaps it's the wine, Darcey thinks. An idea crosses her mind: what if she brews wine from osmanthus flowers?

name: Heavenly Brew
desc: Darcey tries to brew it. But no matter how she alters the recipe, she can't quite capture that scent from her memory.

name: Rich Redolence
desc: Before she can fully smell, she wakes from her dream. But the rich, heavenly fragrance lingers in her mind.

name: Moonlit Drinking
desc: While drinking alone has its own charm, Darcey is still troubled by her failed brewing attempts.

name: Shadowy Elegance
desc: Darcey notices the reflection of the palace in her cup. A rabbit is gathering osmanthus flowers to brew wine.

name: Glass of Nectar
desc: Startled, Darcey looks up but only sees the moon. She looks down again, only to see an osmanthus petal in her wine.

name: Dream Chime
desc: In her dream, Anno is filled with unease as she can't find the little lamb however hard she searches.

name: Soft Companion
desc: As the sky lightens, the dream fades. Anno raises her staff to summon the sheep but finds one of them is missing.

name: Misty Search
desc: What dangers might the little lamb face without her? Anno waits for the night, the time feeling excruciatingly long.

name: Outside Visitor
desc: As a fairy shepherd, Anno rarely speaks to humans, yet when she reveals her identity, Rinya shows no surprise.

name: Dream Revisit
desc: When night falls, Anno quickly returns to her dream and finds the dreamer amidst golden fields of wheat.

name: Innocent Encounter
desc: The farm girl, brimming with energy, greets her warmly. She mentions seeing a lone lamb on the hillside in daytime.

name: Harmony of Chimes
desc: The little lamb somehow crossed over into the real world? Worried, Anno soon finds the answer through Rinya.

name: Spirit Radiance
desc: Seeing Anno's joyful face, Rinya smiles with relief. To express her gratitude, Anno decides to give her a gift.

name: Nature of Wonder
desc: As the dreamer's mood changes, the golden wheat fields give way to neatly planted fields and Rinya's small cottage.

name: Joy of Embrace
desc: Beyond the low fences, a joyful lamb runs toward Anno. She kneels and embraces the lamb tightly in relief.

name: Virtual Bond
desc: Song of the Windmill' mentions harvest and dreams, as well as a story of two girls bridging dreams and reality.

name: Dream Reunion
desc: Guiding her sheep, Anno continues to explore the dreamland. And she always sees Rinya waiting for her in the fields.

name: Fluffy Briquette
desc: Ah!' 'Meow-meow!' A lone traveler is startled by a cat and yells in surprise; the cat seems just as frightened.

name: Adorable Phantom
desc: A pitifully small ghost always dreams of proving itself but never musters the courage to do so.

name: Ambrosial Osmanthus
desc: A basket full of osmanthus flowers, as well as soft petals and adorable little rabbits, catches Momo's attention.

name: Windward Dance
desc: Anno looks anxious and Rinya reassures her. The lamb they found at the farm is actually a messenger of dreams.

name: Aureate Field
desc: The girl is Anno, a fairy shepherd who lives between reality and dreams. She lost one of her lambs here.

name: Fruity Harvest
desc: These lambs feed on dreams; without Anno's guidance, they might start eating people's dreams.

name: Song of the Windmill
desc: By the warm fire, Rinya falls into a sweet dream of a bountiful harvest, and a worried girl comes to her.

name: Heartfelt Will
desc: To put Anno at ease, Rinya focuses her thoughts. The wheat fields fade away, and the lamb's location appears.

name: Reunion Delight
desc: Seeing the lively lamb, Anno opens her arms. Rinya watches with relief, feeling the joy of something lost now found.

name: Wishing Windmill
desc: As the windmill turns, dreams turn into reality. Rinya thanks Anno for her kindness, waving goodbye.

name: Fervent Heart
desc: It was a simple favor, and Rinya didn't expect anything in return, but Anno insisted on giving her a mini windmill.

name: Aroma of Grains
desc: In 'Song of the Windmill', the genuine friendship between Rinya and Anno captivates the children the most.

name: Floral Fantasy
desc: Tying her hair up with a fluffy scrunchie, Ophelia hummed a new song and started to pick her bath bomb for today.

name: Elegant Dream
desc: Childhood dreams were fairytales that she could no longer return to, but Ophelia still wrote them into songs.

name: Silvermoon Lilt
desc: Mermaids had beautiful singing voices. Perhaps they would lean against reefs and sing gentle tunes under the moon.

name: Bubbly Waltz
desc: Ophelia once dreamed of being a mermaid or a cloud above the sky, turning dreams into rainbow-like bubbles.

name: Breezy Florescence
desc: Ophelia's dream bubbles would break with the first ray of light, as her mother woke her up from the rainbow dances.

name: Silken Lullaby
desc: Hayden wrote fairytales for the children of Lilith. Ophelia wanted the same, telling stories with songs of bubbles.

name: Duck's Song
desc: Ophelia named every duck swimming in the water. They would adventure in the sea of clouds and sing the Duck's Song.

name: Coral Seashell
desc: Ophelia's tattoo wasn't a siren's song or the mermaid's fairytale. It was just a symbol of her childhood dream.

name: Misty Fairytale
desc: Clouds had their personalities in the fairytale. Ophelia's favorite was the white cloud that played songs of nature.

name: Bubbly Cloud
desc: Ophelia used to pour half of a jar of bath salt to make bubbles and fantasize about swimming in fluffy clouds.

name: Fantasy Shower
desc: Prismatic bubbles would float out of the shower, dancing with Ophelia and lifting her to the kingdom of bubbles.

name: Jovial Peace
desc: For Ophelia, the happiest moment of the day was singing in the bathroom with the toy duck as her loyal audience.

name: Duck's Dream
desc: In Ophelia's cute dreams, she saw a special duck that would sway as bubbles floated up in front of her very eyes.

name: Guiding Light
desc: Having tried countless materials and watched them melt, Youell clenched her teeth and put the last one in place.

name: Spark of Genius
desc: Youell dreamed of waking up in the warmth of glowing bulbs, surrounded by fairies and fluorescent butterflies.

name: Spotless Gaze
desc: It's over.' the mother touched the girl's cheeks, 'Princess Youell's courage brought warmth and light to the night.'

name: Warm Shelter
desc: Youell's story filled her with courage. She listened to her mother's tales and explored the world with imagination.

name: Circle of Electricity
desc: Her mother kissed her tenderly, 'You will find endless power from the tales and search for your own undying light.'

name: Undying Hope
desc: The bulb shone on, brightening her eyes. All she could think of now was to share the eternal light with everyone.

name: Shivering Shimmer
desc: Having lost her sight, Youell could only be an adventurous princess in her mother's stories. 'Is it over?' she asked.

name: Energy Search
desc: The fairy made a bulb to brighten the island at night, but the heat of magic would melt any lighting materials.

name: Radiant Conversion
desc: The story came to an end, but Youell's adventure had just begun. Her world would be full of hope even in the dark.

name: Effulgent Glow
desc: The fairy said, 'If you can keep the darkness away at night on the island, you will be the princess here'

name: Fanciful Radiance
desc: The clever fairy of light twirled and woke up as the bulb glowed. Would she know how to become a princess?

name: Precious Sparkle
desc: Whenever new land is to be cultivated, the girl is always at the forefront and faces every challenge head-on.

name: Spring of Stars
desc: Wherever the young girl passes, life returns. The villages that suffered from drought are now teeming with life.

name: Midnight Invite
desc: The pumpkin soup was served, its aroma becoming richer. 'Perhaps.' Pepena took a sip and answered with a wink.

name: Candy Burglar
desc: In fact, the imps aren't as scary as they may sound, but they do have a habit of stealing candy on this night.

name: Impish Trick
desc: Pepena passed the imps with a basket of pumpkin candy, luring them to the outskirts with the aroma.

name: Foregone Shadow
desc: Shuji began cultivating a new peony species with rubescent petals and aureate filaments like a majestic lady.

name: Florid Garden
desc: To breed new species, Shuji traveled afar, discussing the characteristics of flowers with like-minded enthusiasts.

name: Flowering Splendor
desc: The new governor secretly levied heavy taxes and collected treasures and antiques from the people.

name: Virescent Leaves
desc: Shuji invited the governor to dinner and offered him two chests: one full of treasures, the other her new peonies.

name: Jade Luster
desc: Overjoyed, the governor took the chests and praised Shuji for her generosity, offering her a post in the government.

name: Brocade Veil
desc: The governor offered the chests to Prince Yong on his tour. The act aroused the prince's suspicion instead.

name: Nostalgic Vision
desc: Not sure where to begin, Prince Yong received evidence from Shuji proving the governor's corruption.

name: Blooming Grandeur
desc: The chest of peonies was hard evidence that only Shuji could breed them. It was Shuji's plan all along.

name: Devoted Guide
desc: After her grandma passed, she would gaze at the sky, imagining her grandma's voice. At least, she still has the cat.

name: Kitten Binoculars
desc: It all started from the day the cat brought a broken map to her. Fanara frowned, remembering her grandma's words.

name: Sparkling Gaze
desc: Grandma told her the map hid an important tale. Fanara followed its lines—until the trail simply vanished.

name: Mellow Fellow
desc: Fanara looked around and saw no other pieces of the map. The cat, however, discovered some fish cans.

name: Feline Companion
desc: Fanara gathered the map pieces and embarked on her journey across the desert and tundra to an ancient forest.

name: Carving of Notes
desc: Broken stone slabs here were carved with words of yores—rhymes and stories passed down through generations.

name: Path to Treasure
desc: The past was brought back to life. Fanara touched the engravings and felt as if her grandma was smiling at her.

name: Voyage Planning
desc: It didn't dissuade Fanara. She started going to libraries and visiting scholars for clues about the other map pieces.

name: Fluffy Wish
desc: The cat never left her side and warned her of danger. After an arduous journey, she arrived at an ancient building.

name: Stamps of Yore
desc: The post office is now back in business. Olitha rides on the country roads, sending letters of love from afar.

name: Lingering Years
desc: In the refurbished post office, Olitha now checks the post box daily and delivers letters to their destination.

name: Tender Echo
desc: Some asked her why she chose to manage an old post office. She only smiled, a hint of regret flashing in her eyes.

name: Distant Yearning
desc: Olitha learned her grandma's death at the age of 16, and a few days later, she received a letter from her hometown.

name: Wondrous Recount
desc: The letter was sent a few days before her grandma's death. The writings were filled with her longing for Olitha.

name: Bygone Causerie
desc: The development of the internet facilitated communication, but also left people behind in the past.

name: Framed Memory
desc: Tears blurred the handwriting as a gentle breeze brushed her hair. The letter reached her, but it was too late.

name: Harvest Promise
desc: By the long table filled with food, people cheer and toast to the harvest in the sound of laughter and singing.

name: Pastoral Aroma
desc: The crops bask in the golden twilight, as people return after a day's work with a heart full of hope.

name: Autumn Encounter
desc: Versha's shop is full of memories. The sewing machine is from her mother, and the couch used to be Grandma's seat.

name: Spiny Cuteness
desc: The hedgehogs are Versha's helpers. They move around the shop, bringing colorful balls of yarn to her feet.

name: Fairytale Blanket
desc: The carpets are handmade. Versha gathered fabric scraps and sewed them together according to color and pattern.

name: Mellow Moment
desc: Versha also furnished the shop with wooden window frames and a warm fireplace, making all customers feel at home.

name: Cluster of Dreams
desc: She spun wool into an elegant shape and dried the colorful flowers. Together they made a hat of beautiful wishes.

name: Ensemble of Roses
desc: Versha gave the hat to the boy for free and told him that he could always come back if the hat needed any repair.

name: Ribbon of Oath
desc: Versha would sometimes think of the boy and his mother and hope that the hat had brought them warmth and strength.

name: Weave of Affection
desc: Then the boy visited again and told Versha that his mother loved the hat. She was so happy and slowly recovering.

name: Fallen Warmth
desc: Versha's life returned to normal. Word of mouth brought her customers despite the remote location of the shop.

name: Tender Souvenir
desc: The perfect match of strawberry and chocolate makes it unique. A juicy, sweet strawberry wrapped in a bitter coating.

name: Sweetened Invite
desc: This is an invitation from the baker. Are you ready for the dessert party with cakes, biscuits and candy?

name: Serene Tune
desc: One by one, beautiful tunes filled the magnificent concert hall. She listened and immersed herself in music.

name: Patchwork Elegance
desc: It was a perfect birthday! The black-and-white pouch wasn't expensive, but it was still carefully chosen.

name: Brocade Pouch
desc: A wisp of scent ascends from the pouch to the moon; Loongs and phoenixes sing as cranes dance amidst the bloom.

name: Magic Collection
desc: When the cloud shrouded the moon, the witches in waiting silently flocked to the empty castle hall.

name: Astral Candlelight
desc: The darkness tried to stop her advance. As Morino raised her hand, a candle floated above, moving with her.

name: Gloom Cloister
desc: Along the endless corridor were closed doors. As the others vanished behind, Morino also pushed one open.

name: Lunar Enigma
desc: To pass the test, one must reach the highest terrace in time, but the path leading to it was different for everyone.

name: Twilight Encounter
desc: As doors opened and closed, Morino felt she was getting closer, but her eyes widened when the next door opened.

name: Promised Vision
desc: Morino solved the puzzle in the room with ease. The door opened again, revealing a flight of stairs leading up.

name: Bewitching Spell
desc: The girl in the room looked the same as her down to every detail. Morino frowned and chanted the strongest spell.

name: Delicate Dream
desc: The other Morino grinned and started chanting the same spell. Their voices overlapped into one in the empty room.

name: Spectral Gleam
desc: After a few rounds, the other Morino seemed unfazed, lifting her hem and greeting Morino with a smile.

name: Eternal Gaze
desc: Give up, Morino. Close your eyes and rest.' 'Give up? No... Never.' Morino whispered under her breath.

name: Law of Magic
desc: Unspeakable fear and confusion seized Morino's soul like a tightening vine, as tears and sweat dropped to the ground.

name: Midnight Tale
desc: The wind kissed her hair as she opened the door to the terrace. In front was a lantern, glowing quietly for her.

name: Spectral Mischief
desc: It's said mischievous specters hide in the book. Flip a page and they may jump out and bump your head.

name: Candlelit Terror
desc: Spider webs on the shelves. Eerie shadows on the wall. Quicken your steps and brace yourself for the adventure.

name: Quirky Honeypie
desc: What's that sound? Don't worry! It's the specter's surprise—put it on and you'll be the star of the night.

name: Guiding Glow
desc: On a gloomy night, Hetta was on her usual hunt and found a special specter in a hidden corner instead.

name: Splintered Vision
desc: Hetta didn't sense menace from the translucent girl. She floated in the air like a fading fog.

name: Ominous Horns
desc: The girl died not long ago. On her deathbed, she promised her young sister that she'd spend her birthday with her.

name: Silent Vestige
desc: The girl lingered, never harming a soul, so Hetta enveloped her in a bundle of energy to keep her from fading away.

name: Regretful Longing
desc: Disease eventually took her from her sister. She remained in spirit form, as she hadn't kept her promise.

name: Blade of Judgment
desc: The girl felt safe with Hetta despite her cold demeanor, as she protected her from evil spirits until the birthday.

name: Glazed Fragrance
desc: The garden darkens, while in an ill-lit alley, a velvet lavender lies in the children's palms, glowing ever brightly.

name: Redolent Trace
desc: Velvet lavenders have become exclusive to nobles, but even with attentive care, they rarely bloom in gardens.

name: Nocturnal Snow
desc: It's said that darkness once took over the world until a deity cast seeds of velvet lavenders that lit the dark.

name: Frosty Grace
desc: Nobles seek after the flower for its fragility, but others are skeptical, 'It lit the dark. How could it be fragile?'

name: Midnight Bloom
desc: The kids gathered in a lane, still mesmerized by the blooms. 'What's this?' Someone takes a bud off a girl's hair.

name: Rosy Entrapment
desc: The God of Sea created an unescapable illusion for Helena, forever trapping the young man in a beautiful cage.

name: Lucent Tears
desc: Helena realized she had fallen for him, but the man did not feel the same. Helena grew worried and smiled less.

name: Moonlit Seashell
desc: The young man weathered the storms. Helena saw light in his determined eyes that even the moon paled in comparison.

name: Swan's Grace
desc: Swans from afar spread their white wings to welcome the young man home, every feather shining the light of freedom.

name: Decadent Love
desc: Helena picked the brightest rose at dawn for the man and sang under the moon to express her love.

name: Thistles' Whisper
desc: But it couldn't change the man's heart. He grew ever more depressed until he turned into a dying swan.

name: Forlorn Saga
desc: Helena could feel the looming death. The swan's feathers lost their sheen, and those roses of love had long withered.

name: Lunar Shimmer
desc: She decided to tell the God of Sea to let him go. The illusion broke, and he could finally return to his kind.

name: Lament of Solitude
desc: Seafarers either wear white swan pendants for Helena's blessing or see it as a taboo, fearing they'd be lost at sea.

name: Seaside Slumber
desc: Helena stared for long after the swan left before turning back into the sea, never again returning to the shore.

name: Olden Squall
desc: The tides rise and fall in the constant flow of time. A wind from the past blows, carrying tales of yore.

name: Cirrus Adrift
desc: With new-found power, the ruthless god vented the anger within, ravaging the earth and planting seeds of horror.

name: Plumed Serenade
desc: He was born gentle and derived his power from people's joy, but in a devastated world, the joy was almost extinct.

name: Luxuriant Charm
desc: Lacking allies, Serra's brother lost and turned into a white peacock, robbed of his singing voice and colors.

name: Mortal Dreamscape
desc: The peacocks couldn't stand and watch despair take the world. Eventually, Serra's brother challenged the god.

name: Sunlit Lushness
desc: When all lives fell to despair, Serra stood up with determination in her eyes and challenged the god to a duel.

name: Jade Plumage
desc: Serra also gained power from pain, but unlike the god, she only felt sorrow instead of joy from her power.

name: Aureate Glamor
desc: Her connection with all lives filled her with power. After defeating the old god, Serra became the Goddess of Art.

name: Owl's Message
desc: Startled from sleep, she saw the owls arrive with a letter—the first she'd ever received from strangers.

name: Desolate Scent
desc: It was a letter from the humans! Ambelle opened the letter, relieved that her nightmares didn't come true.

name: Sylvan Rebirth
desc: Dear Goddess, without your guidance, we still follow your teachings. We learn, observe time, respect life...'

name: Ravaged Sanctum
desc: Ambelle fell asleep again and dreamed that humans were easily killed in disasters without strong bodies or wings.

name: Crowned Shadow
desc: It was a terrible winter, but we made it through. The kids were growing stronger, and none of us fell to the cold.'

name: Rustling Blooms
desc: A sage read the stars and predicted a disaster. We fought the flood and saved our food using what you taught us.'

name: Echoes of Green
desc: Ambelle was pleased. Humans might be weak, but they were determined to learn and protect their families.

name: Future Brilliance
desc: She was wise enough to understand the new language. In the last moments of her life, she decided to write them back.

name: Ephemeral Wonder
desc: Ambelle realized that the letters weren't her language but one created by humans themselves.

name: Dream Recall
desc: She chanted a spell, turning back time. The old carpenter no longer felt back pain and became nimble-handed again.

name: Chirping Chorus
desc: A mother came to sell furniture to treat her daughter's illness. The carpenter gifted her the watch and paid double.

name: Heart Toll
desc: If only I could turn back time and be young again, even if just for one day. Or am I doomed to not finish it?'

name: Fondness Echo
desc: The carpenter threw himself into his work and forgot time. When the sun rose again, an exquisite sculpture was born.

name: Earnest Support
desc: As the watch slowly opened, she saw the girl lying in bed, still trying to console her mother despite her illness.

name: Dream Murmur
desc: She overheard the girl talking in her sleep, 'If only I could be better sooner so that Mother would cry no more.'

name: Blissful Harmony
desc: As the watch hands turned, the girl recovered miraculously. When they hugged each other, she felt warm inside.

name: Chime Beyond
desc: The girl grew up and fell in love. Together they traveled the world and prepared to challenge a snow mountain.

name: Eternal Promise
desc: No longer trapped in the watch, she opened an antique shop of her own and offered help to anyone in trouble.

name: Free to Roam
desc: A sudden avalanche separated the girl and her lover, and the pocket watch swung violently in the backpack.

name: Symbiont Wings
desc: One sunny afternoon, a pocket watch clicked for the first time. She watched the newborn fairy with a hopeful smile.

name: Heartfelt Concern
desc: Hadia refused to let go of her grandpa's hands, fearing she'd lose him forever. He patted her head to reassure her.

name: Entwined Sentiment
desc: On Hadia's birthday, her grandpa gifted her a net with flowers that kept nightmares away and protected her in dreams.

name: Soul Blossom
desc: Grandpa made preparations for Hadia in the event of his death, but a terminal illness took Hadia away unexpectedly.

name: Lonesome Promise
desc: People bought flowers for the day of spirits. Grandpa packed them alone, as the flowery net swayed in the wind.

name: Sparkling Candle
desc: Hadia followed the flower petals and candlelight home. She only wished to gently touch her grandpa's hand.

name: Olden Cadence
desc: Spirits danced in the flickering light. Hadia waited for her grandpa to fall asleep: dreams would reunite them.

name: Reunion Dream
desc: She sneaked past the net and fell into her grandpa's dream. Overjoyed, she ran into his arms in a sea of flowers.

name: Grape Whispers
desc: The cheering crowd opens a sealed barrel as wine swashes inside. All the tiredness is washed away by the scent.

name: Rejoicing Chant
desc: The girls chat with the poet. 'Hope you're having a great time!' 'Of course. It's like a symphony of joy here!'

name: Emerald Shadow
desc: The poet takes a sip of wine and savors the sweet aftertaste. She decides to praise it in her new song.

name: Fruity Aroma
desc: Sweet jam bubbles in the pot while the aroma of the pumpkin pie fills the air, waiting to be served with fresh salad.

name: Ethereal Resplendence
desc: The emperor respected Shuji's choice and granted her treasures and the title: Master of Peonies.

name: Dewdrop Aroma
desc: It's said that when Shuji passed away, all the peonies bloomed. She is remembered as the Peony Goddess even now.

name: Tireless Toil
desc: The delicate bamboo hat shields the girl's face from the sun. The fine weave is a precious and lasting legacy.

name: Stormy Ambition
desc: The girl rests against a tree and hums again to the babble of the crook. It is a song dedicated to the land.

name: Sketch of Inspiration
desc: A special pen lies quietly on a stand. It is said to be most precious to Arianna and creates world-changing patterns.

name: Timeless Echo
desc: On the wall are newspaper clippings she gathered from sea monsters to floating cities—a fantasy world in her dreams.

name: Burgeoning Hope
desc: In her own design, Arianna twirls in a room full of mirrors, reflecting infinite possibilities with every step taken.

name: Pastel Motion
desc: A tap of the pen is a dancer's leap. Each motion is irreplaceable, freeze-framing the mix of reality and dream.

name: Epistle of Yore
desc: The desk is scattered with design drafts, each a sketch of a different world, demonstrating her unique vision.

name: Silent Timekeeper
desc: Arianna sometimes stares at the old clock late at night, letting her thoughts run wild through time for inspiration.

name: Crimson Nocturne
desc: On full-moon nights, the witch roams the thorny woods as ravens shriek warnings to keep wanderers away.

name: Thorny Nightmare
desc: The child's sob stilled the witch's anger. Even her low-brimmed hat couldn't hide the surprise on her face.

name: Birth of Terror
desc: Her hands, wrapped in black satin gloves, only brewed potions. Purple bubbles rose as the child watched.

name: Raven Wand
desc: Children's cry was the worst spell of all. The witch conjured up stars and singing ravens to cheer him up.

name: Fateful Bond
desc: Life had its unexpected interludes, and the witch shared a brief chapter of her long life with the innocent child.

name: Eternal Treasure
desc: The clumsy bear lost coins all over the fairyland. Nanaki busied around the park and filled her pouch with coins.

name: Stellar Balloon
desc: A starlit balloon tied with coins was stuck in a tree. Nanaki found it but was too small to reach the prize.

name: Soothing Solace
desc: Frustrated, Nanaki felt a fluffy paw on her shoulder. She turned around to see a cute bear mascot.

name: Childhood Gems
desc: Mr. Bear looked exactly the same as the one Nanaki wanted! He gave her a hug and put the coins in her palms.

name: Blooming Boon
desc: The kid who collected the most coins by sunset would win the special prize—a soft little toy bear.

name: Wilting Blossom
desc: Did you win the toy bear?' the curious reporter asked Nanaki, now the park's beloved manager.

name: Moonlit Nectar
desc: Nanaki faked a frustrated sigh, 'Unfortunately, I didn't win the game, but I found the treasure I wanted the most.'

name: Wreathed Dream
desc: Nanaki hopes to give children experiences as magical as hers, to help them cherish innocence as they grow up.

name: Nocturnal Tinge
desc: Her singing helps plants grow, including the dreamshroom. Fina sits under the tree and gently watches the plants.

name: Breath of Dew
desc: Flowers stretch their leaves in the evening breeze, rejoicing and dancing to Fina's cheerful song.

name: Obscure Imprint
desc: Fina loves plants but isn't fond of outsiders. If you ever run into her, don't disturb her time with her plants.

name: Nocturnal Tinge - Dream
desc: Travelers are all careful not to hurt the plants in the forest, in case they anger Fina and get thrown out.

name: Breath of Dew - Dream
desc: Another group arrives in the depths of the forest, gazing in awe at the fairy standing alone under the moon.

name: Obscure Imprint - Dream
desc: The fairy's singing flows in the veins of every leaf. Plants shiver in the silent night, telling stories of yore.

name: Crimson Chant
desc: The witch brushed her hair as the raven brought a gem necklace. The hat fell on her head with a wave of her wand.

name: Mushroom Stew
desc: Ripe dreamshrooms are precious ingredients to be cooked in the simplest way—boiled and served with fine salt.

name: Mushroom Stew - Fresh
desc: Wait, it hasn't boiled.' When someone asks worriedly, the mushrooms are already rolling around, 'Not ready!'

name: Undercooked Mushroom
desc: The inside of the mushroom looks like 'zzz', so people call it the dreamshroom, sleepshroom, or snoreshroom.

name: Photosynthesis
desc: Mushrooms can't photosynthesize without chloroplasts, so the colorful mushrooms complain, 'That's not a right name!'

name: Photosynthesis - Dream
desc: But the mushrooms have turned into lamps, so we can help other plants synthesize!' The mushrooms wonder.

name: Red Muscaria
desc: They look like us, but these aren't edible!' The mushrooms speak at once, 'There will be huge trouble!'

name: Purple Muscaria
desc: That's worse!' The mushrooms jump up and down anxiously. 'I'm not eating it. I can tell that from the way it looks.'

name: Sugar Overload
desc: Nikki, is this a world without you...' 'Momo, do you need help?' 'Y-yes... I can't get out meow!'

name: Bear Fluff
desc: She can't leave the forest and values every chance to talk to outsiders. Don't be shy if you see her on your tour.

name: Bear Fluff - Mocha
desc: Of course!' Kokia makes her entrance, fluffy ears popping out of the bush, 'Strawberry, chocolate, or milk?'

name: Wicked Fluff
desc: A furry little creature in a cute outfit stands in front of the adventurers. They can't tell who it is for a second.

name: Fairytale Gate
desc: Beyond the leaves stands a quaint cabin. In front of it is a small garden full of blooming flowers.

name: Blooming Palisade
desc: After some discussion, they decide to follow the voice. Of course, they will keep a safe distance from the character.

name: Sylvan Glade
desc: But this is an immersive play. It can't be too dangerous. Why don't we take a look?' one of them suggests.

name: Bunny Caper
desc: It seems another group has arrived sooner. They stand in the garden, shielding a girl in a red cape behind.

name: Gourmet Basket
desc: The adventurers let out a sigh of relief, share a look, and decide to go out and join the other team.

name: Redolent Satin
desc: The fluffy animal scutters away soon with a roar. The team members stand in a circle, comforting the girl.

name: Cutesy Costume
desc: Seeing the mascot head Nikki prepared for the guessing game, Momo commented, 'Everyone will know who you are.'

name: Broken Clues
desc: With a low hiss, the lights in the hall suddenly went out. The music paused as the crowd began to panic.

name: Puzzling Cinders
desc: Beep—' The passcode to a storage room away from the hall was decrypted. A figure approached the sleeping gem.

name: Blinding Alarm
desc: Don't panic!' 'Don't run. Watch your steps!' Staff members tried to maintain order while a figure left in silence.

name: Mind Labyrinth
desc: Shouldn't the security guards be keeping order in the hall? The Gem Burglar was puzzled, 'Why are you here!?'

name: Mystery Paradox
desc: You've been caught in the act. Save your breath for the police.' Colis handed the Burglar over to the police.

name: Revealing Moment
desc: I've tracked this case since the first theft and noticed the same MO,' Colis explained patiently.

name: Extraordinary Grace
desc: Thank you, Ms. Colis,' the host said gratefully, though curiosity about her methods lingered in his mind.

name: Insightful Theory
desc: Colis first checked the security details for tonight and believed this would be the best moment for arrest.

name: Gamble of Minds
desc: Colis never feared enemies in the dark. She would find herself in dangerous situations and never back down.

name: Ingenious Scheme
desc: Detectives have their own styles—and so do burglars. The Gem Burglar was known for exploiting security flaws.

name: Suspect Analysis
desc: The Gem Burglar was suspiciously calm after the arrest and smirked when he walked by Colis.

name: Drifting Mind
desc: More importantly, the dreamshrooms are extremely delicious no matter how it is prepared and cooked.

name: Mushroom Whimsy
desc: The cafeteria of Pedmon School grew them in greenhouses and created a specialty dish that soon captivated the world.

name: Drifting Mind - Dream
desc: Shroomoo has been staying in the forest for research. Adventurers lucky enough may run into her on their tour.

name: Mushroom Whimsy - Dream
desc: She is a friendly character who will actively approach adventurers. If you need any help, don't hesitate to tell her.

name: Gentle Companion
desc: The fluffy white creature looks as calm and gentle as its master, but the girl knows it is a fleet-footed hound.

name: Romantic Confetti
desc: What's wrong?' The clamor ceases at the sound of the voice as people step aside. The girl looks up curiously.

name: Everlasting Glory
desc: The name Nakoya means undying light. Even time favors her, granting her extraordinary maturity and grace.

name: Breeze of Bloom
desc: As Duchess Nakoya approaches her, her heart beats faster and faster, before she bows on one knee with all sincerity.

name: Elegy of Glamour
desc: A sergeant? Some guests look her up and down, their murmurs like an off-key song, destroying the harmony in the room.

name: Crimson in the Night
desc: Who would dance with her? Someone raises their voice, but she doesn't argue with them. All she cares is that...

name: Stellar Affection
desc: As Nakoya and Selly step onto the dance floor, the gentle tune turns into passionate notes to start the ball.

name: Fairytale Carousel
desc: In her dreams, Tatasie rode on a wooden horse on clouds as stars weaved her a shimmering rainbow-like cape.

name: Rainbow Starlight
desc: Reluctant to leave, a star clung to Tatasie's hem, swaying with her steps and urging her onward with each twinkle.

name: Fantasy Stairway
desc: Clouds formed a stairway to the festival. Tatasie waved goodbye and stepped up, lifting her hem as she went.

name: Dewy Zephyr
desc: Tatasie stepped into a fairyland where the sweet wind brushed her hair and told her stories under the blue sky.

name: Cirrus Chorus
desc: Stars slid down the rainbow bridge, eagerly offering Tatasie their handmade, masterpiece treats.

name: Ethereal Shimmer
desc: Tatasie could still see the colors when she woke up. Inspired, she rushed to her desk — she now had a design!

name: Skyward Invitation
desc: After renovation, the fairyland reopened. The carousel of stars and clouds invited everyone to the sky.

name: Traces of Inspiration
desc: The assistant opened the studio door to see Tatasie finally smiling again—with a finished carousel blueprint in hand.

name: Wishing Fairy
desc: Iset brings a unique wish bottle that grants any wish written on a slip of paper in the near future.

name: Awakened Rebirth
desc: Ace and Elle bring the morning lavender from the Pigeon Kingdom that symbolizes awakening and rebirth.

name: Moment of Amazement
desc: Nikki is surprised when she walks out of the room. Momo jumps on the table and hands her a cute hammer with a ribbon.

name: Fuzzy Feeling
desc: Nikki gently cracks open the chocolate egg brought by the Iron Rose. Inside is a birthday cake adorned with stars.

name: Brilliant Blossom
desc: The pillow from her friends in the Cloud is embroidered with flowers, symbolizing their great wish for her happiness.

name: Enwreathing Aroma
desc: When the first ray of light shone through the mist, Waverly set out to find water despite the treacherous path.

name: Ambrosial Carriage
desc: It hadn't rained in months this year. The ground dried up, and even the flourishing apple tree looked withered.

name: Floral Vitality
desc: As leaves fell and branched dried, Waverly couldn't stop worrying. She didn't want to lose her longtime friend.

name: Gentle Haze
desc: Tender flowers and leaves formed an oil painting. Waverly lay in the shade, watching the clouds shift.

name: Cherished Hope
desc: Deep in a remote valley, Waverly found a small but clear crook, as if nature had prepared an answer for the brave.

name: Scarlet Delicacy
desc: Overjoyed, Waverly carefully scooped water into her bucket and began her journey home at sunset.

name: Lingering Redolence
desc: On quiet evenings, Waverly would sit by the apple tree as usual, sharing her day or singing a gentle song.

name: Blooming Aspiration
desc: Though fetching water was tiring and repetitive, Waverly never complained—she only wished for the tree's recovery.

name: Redolent Ballad
desc: One morning before departure, Waverly was surprised to see new sprouts on the apple tree's branches.

name: Emerald Magic
desc: A plump red apple fell into Waverly's arms. She took a bite from the tree's present, and it began to work wonders.

name: Afterglow Leisure
desc: Its refreshing aroma bears witness to Waverly's friendship with the tree, watching over her innocence and kindness.

name: Feline Receptionist
desc: The cat grew fond of Saki's mother, rubbing against customers' legs and allowing gentle pets from familiar hands.

name: Delightful Treat
desc: To spoil the cat, her mom baked its favorite food—fish cookies. People started calling it Fish since then.

name: Exclusive Devotion
desc: When her mom was baking cakes and fish cookies, Fish would sit quietly by her side, awaiting its special meal.

name: Pastry Guardian
desc: As time passed, Fish became the guardian of the shop, patrolling the pantry, kitchen and tables every day.

name: Cordial Atmosphere
desc: Worried Fish might occupy a dining spot, Saki offered discounts at tables where Fish chose to nap.

name: Convivial Treat
desc: Saki refurnished the shop after she took over. On reopening day, she baked a new flavor of cookies for Fish.

name: Delicious Compensation
desc: Fish now loves sleeping under tables, and customers lower their voices to avoid disturbing the beloved old cat.

name: Elegant Elephant
desc: The elephant carried Mikari to a wonderland. Here, she was no longer a lonely girl but a brave adventurer.

name: Plaited Clouds
desc: Seeing Mikari upset, her grandma lovingly crafted toy elephants with her warm, dexterous hands.

name: Adventurous Anecdote
desc: Beyond the soft clouds lay the magical park in the sky, where wonders awaited the curious young girl.

name: Liberating Venture
desc: Mikari and the elephants cleared challenges and found treasures hidden in the park. She never felt such joy before.

name: Frosting Badge
desc: Mikari shared the dream with her grandma, who patted her on the head, 'I hope you'll always smile like this.'

name: Devout Wish
desc: Mikari looked at the mirror behind her grandma and saw the upward curve of her own lips, her eyes shining with joy.

name: Innocent Dreamland
desc: She adored the toy elephants, naming each one and crafting creative clothes and accessories just for them.

name: Hook of Luck
desc: Inside the dark forest are heavy mist, strange mushrooms, and bubbling swamps... Infinite wonders abound.

name: Underwood Memory
desc: Lorora's interest was piqued. She asked where the creek was and set out to find the fish first thing in the morning.

name: Medal of Courage
desc: They came to a glade in the forest where a huge tree towered over them. Lorora stepped closer and asked nicely.

name: Tacit Support
desc: Lorora and her cat feared no difficulties, but as they adventured farther, they started to lose their direction.

name: Adventure Fellowship
desc: Follow where my tallest branch points, and you will find the deepest creek.' The tree praised their courage.

name: Treasure Voucher
desc: Lorora parted vines and finally saw the creek. The special red fish swan gracefully in the shimmering water.

name: Rekindled Dream
desc: How did Tiya know what she wanted? She tasted the pudding and felt joy for the first time after Tiya left.

name: Candlelight Twinkle
desc: She felt empty inside after Tiya left with her mother. Now there was no one to share dreams with.

name: Golden Sconce
desc: On her birthday, she received an unexpected gift—a strawberry pudding with the letters 'Happy Birthday' on it.

name: Crown of Faith
desc: She continued to learn art and design. The dream of becoming a designer with Tiya was her guiding light.

name: Tomorrow Fantasy
desc: She would receive the same candle before her birthday. On her 16th birthday, she wished to get into her dream school.

name: Candle Bloom
desc: A magic circle glowed beside a desk of books and manuscripts. The girl's face was lit by the candle flame.

name: Enduring Vow
desc: Candle Fairy, share Sana's wishes with me! Even if we're not together, I want to realize a wish for her every year.'

name: Poetic Fragrance
desc: The garden became alive—lilacs and roses turned into fairies and held Laruna's hem, inviting her to an adventure.

name: Illuminating Insight
desc: Laruna floated up in the evening breeze. The dark sky seemed within arms' reach, as if she could touch the stars.

name: Crescent of Dreams
desc: She rode the golden crescent along the river of stars, each whispering a secret of the past.

name: Midnight Palisade
desc: Laruna took a step ahead and saw a ferry to the sky river. In the shimmers berthed a golden crescent boat.

name: Sparkling Blossom
desc: Stars jumped into Laruna's boat with drops of water, sharing brilliant ideas with her. The girl smiled with joy.

name: Chorus of Strings
desc: She reached into the river of stars and found shimmering verses. As she chanted them, the stars shone even brighter.

name: Nostalgic Ballad
desc: Through thick clouds, the boat suddenly shook violently. Laruna with the stars and verses all plummeted below.

name: Stellar Ripples
desc: The crescent boat flowed and left ripples in the river. Laruna arranged the verses into a brilliant chapter.

name: Serene Frolic
desc: Nobody knew how the cave was formed. Tavania speculated that an overwhelming power had been sealed within the forest.

name: Shattered Memory
desc: Tavania began looking for a solution. She opened a rift in the seal of the forest, slowly releasing the power within.

name: World of Yore
desc: The phantoms around Tavania were lives lost in the cave. They weren't even spirits, just projections from the past.

name: Nightmarish Bloom
desc: Immense power brewed in the sealed realm until the cave formed, enveloping the forest in a looming shadow.

name: Verdant Renewal
desc: Soon, because of the rift, a human explorer discovered the forest. She was the first visitor in a thousand years.

name: Evening Zephyr
desc: Tavania is glad with the result. The corrupting power is slowly dying, while humans bring new life to the forest.

name: Shades of Time
desc: Sometimes Tavania feels lonely, too. She is shy and a bit timid, so she only has very few friends.

name: Pacific Storm
desc: It makes Tavania sad that due to the cave and her mysterious power, explorers are afraid of running into her.

name: Crystalline Glow
desc: If explorers come here, I'll politely tell them not to go near the cave. Tavania wonders if they'll be her friends.

name: Hazy Hoar
desc: Tavania lives alone near the cave in the depths of the misty forest, where humans and other animals seldom visit.

name: Loyal Audience
desc: Sheryl is an important character who appears early in the tour. She's pure-hearted with a love for dance and music.

name: Fountain of Magic
desc: Sheryl is a fairy living in the forest who's equally friendly to everyone instead of only adventurers.

name: Curtain of Wonder
desc: At the end of a show, she might ask adventurers to gather materials for her to design new decorations for the stage.

name: Burgeoning Mirage
desc: No matter the result, Sheryl would compliment anyone who helped her and gift them some adorable souvenirs.

name: Hymnal Blossom
desc: Sheryl has made friends with the bunnies, bears, hamsters, and more. She would make your adventure extra fun!

name: Serene Chapter
desc: As the wind and music die down and light illuminates the stage, the audience realizes the show has ended.

name: Silent Whisper
desc: If you have Sheryl's approval, she'll give you a small gift—a flower bookmark, leaf envelope, or mushroom badge.

name: Effulgent Wonder
desc: Adventurers seeking close interactions with Sheryl may be disappointed—she's quite busy.

name: Galactic Bond
desc: If you run into any trouble, don't hesitate to blow Sheryl's whistle. Her friends will come to your aid at the sound.

name: Euphoric Flutter
desc: In the pale moonlight, Sheryl waves her hands—and this time, her friends join the dance too.

name: Wings of Vision
desc: After the adventurers arrive at the last scene, Sheryl often appears in the distance before the final departure.

name: Loyal Companion
desc: She gives adventurers simple but fun quests, such as helping her animal friends choose their outfits.

name: Murmuring Bloom
desc: Flowers sway in the breeze by the sides of the forest trail. Every bloom has its own story to tell.

name: Chef's Hat
desc: The custom-made chef's hat is adorned with colorful dessert patterns. Every kid gets to have one for free.

name: Ingenious Craft
desc: Sweetness helps release stress. If you are feeling down, head to the Bear's Bakery for fun and satisfaction.

name: Sprouting Meadow
desc: Mornian only realized it was midnight when she finished work. The prettiest flower was still blossoming alone.

name: Ardent Blossom
desc: The first customer knocked on Mornian's door and bought a white lily for the Goddess. The second chose the iris...

name: Devoting Dream
desc: Mornian awoke to a graceful woman in a hazy light, her gorgeous hair shining like the glow on the mountain peaks.

name: Daydream Boon
desc: It was morning when Mornian woke up again. She came to the garden and noticed that the prettiest flower was gone.

name: Sunrise Sparkle
desc: Overjoyed, Mornian offered the prettiest flower to the Goddess, who accepted it as the petals kissed her fingertips.

name: Gentle Revelation
desc: The woman thanked Mornian's work with a gentle smile. Still in a daze, Mornian suddenly realized who she was.

name: Budding Dream
desc: How she wished to offer the flower to the Goddess. But the festival had ended. Mornian went to sleep with regrets.

name: Midwinter Bliss
desc: Birds brought peculiar objects to adorn Tana's windowsill, from star-shaped hair pins to colorful pebbles.

name: Fateful Nocturne
desc: The fox had a bigger task. A magician lived by a hot spring in the deepest of the woods where no animal ventured.

name: Magic Insignia
desc: The spring was said to cure all illnesses. On the holy night, the fox set out on its journey to find the spring.

name: Purest Dedication
desc: The squirrels wove twigs into a big basket, filled it with their best acorns and placed it in front of Tana's home.

name: Rejoicing Snowman
desc: Tana was ill? That's terrible.' the white-bearded magician had heard her singing, too. 'Give her the spring water.'

name: Ephemeral Dream
desc: From gentle speaking to lively motions, Luoyun taught the kitten how to disguise as a human and hide herself.

name: Shadowy Venture
desc: Overly excited, the kitten let out her tail accidentally caught the new crystal chandelier, and shattered it.

name: Ethereal Odyssey
desc: The crystal chandelier was key to the show. In a panic, the kitten thought of Luoyun's brush that could fix anything.

name: Rosebud Shadow
desc: The kitten worked hard and went to the dance hall early to clean it. Luoyun leaned on the cupboards and listened.

name: Spiritual Embrace
desc: The brush on the desk fixes anything; the lamp can turn back time; the old phone is one call away from other worlds.

name: Tender Greetings
desc: Luoyun explained that some had sentimental value and weren't for sale, so the suspicion gradually went away.

name: Ingenious Marvel
desc: The last customer left as the night fell. Luoyun blew out the candle and suddenly heard the sound of crashing beads.

name: Archaic Artistry
desc: Luoyun went upstairs and saw the bead curtains swaying. A girl was lying on a chair with tears on her cheeks.

name: Twilight Haze
desc: She learned some basics about human behavior and language from an older waitress and managed to stay here.

name: Wishful Echo
desc: Please Luoyun... Help me.' Before the girl finished her words, two cat ears popped out and a tail dangled behind.

name: Jade Iridescence
desc: Holding a cup of tea, the girl explained how she found a waitress job in the Jasmine Hall nearby.

name: Gem Dazzle
desc: The kitten begged and promised she'd bring the best jewel one day. She just needed Luoyun's brush and her help.

name: Ethereal Shadow
desc: Crowned by the night as the master of dreams, she saw visions and heard every secret wish and silent hope.

name: Crescent Whisper
desc: Lovers reunited. Those consumed by fear or pain worried no more. Sorrow faded into oblivion.

name: Drifting Haze
desc: A river of stars carrying hopes and memories flowed through dreams, driving out terrors with a harmonious finale.

name: Feathery Breeze
desc: The audience was a group of blind kids. Their teacher hoped that music could show them the beauty of the world.

name: Dream Timbre
desc: The show started on time. There was no spotlight or Arya's dream stage, but a sky full of twinkling stars.

name: Dream Embrace
desc: The children sat quietly in their seats, with the most attentive and touching look of anticipation for the performer.

name: Lustrous Bloom
desc: In her singing, stars were musical notes dancing under the sky, while fireflies shimmered in the serene, open wild.

name: Starlit Glide
desc: The singing turned into pairs of invisible wings, carrying the children to the boundless sky of shining stars.

name: Candid Embrace
desc: Since then Arya has been to many places for shows, but she still remembers the night and those meaningful tunes.

name: Stylistic Solo
desc: The unique guitar has been with Chilu for long, from his loneliest moments to his achievements under the spotlight.

name: Metallic Hum
desc: After a short break, it's time for the mysterious guest. The stadium erupts into cheers when the audience sees Kaja.

name: Opposing Wings
desc: Chilu explains to Cali his inspiration for the concert, 'Contradictions make up the world and our lives.'

name: Dance of Strings
desc: Day and night, front and back, black and white—the audience dances and cheers as the melodies and beats clash.

name: Drifting Warble
desc: The praise of life never stops. Be it day or night, spring or winter, the melodies flow with endless passion and joy.

name: Euphoric Beats
desc: A musical score floated in the air. With Melodie's guide, the students soon noticed the incorrect notes.

name: Track of Life
desc: Two musical notes overlapped, while one hung at the edge of the score, as if it would fall at any moment.

name: Fantastic Symphony
desc: Melodie told her students that everything had its own song. Listen carefully to hear every dancing note.

name: Dream Navigation
desc: The students cheered as the wilting plant thrived again, budding quietly in the sound of music.

name: Missing Curse
desc: Melodie waved her wand and chanted a spell to move the misplaced notes. A gentle song echoed in the room.

name: Rejoicing Snow
desc: The girl's dress twirled like a flower blooming in the snow. People were transfixed by the perfect dance and music.

name: Starlit Foliage
desc: For the Night Festival, the girl would be dancing under the largest adorned tree lit for the whole night.

name: Earnest Present
desc: Cheers and claps surrounded her after a song. A small figure pushed out of the crowd and lunged into her arms.

name: Ursine Cuteness
desc: The girl felt as if she were dancing on a cloud and saw a snow bear coming to life and nodding at her approvingly.

name: Vivid Fairytale
desc: The audition was a week before the Night Festival. She practiced and sewed her dress with carefully picked clothes.

name: Guiding Pearl
desc: Overworked, she caught a cold from the wind. Fortunately, her friends got her to the hospital in time.

name: Silvery Jingle
desc: Tomorrow was the Night Festival. Disappointment almost crushed her as she walked in the sound of holy carols.

name: Moonlit Gaze
desc: The messenger brought a pile of packages, from a portal speaker, CDs, sweets from her hometown to starry ribbons.

name: Nocturnal Glimmer
desc: Her friends and family cheered her up. She wiped away tears as an idea slowly formed in her mind.

name: Brilliant Festivity
desc: She felt her unfinished dress and the audition poster still lying on the table, when a knock broke the silence.

name: Snowflake Charm
desc: Her students stared as Verssia calmly waved her wand, until waterdrops froze into snowflakes floating in the air.

name: Gale of Snow
desc: It was time for the students to practice. Some recalled her steps and started practicing, while some needed help.

name: Crystalline Shine
desc: Don't rush,' Verssia slowed her movements to show the details, 'Move in order and chant the spell accurately.'

name: Frostland Fantasy
desc: The students would continue to discuss what they learned. They all felt that Verssia was actually very gentle.

name: Silent Promise
desc: Thankfully, Verssia came to the rescue. She shielded the nervous student behind and melted the icicles with a wave.

name: Gentle Croon
desc: Sorry, Ms. Verssia... I failed.' Verssia patted him on the shoulder, 'It's always good to try, so don't be afraid.'

name: Magic of Silence
desc: Imagine elements of water gathering at the tip of your wand and freezing...' She guided her students to feel magic.

name: Effulgent Snow
desc: Glimmering snowflakes were reflected in the students' eyes. The breathtaking view seemed to have stopped time.

name: Chapter of Nature
desc: Verssia carefully guided every student. With each chant of the spell, snowflakes bloomed in the classroom.

name: Sparkling Prayer
desc: Suddenly, someone screamed. A nervous student lost control and accidentally made dangerous, sharp icicles.

name: Frozen Splendor
desc: With Verssia's encouraging words, the student calmed down and waved his wand again—a perfect snowflake bloomed.

name: Snowy Night Magic
desc: The Magic Academy Fantasies has been a hit since its publication. Verssia is one of the most liked characters.

name: Frosty Shrine
desc: Vianna would listen to their wishes in the sea of flowers and send the emissary of snow to spread her blessings.

name: Meandering Peaks
desc: Since then, the townsfolk would bring flowers to the foothills during the Night Festival to thank the Goddess.

name: Echoing Stars
desc: Children have whimsical dreams while others pray for their loved ones... Each tugs at Vianna's heartstrings.

name: Blessed Snowflake
desc: The Goddess blessed everyone in town, but when the festival ended, she heard a girl's disappointed sigh.

name: Pious Heart
desc: If only I could give this flower to the Goddess!' the girl had the sincerest wish that reached the snowy peaks.

name: Midnight Breath
desc: The girl didn't deliver the flower in time. I should visit her instead! Vianna made up her mind with a smile.

name: Starlight Vision
desc: The peaks glowed silently as the girl slept soundly in the warm room, a sweet dream awaiting her.

name: Crystalline Frost
desc: The girl spent all day preparing flowers for others to offer the Goddess and missed the festival herself.

name: Rosy Redolence
desc: The exquisite bag is the first New Year's gift: elegant design and romantic colors adorned with fragrant roses.

name: Dual Space
desc: Their collaboration ignites the show, and Chilu's new song Echo makes the best response to the audience's passion.

name: Carefree Sway
desc: Starlet guessed the girl was a poacher and challenged her to a styling contest, asking to set the birds free.

name: Guardian of Blooms
desc: Surprised but not offended, the girl explained that she was a healer who helped animals hurt by poachers.

name: Entrapped Wings
desc: Starlet noticed the caged birds were badly hurt, their wounds covered in white gauze. They needed protection.

name: Carefree Sway - Hidden
desc: Maybe the stars answered her prayer or the forest heard the birds. The girl cried when Starlet returned in time.

name: Guardian of Blooms - Hidden
desc: The girl ground the Whispergrass and fed it to the birds. As their eyes lit up again, they both relaxed.

name: Entrapped Wings - Hidden
desc: Starlet waved goodbye to the girl and the birds and looked at the stars. Maybe they didn't lead her astray this time.

name: Fluorescent Mirage
desc: The girl sitting quietly in a coffee shop could be Ms. Bunny lost in imagination. What would the next story be like?

name: Ethereal Vision
desc: Ms. Bunny invited Starlet to the troupe's new show. Beautiful scores guided the audience into a world of fantasies.

name: Poem of Tomorrow
desc: Applause erupted at the end of the show. It was so amazing that Starlet decided to stay and watch the next one.

name: Wonderland Parade - Maple
desc: Starlet always gets lost on her journeys, but thanks to that, she's made friends and has lots of stories to tell.

name: Fluorescent Mirage - Maple
desc: Starlet's stories gave Ms. Bunny new ideas. She wrote them down in her notebook but refused to show Starlet.

name: Wonderland Parade
desc: It wasn't until the new show that Starlet knew that Ms. Bunny wrote it for her, named The Lost Seer and Her Friends.

name: Ethereal Vision - Maple
desc: It wasn't until the new show that Starlet knew that Ms. Bunny wrote it for her, named The Lost Seer and Her Friends.

name: Poem of Tomorrow - Maple
desc: The seer's journey put smiles on everyone's faces, and Starlet had a new story to tell—her experience in the troupe.

name: Bear Cookie
desc: Ennie invited Starlet to dinner. Starlet was on cloud nine among toy bears after having the cream of mushroom soup.

name: Whispers of the Night
desc: Ennie spoke gently, 'Sleep, for your journey is in the dreams.' Starlet thought dozily that she sounded magical.

name: Fluffy Camaraderie
desc: When Starlet opened her eyes, two toy bears were waving at her. They tugged her sleeves, inviting her to the castle.

name: Bear Cookie - Foamy
desc: Starlet thought for a while and said, 'I like myself and my life. Besides... I don't know this prince.'

name: Whispers of the Night- Foamy
desc: The next day, Starlet bid farewell to Ennie, who offered her a toy bear to accompany her on her journey forward.

name: Fluffy Camaraderie - Foamy
desc: Starlet patted the bear's fluffy head and whispered, 'Thank you, but I think they'd prefer staying with you, Ennie.'

name: Spring Firecrackers
desc: Bid goodbye to the last year with fireworks and cheer! Is that thunder? No, it's my firecrackers of good wishes!'

name: Bunny Cheers
desc: The toy bunnies Ruby and Kane were Luluko's first fans. Their long ears danced to her singing as if cheering her on.

name: Stage of Excitement
desc: In the brilliant neon lights and waves of cheers, Luluko took a deep breath and stepped onto her dream stage.

name: Perfect Vigor
desc: When she was a kid, Luluko saw an idol's performance on stage. The gorgeous dress and bright smile captivated her.

name: Childish Imitation
desc: Dressing up in a sheer curtain and dancing with a rolled-up magazine—it was young Luluko's favorite game.

name: Heart of Passion
desc: Brighter than the stars was Luluko's smile. Her shared joy and energy must have reached the cheering audience.

name: Childhood Vision
desc: Tears of joy replaced days of anxiety when she got a reply from the idol project. Her dream was finally coming true.

name: Perfect Rendition
desc: As the audience chanted for an encore, Luluko smiled with tears in her eyes and wished the song would never end.

name: Scattering Wish
desc: Luluko wasn't disappointed with no more spotlights, because those glow sticks would shine on in her heart.

name: Radiant Sweetheart
desc: No more rolled-up magazine, Luluko grabbed the microphone and made her intro—I'm Luluko, and welcome to my show!

name: Stellar Bloom
desc: Her time as a trainee wasn't always fun. After being asked to do it again, she'd hide and cry. Then... try again!

name: Tomorrow's Reunion
desc: The manager took Luluko's phone to stop her from going on Tide. Her schedule was packed the next day!

name: Zephyr Murmur
desc: It's dark and time to go home. The leaves rustle in the wind and sing a lullaby. Explore the autumn in warm dreams.

name: Glacé Memory
desc: Myra felt happy for her. She gave her a big bar of coffee chocolate and wished the best for her new life in Cicia.

name: Hazelnut Biscuits
desc: Linno seemed hesitant outside, so Myra invited her in. She said she wanted to confess her feelings to her crush.

name: Cream Gummies
desc: Why not give him handmade chocolate?' Myra helped Linno make a heart-shaped chocolate and wished her good luck.

name: Cream Honey
desc: Momo, there's no fish-flavored chocolate!' 'Fine. Let's try mint, strawberry and this lemon flavor together!'

name: Luscious Cocoa
desc: The day was coming to an end. Myra was preparing to close the shop when a pink-haired girl and her cat came in.

name: Midwinter Bloom
desc: She trudged in the snow in threadbare shoes and blazed a trail on the perilous northern peak.

name: Fragrant Dawn
desc: It was not until dawn that she saw the red plum trees blooming for miles, covering the precipice in a dreamy brocade.

name: Brocade of Dreams
desc: She clenched her teeth and prayed for the remainder of the trip. She was so close when she fell and blacked out.

name: Splendid Grace
desc: A decade passed, and it was winter again. She walked alone in the snow, but this time, the trail was beaten and firm.

name: Crystalline Snow
desc: She woke up in a warm, dry cave. The plum blooms had shriveled, leaving only one petal in her hand.

name: Fading Scent
desc: With no floral fragrance, the red blooms on the peak were actually handkerchiefs with exquisite embroideries.

name: Nostalgic Dream
desc: Despite the howling storm, she took out a red handkerchief and tied it with a ribbon to a withered branch.

name: Dream Bubbles
desc: She was Carpia, with gorgeous golden and red scales exactly like the one in the story, but she always lazed around.

name: Crimson Jade
desc: The koi fish began to ask if it was really what they wanted. It was a path to success, but also filled with pain.

name: Tender Illusion
desc: In their training, the red koi and golden koi met a new friend who always stayed in the corners and never socialized.

name: Sunlight Dazzle
desc: Carpia made two friends, even though she looked reluctant. They practiced together and shared pearls and snacks.

name: Gemmed Glimmer
desc: The river was drying. The koi fish were too small to notice it at first, and the river was the whole world to them.

name: Bejeweled Fan
desc: The red koi came to help, so Carpia asked her, too. She wanted to protect the others so they wouldn't get hurt.

name: Lucent Felicity
desc: Carpia asked why she wanted to become a Loong. The golden koi shed a tear and answered she wished to see the sea.

name: Tailored Breeze
desc: That night, Carpia let the snowy moonlight shine on her and leaped over one towering wave after another.

name: Tune of Devotion
desc: Every koi fish has its reason to be a Loong. Through countless trials, they struggle and challenge themselves.

name: Euphonic Serenade
desc: The koi fish that turned into a Loong had never left. She'd seen every mountain and sea and returned to the river.

name: Earnest Promise
desc: Carpia used her Loong power to clear the sludge from upstream. It all went back to normal as the water returned.

name: Rippling Reverie
desc: It wasn't until the golden koi got hurt that they realized the river was drying out. Time was changing everything.

name: Transient Eternity
desc: A giant Loong appeared, with a solemn voice echoing under the moon, asking if she was ready to leave the river.

name: Shadow of Destiny
desc: Greed misled the once-wise nobleman. He abused his power and wealth, gilding even the floors of his manor.

name: Dauntless Wings
desc: The girl in the tower believed in Verka's lie until one day, an injured falcon brought a blood-stained family emblem.

name: Frigid Blaze
desc: She thought it could be a clue. Following the emblem, she found her father's old subordinate and learned the truth.

name: Effulgent Leaf
desc: The starving population and the truth of her father's death. With seething rage, she set out on a journey of revenge.

name: Pristine Glory
desc: A few days ago, she faked a report about an uprising in another region to lead Verka away from the castle.

name: Silent Recital
desc: As the castellan, she ordered the banishment of Verka's family, which was carried out by her close followers.

name: Blazing Splendor
desc: But it was far from enough. Rofona didn't have enough wealth or power if Verka returned with his army.

name: Glimpse of Yore
desc: Verka's reaction was unexpected. His letter seemed calm—he thought she was coerced by her father's followers.

name: Triumphant Return
desc: The hubristic man was still stuck in the past. The web of lies he wove for Rofona eventually ensnared him as well.

name: Fearless Oath
desc: Verka took our wealth, and I'll get it all back for you!' Rofona swore an oath to her followers at sunrise.

name: Midnight Blizzard
desc: Darlene would come to the park every night after that. Like an unspoken agreement, the violin would play.

name: Snowfall Promise
desc: The wait felt endless in the snow. Darlene was about to give up when the man shielded her with a black umbrella.

name: Vow of Life
desc: Seeing Darlene's tears, he couldn't hide his feelings anymore, 'I'll protect you from now on. You won't wait again.'

name: Snowfall Moment
desc: A welcome party held him up. He was out of breath after running in the snow, begging for Darlene's forgiveness.

name: Silent Aspiration
desc: Darlene loved writing, but her work left her no time to put ideas to paper. Yet tonight, he wanted to be her reader.

name: Lingering Chorus
desc: Darlene listened as he played, while he read all her poems. They were each other's first audience.

name: Snow-Night Oath
desc: A lily always lay on the bench she sat on. Darlene would turn her gaze to the violinist playing with flushed ears.

name: Midwinter Comfort
desc: Darlene sent her poems to publishers, and the violinist signed up for the open recruitment of an orchestra.

name: Pristine Feeling
desc: Darlene found fame with her beautiful writing, while the violinist impressed everyone with his amazing skills.

name: Sacred Inscription
desc: The day Renata left, birds surrounded her like always as she leapt by the old tree, oblivious to the glowing runes.

name: Immortal Saga
desc: She woke up before the birds and slept cradled by vines. One day, the envoy whispered, 'Call me Mother.'

name: Ligneous Sanctum
desc: One day, as Mother brushed Renata's hair, she said, 'It's time. You're ready for your three missions.'

name: Primeval Sentiment
desc: Renata came to the first impoverished country. Following Mother's instructions, she gave them fertile grounds.

name: Sylvan Tales
desc: People in the second country were brave but reckless. Renata crafted the sharpest weapons for them as told.

name: Caged Wish
desc: The third country was obsessed with magic powers. Renata taught those with potential what she learned from Mother.

name: Hillside Smelter
desc: When Mother heard Renata murmur in her sleep she felt lucky to be by her side, the look on her face seemed uncertain.

name: Starlit Splendor
desc: Renata rushed back and saw golden runes glowing by the tree. Worried, she ran to Mother but was pushed away instead.

name: Spiritual Sigh
desc: Renata somehow felt worried seeing people in their euphoria, but it faded when birds brought a gift from Mother.

name: Wilderness Elegy
desc: Fertile land couldn't defend itself; weapons led to war; magic broke the balance of power. The countries collapsed.

name: Surreal Dream
desc: The birds carried lights to the outside world, sharing warmth and calmness with those struggling in hatred and war.

name: Midnight Reverie
desc: In the safe haven of a comfortable dream, time loses all meaning, leaving only two inseparable hearts.

name: Snowfall Vow
desc: A sweet kiss melts the winter chill as snowflakes fall, forming two hearts forever entwined.

name: Ardent Passion
desc: A red rose witnesses fiery love on a snowy night, its imprint eternal and unyielding.

name: Mirror of Time
desc: The mirror belongs to the castle and the Star Seer. Unfortunately, there's nothing she needs to know through it.

name: Frosty Splendor
desc: On the balcony, Hirst leans casually on the sofa with a book in his hands, but his gaze lies somewhere else.

name: Seasonal Cycle
desc: Starlet lies in a tall and fluffy bed in the well-decorated bedroom, frowning as if debating something important.

name: Florescent Shadow
desc: As candlelight flickers in the church of the Pigeon Kingdom, the Holy Maiden prays on her knees with her closed eyes.

name: Sparkling Dew
desc: In Apple Federation, the magician bows in thunderous applause and cheers as colorful confetti bursts and falls.

name: Splendid Vestige
desc: As stars illuminate every corner of the continent, ripples spread in the mirror, showing images from afar.

name: Anecdote of Time
desc: The vision in the mirror becomes a blur of falling stars and fading moonlight, leaving only silent darkness.

name: Fate in Mirror
desc: In the forgotten corner, time turns into ripples in the mirror. Only blooms and springs sing rhymes of yore.

name: Herald of Spring
desc: The flower said: I'd seen others looking for the garden but leaving in disappointment. Did you also come from afar?

name: Iridescent Garden
desc: The traveler sat by a stone pillar. To her surprise, there was power left in the wilted vines where a flower budded.

name: Vernal Eternity
desc: The traveler was tired, thinking the dead garden was fate's prank, telling her that all her efforts were in vain.

name: Temporal Reflection
