desc: The traveler couldn't answer that. Her journey began so long ago, and she'd left footprints all over the world.

name: Aromatic Prelude
desc: The traveler wandered the world and saw prosperity and desolation. The initial joy of traveling had long faded.

name: Floral Rhetoric
desc: The flower waited, swaying in the frigid gale as if it'd be blown away the next second. The traveler answered yes.

name: Florid Companion
desc: A gust of wind blew the flower into the traveler's palm. It asked: Will you stay? We can create another spring.

name: Garden Strings
desc: But the traveler was too tired. She stared at the desolation, unsure of an eternal spring. Would there ever be one?

name: Sprouting Verdure
desc: The flower said: Sorry, spring had long left. Take your rest and leave. You may find an eternal spring elsewhere.

name: Eternal Tendrils
desc: The fairy was long gone, but she left a way to preserve spring. The traveler decided to stay and rebuild the garden.

name: Garden Rhapsody
desc: But she didn't leave and felt the vines with warmth in her gaze. She'd walked too long for the promise of spring.

name: Locks of Felicity
desc: Herbal wine is the goddess’s favorite, filled with the scent of spring, symbolizing hope and prosperity.

name: Aureate Splendor
desc: As the fireworks bloom, the goddess blesses the world with peace and prosperity and wishes for abundant times ahead.

name: Fortune Cauldron
desc: A fortune sprite gifted her a cauldron to share blessings and wishes as she serves as the new year’s guardian.

name: Heavenly Auspice
desc: The snake goddess prepares for all wishes—reunion, love, health, wealth, or luck—for the coming year.

name: Nephrite Wish
desc: Firecrackers awaken the sun lord as people don new outfits, ready to embrace a prosperous new year.

name: Brimming Vigor
desc: After Miu landed, the bloated toast slowly shrunk and turned into a warm light, leaving only the sweetness of butter.

name: Faith in Tomorrow
desc: I'm sure you've made it to school on time. Hope the magic helped. And don't sleep late again. —Bakery Owner'

name: Tales of Fortune
desc: It all happened so suddenly that Miu thought she was dreaming. She shook the empty bag and found a note inside.

name: Toast Magic
desc: Riding the giant piece of toast, Miu finally made it to school before the last moment.

name: Fondness Overload
desc: Miu is a character in Morning at the Bakery. It's a children's book about a bakery owner using magic to help kids.

name: Fireside Tea
desc: After preparing melted snow and tea leaves in the yard, Roro brought more fruits to treat her guest.

name: Fragrance in Snow
desc: The snow died down, but Roro was still worried. If her guest didn't come, she'd bring some treats to the mountain.

name: Flimsy Dream
desc: After reading about brewing tea with melted snow, Roro climbed the mountain to collect some—but slipped and fell.

name: Bundle of Snow
desc: As she brushed away the snow, a flurry little creature stuck its nose out and rubbed the snow off of her cheeks.

name: Snowland Fairy
desc: Roro was surprised to see her guest had arrived—a ferret was waving at her on the unlit stove, taking it for a seat.

name: Enwreathing Mist
desc: The ferret followed Roro wherever she went. It watched with its head tilted, then led her to a secret plum forest.

name: Crucible Haze
desc: Roro lifted the ferret away and lit the stove. Soon, a pleasant scent wafted out of the pot of snow and tea.

name: Scented Snowfall
desc: Roro gathered snow with the smell of plum blooms and invited the ferret to tea tasting. To her surprise, it nodded!

name: Dormant Warmth
desc: The ferret followed Roro home before bidding its goodbye. Roro watched until snow covered its tiny footprints.

name: Emerald Resplendence
desc: At sunset, the ferret rubbed on Roro's fingertip and scampered away—perhaps they'd meet again the next day.

name: Banquet Vestige
desc: A waiter walked to Allison with drinks. She took one and saluted to someone behind the crowd.

name: Stairs of Glory
desc: Like that, Allison got away from the crowd. Beside the elegant spiral stairs, a waiter invited her to the lounge.

name: Glowing Spectacle
desc: Everyone turned their gaze to the middle-aged man. Allison's next investee? They wondered and gathered around him.

name: Urban Neon
desc: The marble floor reflected the neon lights and stars outside, as an intoxicating aroma filled the room.

name: Amber Whisper
desc: Her assistant put a coat on her and whispered, 'We found proof that her design got stolen. Are you helping her?'

name: Aureate Daze
desc: Allison doesn't mind bootlickers. She knows wealth attracts vultures like carcasses. They'll never forget the taste.

name: Emerald Canticle
desc: This is my newest design. What do you think?' the young man smiled flatteringly, 'Nothing beats it!'

name: Scented Treasure
desc: Of course.' the young man apologized. 'You must have more than this.' Allison didn't mind, 'I'll take them all.'

name: Cosmic Symphony
desc: Allison raised her eyebrow, 'I run a legitimate business, sir. The tax I paid is enough to build three Times Towers.'

name: Empyrean Shine
desc: Lives fell to the empress's wrath. Blood on the guillotine didn't dry for months and the blade split time and again.

name: Lakeside Arcade
desc: The girl was invited to the palace with respect. She felt no joy or sorrow, so nobody could see through her.

name: Frosty Willow
desc: There was no more secret in the world. The girl needed no excuse or proof, for she knew it all.

name: Cosmic Liberation
desc: But the empress didn't ask her everything. The girl was confused as to why the empress pretended to not spot a lie.

name: Purge of Evil
desc: The empress smiled, no longer young, 'You know the world, but not people.' Then she added, 'It's not a bad thing.'

name: Ravine Echo
desc: As time passed, the once vigorous empress aged. She lay in bed, only her eyes still as bright as usual.

name: Serene Luster
desc: Before she made her choice, the new empress came to butter her up, 'If you're tired, you can return to Frostleaf.'

name: Timeless Finesse
desc: Instead of explaining, the empress talked about other things that fascinated the girl even though she knew them all.

name: Curious Virtuosity
desc: She sighed after a while, 'Leave if you don't want to.' The girl was confused. She thought she wanted her to stay.

name: Misty Cirrus
desc: Do you want me to help the new empress?' the girl asked, even though she shouldn't stay. The empress hesitated.

name: Drifting Cirrus
desc: Frostleaf disappeared over time, leaving only a handful of small lakes scattered over the map.

name: Meteor Whisper
desc: Go home, before the stars all fall. You need rest.' Starlet nodded and then shook her head. She couldn't promise it.

name: Verdant Canto
desc: Her teacher pushed the Stellar Codex toward her, 'We'll be waiting here, like today, and you'll find your way back.'

name: Scentful Slumber
desc: Starlet was beckoned over to her teacher. She stood there as her teacher flipped through the Stellar Codex.

name: Clouded Echo
desc: You must be tired after a long journey.' The teacher pulled Starlet to sit by her—a memory she didn't recall.

name: Resplendent Stars
desc: As Starlet closed the door and turned around, she saw the ship Lilith Star flowing in the sea wind.

name: Vision of Innocence
desc: At dawn, she sat with Amphithea News flapping in the wind, the date on which already leapt to months later.

name: Garden Adventure
desc: The past, present and future were marbles scattered on the ground to her. There was no point in finding a pattern.

name: Lingering Memory
desc: There had to be something to base reality on. Starlet felt the Stellar Codex and tried to sort out her mind.

name: Luminous Starlight
desc: Would her past and future selves help with her current wish? When Starlet looked up again, the sky had turned dark.

name: Stellar Coronation
desc: She seemed to have caught the star's tail for a brief moment. Would it be her way home or lead her astray again?

name: Eternal Blessing
desc: Brenda would lie on the armor during breaks, wiping her sword while babbling on about palace anecdotes.

name: Drifting Petals
desc: Bloody roses bloomed all over the Royal City. Brenda who grew like a sprouting tree hastened past the hedgerow.

name: Nocturnal Echo
desc: The girl's sword accurately hit between the breastplates with a clang. She cheered, ignoring the pain in her hand.

name: Crimson Edge
desc: Brenda commissioned a heavy sword as advised. The hilt was engraved with the same patterns as the armor.

name: Innocent Wonder
desc: Brenda defended her kingdom with her sword. Under her leadership, they fended off invaders again and again.

name: Pristine Vision
desc: The armor spun around and showed Brenda a blooming red rose on the tip of the blade, 'Well done, Brenda.'

name: Iridescent Twinkle
desc: The king died after a raid at night. Fire and smoke of war spread across the kingdom in place of red roses.

name: Pristine Oath
desc: She knew the soldiers must have felt the same. The armor exhausted its soul, sharing its power with everyone.

name: Frigid Silence
desc: Blue decided to look for White. The spirits studied the travelers' books for three days before seeing her off.

name: Fluorescent Era
desc: White usually returned after a few days, so the spirits grew worried when she didn't return for months this time.

name: Vow of Loyalty
desc: When Blue said that, White would sigh with a smile and let her wrap around her arm as they watched the clouds surge.

name: Veiled Moon
desc: The human world was much more lively. She followed a pleasant smell and found the sweet cake she read in the books.

name: Nephrite Charm
desc: Blue tilted her head in confusion when asked to pay, so the vendor offered her a small piece resignedly.

name: Enwreathed Ridge
desc: The human world was not as dramatic as the books. Their lives were simple but colorful as they worked and rested.

name: Hazy Precipice
desc: Spirits don't eat these. Blue thought to herself, but drooled over it. How could the humans make such delicacies?

name: Emerald Shimmer
desc: Humans feared the unknown, nature and whims of fate, but they were also brave, living as if they were never afraid.

name: Lotus Verdure
desc: Blue remembered what her sister told her. Spirits grew up in rain and storms, but never had to worry about death.

name: Godsbane Oath
desc: She was no envoy of the gods but a fallen angel, cursed with eternal life, bound by trees and mountains.

name: Mirror of Miracles
desc: As the candles dim, the vision in the mirror fades in ripples. The sound of the gates opening echoes in the corridor.

name: Banana Satchel
desc: She always wears a banana-shaped satchel. Some say inside is delicious candy, while some say interesting stories.

name: Floating Clouds
desc: People were told where the medicine came from. Since then, the wild cranes have become a symbol of the ancient city.

name: Dreambound Whisper
desc: The final stop was the Crane's dwelling place. The wind rustled the reed leaves, and a crane stood in the water.

name: Cheerful Breeze
desc: A cup of morning tea carries the scent of lemon groves, each breath filled with nature's calm and hidden delight.

name: Blazing End
desc: Why did he leave? Drawn by beauty, he was burned by the fire within. An insecure soul can never face the flame.

name: Lost Memory
desc: Helen recalled her mythic namesake—both trapped by beauty, their fates chosen by a world beyond their control.

name: Drowning Dream
desc: She dreamed of fire roaring through an ancient city. Its light in her eyes, and the illusion of beauty vanished.

name: Time Glimmer
desc: Helen stepped into the spotlight. Her red dress flared like fire with each spin, burning away every unseen chain.

name: Flicker Mirage
desc: Beauty was never the sin—it was desire and illusion that fed the blame. Rumors only revealed their fragile souls.

name: Mirror Gleam
desc: At the banquet, Helen nodded with a calm smile—he was a stranger now. But in his eyes, longing still lingered.

name: Dreamlike Flutter
desc: A butterfly landed on the girl's shoulder before flying to the roses, fascinating her with its glittering wings.

name: Flitting Butterfly
desc: Does love always feel so bitter-sweet? She believed that she'd met the one and wished to fall in love sooner.

name: Untold Feelings
desc: It might be time to confess her feelings amidst the butterflies and blooms, but the girl didn't know how.

name: Earliest Blossom
desc: A cold wave swept across the town. The roses that were blooming yesterday lost their colors in the gale.

name: Springtime Wonder
desc: Butterflies huddled around the roses in the bitter cold, each thin wing shielding the blooms from the wind.

name: Devout Prayer
desc: She prayed for the roses to survive the night and for the butterflies to leave for warmer lands.

name: Prismatic Wings
desc: The girl tried to keep every bloom warm while the butterflies danced around, unaware of the approaching danger.

name: Colorful Flickers
desc: Under the warm sun, the girl danced with the butterflies amidst the roses, creating their romantic fairytale.

name: Bunny Pawns
desc: Unlike the bunny pawns on the chessboard, Bena was surprised to find out that she didn't have to follow the rules.

name: Ingenious Move
desc: In the blink of an eye, a giant hand placed Bena on a black-and-white chessboard. Around her were bunny pawns.

name: Monochrome Dream
desc: It's just a dream.' Bena nodded cheerfully, 'I'll be your soldier and guard every inch of the kingdom for you.'

name: Silent Midnight
desc: Bena led the white bunnies to knock off their enemies one by one, like a light shining through the silent dark.

name: Soldier's Glory
desc: Bena took down the enemy rooks, captured their king, and earned her queen's praise, 'You're an excellent soldier.'

name: Charging Blade
desc: Bena never got a bunny chessboard. She was excited that she could finally have one, but she was also worried.

name: Unbreakable Oath
desc: A designer created the bunny chess after a whimsical dream. Bena loved it but could never afford one.

name: Supreme Praise
desc: You can have me now.' The queen agrees, 'Tomorrow afternoon, visit your favorite thrift shop. I'll wait there.'

name: Fairytale Waltz
desc: The queen seemed to have misunderstood. Bena did win, but it had nothing to do with being an excellent soldier.

name: Fairytale Twirl
desc: Every move on the chessboard calls for meticulous planning, but in the land of dreams, the only rule is to have fun.

name: Astral Weave
desc: They stood shoulder to shoulder under the fireworks, like how they once crawled under one blanket in their dorm.

name: Galactic Dazzle
desc: Tabisha couldn't help but yelp with joy. Like stars, the fireworks cast happiness and blessings for the night.

name: Resplendent Blaze
desc: Three, two, one—the moment she opened her eyes, she saw a sky lit by fireworks as brilliant as a sea of flowers.

name: Dancing Shimmer
desc: The memories intertwined but never faded. They shared a knowing look, laughing heartily just as before.

name: Wondrous Serenade
desc: Their memories of every adventure, every clash and mix of inspirations, seemed ever so vivid and never lost in time.

name: Fulgent Stars
desc: Tabisha's friends dragged her off the terrace and gathered the guests to reveal their wedding gifts.

name: Reminiscent Stars
desc: Tabisha looked in the mirror to put on a glistening necklace and cracked up seeing her friends make faces.

name: Sweet Lullaby
desc: In the gentle breeze under the stars, Tabisha tossed the bouquet of happiness as everyone cheered.

name: Effulgent Daze
desc: Our dearest friend, between the stars and the sparks, we weave for you a never-fading dream—a life full of love.'

name: Dream Companion
desc: Elanie leans back in her shell chair, dreaming of the sea—dolphins at play, fish gliding beside her.

name: Free Voyage
desc: Elanie turns off her jellyfish lamp and closes her eyes—wishing to hear the sea's whisper in her dreams.

name: Starlit Whispers
desc: At school, wishes go in drift bottles. Send them afloat—some say the water will make them come true.

name: Neon Ray
desc: In pajamas, Elanie leans on her bed. Moonlight touches her photo wall—the leaping manta ray looks so free.

name: Sea Treasures
desc: Elanie leaves her curious friends and heads to the riverside, carefully writing her long-held wish.

name: Mist Drop
desc: The bottle floats away. If my wish won't come true, Elanie thinks, then go see the sea for me.

name: Gleam Shell
desc: Elanie begins her drift bottle shopping—glass jars, scented paper, rainbow stars, and ribbons for a perfect wish.

name: Prism Glow
desc: Could it be true?' Elanie wavered. 'But imagine the bottles reaching the sea!' Her friend's eyes sparkled with zeal.

name: Glimmer Sprite
desc: One clear night, Lumi rose with the waves. The tide whispered, and the sea breeze carried distant laughter.

name: Bottled Wish
desc: Lumi uncorked the bottle. Inside, a child had written: “I want to grow up and explore the world’s end!”

name: Crystal Hope
desc: A drift bottle washed up before Lumi, moonlight glinting on its glass. Curious, she wondered—what could be inside?

name: Stardust Gleam
desc: But Madam Orca never stayed long—she loved the surface more than the deep. Lumi wondered, what could be up there?

name: Shell Whisper
desc: Where is the world's end? In the deep sea, or beyond the sky? Strange thoughts, yet they fascinate her.

name: Pure Whisper
desc: Some letters hold first love, some brief wonders, but most carry heartfelt wishes from their senders.

name: Tide Relic
desc: Since that night, Lumi rises whenever moonlight glows bright, opening drift bottles to read the wishes within.

name: Dream Net
desc: Lumi is enchanted. The letters paint the human world vividly, making the quiet sea below feel dull in comparison.

name: Egg Wonder
desc: The bunnies are always looking for eggs, but they seem to have never thought how to bring them home.

name: Bunny's Birth
desc: Mom, what's the world like beyond the fields?' 'No bunnies in our family have traveled that far, my child.'

name: Burgeoning Wonder
desc: I heard there are crows envious of your red eyes, hungry beasts, and mountains and rivers standing in your way.'

name: Sprouting Wish
desc: Reba always leaped on the mound to stare at the horizon where the sun sank, wondering about the world beyond.

name: Colorful Journey
desc: She traveled outside the fields to the mountains. There were hungry wolves and squirrels adventuring with her.

name: Dandelion Yellow
desc: But I want to see it!' One night, Reba followed the dandelions' seeds on a secret adventure of the unknown.

name: Flourishing Wish
desc: The garden grows fragrant with the wishes. It is said to be a mysterious ritual that turns wishes into flowers.

name: Blossoming Dream
desc: Flore asks her customers to write down their wishes with a smile. The floral-scented notes seem to hold secrets.

name: Guardian of Hope
desc: Ten years ago, the town was destroyed by merciless floods. People thought it had no hopes of reconstruction.

name: Mellow Glow
desc: Now, Florawishes bloom still. The girl who lost her parents in the floods has built a garden upon the ruins.

name: Zephyr of Dawn
desc: Florawishes are beautiful hopes, but without Flore's care, how could those buds bloom in the end?

name: Dashing Grace
desc: No setbacks or hardships can deter her. She will always chase her dreams with the same determined, fearless passion.

name: Emissary of Romance
desc: A pink bowtie and ribbons around the tail! Whisper sweet words of romance and be the star of the ceremony.

name: Kitten Whimsy
desc: A gift inspired by The Star-Struck Kitten, the interesting fairytale that sparked the love between the newly-weds.

name: Sea of Roses
desc: Each rose, wet with dew, emits a rich aroma, as the wedding dress leaves a gentle kiss on it when the bell rings.

name: Fluttering Heart
desc: Countless worries woke Nightwisp up from her respite. The girl's woeful wish stirred up waves in her heart.

name: Cocoon of Love
desc: The girl buried her innocent feelings deep in her heart, hoping for the gods to watch over the one she loved.

name: Hazy Passion
desc: Nightwisp saw shapes of souls and traveled dreams and reality to listen to every girl's unspoken love.

name: Endearing Murmur
desc: May your love shine eternally like the moon and guide your path.' The moon cast its glow upon the girl's face.

name: Tranquil Repose
desc: Nightwisp reached out, almost touching the tears on the girl's cheeks, but was afraid of waking her up.

name: Entwined Dreams
desc: Dreams change like a kaleidoscope: from cities bustling like a never-ending movie to nature teeming with lives.

name: Heartfelt Prayer
desc: Even if everyone faces the end alone, the memories that they share with those they love still shine true.

name: Spotless Heart
desc: A stage manifested before the girl's eyes. The person she held dearly wished that she'd achieve her dream there.

name: Hazy Remembrance
desc: The girl dreamed of a heartbreaking departure. A familiar figure moved farther away as she waved her hand.

name: Blazing Serpent Soars
desc: Legends say the serpent, sacred to fire, soars where the deity descends, bringing fortune to the world.

name: Rites of Gilded Flame
desc: At year-end rites, twelve brocade drums thundered as masked priests danced with bronze bells around the altar.

name: Crown of Grace
desc: The high priestess danced alone atop the altar, each final step aligning perfectly with the Flame Wyvern star.

name: Chime of Grace
desc: On the altar, a jade scepter gleamed as flames spiraled from the cauldron marked 'Serpent Fire Brings Eternal Light.'

name: Serpent in Firedance
desc: Solemn priests poured wine at the divine tree's roots; flames burst forth like a spirit serpent leaving its lair.

name: Jade Sparks
desc: Palace musicians struck bronze chimes in a flowing rhythm, echoing the Flame Wyvern deity's eternal power.

name: Torch of Order
desc: A 100-foot bronze tree stood at the altar's center, hung with lamps and etched with the Flame Wyvern star chart.

name: Amber Omen
desc: The sky cracked open, bleeding amber light. Lirain's charms spun wildly, sensing the storm long before the town did.

name: Featherlight Shade
desc: Her father's parting gift swayed in the breeze, waiting—so afraid of rain. Lirain turned back, sprinting home.

name: Raining Bells
desc: She rang the bell, ignored... Until the first winds shattered rooftops, sending the town fleeing underground.

name: Floodwalker
desc: Rain-drenched linen, water rising past her ankles. She reaches for the severed string, the charms barely holding on.

name: Seaside Bloom
desc: Lirain lived alone by the sea, as her father wandered the lands. The townsfolk, warm and kind, became her family.

name: Gentle Refuge
desc: The storm passed, leaving the town unscathed, its guardian gone. The old oak vanished, and with it, Lirain.

name: Stormproof Joy
desc: Father brought home two sun charms, their cotton smiles warmed by light. 'With these, you'll never fear the rain.'

name: Harbor Reunion
desc: A ship docked at last—Lirain ran to the pier, where her father stood, weary yet smiling, the sun on his back.

name: Secret Medkit
desc: Nurse Bubblin is unique, overlooking discarded pills and pretending not to see Elva sneaking by during night shifts.

name: Quiet Reverie
desc: The next day, her friend was gone. Bubblin's sigh held regret: 'Elva's surgery came sooner than expected.'

name: Timeless Escape
desc: Elva left behind notes like maps—true to her explorer's heart. Heeding them, Moony stood before the iron door.

name: Whispered Dreams
desc: Cold lights flickered beyond the door. Elva smiled from the operation table, pure and serene, untouched by memory.

name: Scarless Fate
desc: That empty smile haunted Moony. Elva had become a blank slate, wiped clean of everything they once shared.

name: Fading Ink
desc: You won't be punished tonight. Go back.' The words were kind, but Moony only shook her head.

name: Bright Spark
desc: Someone grabbed Moony's hand mid-sprint. Bubblin's eyes shone with worry as sweat dripped down her face.

name: Cure's Secret
desc: Moony hid Elva's notes. Now, she had to escape too, before the surgery. There was no one left to trust but herself.

name: Blank Experiment
desc: Bubblin hesitated, then smiled. A final touch on Moony's cheek, a quick swipe of a keycard—the door clicked open.

name: Love's Prescription
desc: Night fell as Moony slipped through corridors. The hospital exit was within reach, but she was spotted.

name: Chaotic Pulse
desc: The children loved Bubblin who listened. She soothed their worries, weaving their wildest dreams into stories.

name: Velvet Choice
desc: One night, Elva burst in, breathless—'Run! This place isn't...' But hands grabbed her, cutting the warning short.

name: Clamorous Blaze
desc: Her plumed crown ignites the night, sending the fire of freedom through the rejoicing city amidst all the noises.

name: Stellar Iridescence
desc: The city celebrates the night with the heat of the sun. The stars shimmer in the sky with a golden, splendid luster.

name: Crescent Dazzle
desc: Through a thin layer of clouds, the moon casts its light upon the girl, shimmering in the shape of a star orbit.

name: Feathery Phantom
desc: As the tail feather brushes the masks, the night devours the shadow of her dance, turning the dark into a carnival.

name: Aurora Blossom
desc: The flowers and leaves sway in the breeze at dawn, as if whispering the hopes and expectations of spring.

name: Youthful Secret
desc: A pair of earrings shaped like tiny locks recalls a chest of youthful diaries, a must-have for vintage style lovers.

name: Dewy Fragrance
desc: Alina believed Grandma's story and scattered petals in the lake. The ripples seemed like the fairy's whisper.

name: Flowery Shades
desc: At 16, Alina left to study in City Oren. In dreams, she'd see the flowers and ripples that she missed dearly.

name: Redolent Glow
desc: A glowing blue bloom turned into shimmering sparks the moment she touched the water, weaving an ethereal dream.

name: Amidst Blooms
desc: She returned years later to the same blooms and lake. Only Grandma's voice was nowhere to be heard.

name: Reverie of Wings
desc: In the bleak palace, the girl covered in dirt and scars moved closer, her eyes set on the broken sword by the throne.

name: Timeless Pledge
desc: The young Inara loved the garden of astral roses, where her mother would gently tell her stories of the stars.

name: Arbitrary Throne
desc: The kingdom turned into ruins with people imprisoned in fear, but none caved in and betrayed the princess.

name: Crown of Sword
desc: The demon had eyes in the shadows, searching for the royals. She dodged them, her hand gripping the dim thorny sword.

name: Soundless Grace
desc: The sword beamed as it pierced the palm, turning the demon's eyes into dust. 'I hereby summon the morning star!'

name: Swirl of Blooms
desc: The thorny sword with astral roses glowed in her hand, while butterflies flitted about in starry twinkles.

name: Midnight Starbeam
desc: Illuminating the dusty ruins, thorny vines sprouted from Inara's wounds, merging with the thorns on the sword.

name: Twinkling Murmur
desc: I'm willing... to sacrifice all for my people. Inara whispered, a heart pounding with endless passion and power.

name: Trial of Thorns
desc: To summon the morning star, you must pay the price. Are you willing to forever suffer such pain?' a voice asked.

name: Cuddle Mate
desc: A cat-paw mic glowed. Her voice filled the stream. Cheers flickered onscreen—her fans' love never faded.

name: Particle Burst
desc: More than a livestream—it's a harbor of warmth. Fleeting joy, yet heartwarming moments linger forever.

name: Virtual Cube
desc: Golden pixels build a dazzling virtual world. Every 'Little Fish' brings joy to the fans who stand by them.

name: Prism Flash
desc: Orange, blue, purple lights dance to the beat. Comments leap like musical notes—audiences' heartfelt cheers.

name: Glitz Wish
desc: Day two brings a famed singer—voice like crystal springs. Requests flood in as tender melodies carry the night.

name: Meow Pulse
desc: Games she loved feel fresh in Little Fish's hands. Late at night, she shares the thrill and joy with the stream.

name: Chroma Patch
desc: She savors 'Little Fish's' voice—sometimes bright, sometimes soft—smiling at each warm fan interaction.

name: Sugar Oath
desc: A new stream begins. She waits as tonight's shy “Little Fish” prepares to solve a cube on screen.

name: GameCharm
desc: In the “Little Fish” stream, even classes come alive. Professors join in, learning turns fun and engaging.

name: Meowtel Receiver
desc: As she conquers the final challenge, cheers flood the screen—a shared dream chased, a breath released.

name: Glitch Quest
desc: 4x4, 5x5, one-handed, blindfolded—each harder than the last. Tension builds as viewers cheer her on with hope.

name: Code Pop
desc: Once a star dancer, now standing after surgery—can she reclaim the rhythm of her soul?

name: Neon Mirage
desc: Little Fish's' stream—now a kaleidoscope of warmth. Watching others bloom, her own spark quietly reignites.

name: Meow Charge
desc: Each stream inspires fans. Magicians debut new tricks, and photographers share tips—all through “Little Fish.”

name: Starlight Index
desc: For races abroad,' she whispers—click, click, click—a cube conquered between hope and fear.

name: Byte Bloom
desc: She signs up as the next “Little Fish” and, while waiting to stream, repeats the dance she once knew by heart.

name: Best Cheer Squad
desc: One photo captured Nikki's adorable smile, another had great composition. Choosing was difficult for Momo!

name: Best Friend Forever
desc: I always introduce myself solemnly, 'I'm Momo, Nikki's best friend, and I'll accompany her anywhere.'

name: Future Daydreams
desc: Nikki and I talked again about the legendary kingdom of grilled fish. I believe we'll find it one day!

name: Leisurely Moments
desc: I was close to reading the words at the top... Wow, I'm as tall as the sign! Nikki always knows what I need.

name: Vivid Chic
desc: Every bow was specially designed and adjusted repeatedly. Of course, I provided careful guidance!

name: Meowgical Clip
desc: Nikki thinks the hairclip is as cute as me... Denied! Its cuteness is a hundred grilled fish behind mine!

name: Sweet and Cool Vibe
desc: At the last second, Nikki put on this special necklace. I certify it completes today's outfit.

name: Colorful Memories
desc: Journeys have surprises, but with Nikki's experience and my cleverness, we can handle anything.

name: Celestial Melody
desc: After that, Lainie often slipped into the sanctuary unseen. Her life was hunger and cold, no hymns or sacred songs.

name: Vow in Bloom
desc: Outside the halls, nobles squandered while slum children survived by stealing. Lainie spoke of it without sorrow.

name: Crown of Seasons
desc: The sanctuary wept in prayer, yet never reached out. For the first time, Isua doubted its flawless light.

name: Tear of Ephemera
desc: With Lainie's help, Isua secretly gave food to poor children. She even asked to fund shelters with sanctuary gold.

name: Earnest Blessing
desc: The sacred halls watched their heir in silence. Soon, Isua's freedom was gone, and contact with Lainie was forbidden.

name: Radiant Crown
desc: The sanctuary grew into a burden on the land. Wealth poured in. King and beggar alike bowed beneath its shadow.

name: Sacred Benediction
desc: Years later, she was crowned anew. She knew pain still lived in the world—but vowed to protect those close to her.

name: Elegy for the Lost
desc: She left there at last. What she saw was fire and ash—her homeland now torn by the enemy's war—so she acted.

name: Arcane Pact
desc: Meluthiel's power drove the invaders back. In the cheering crowd, she saw Vanessa again—now a brilliant commander.

name: Veil of Dusky Mist
desc: How long had it been? When young Vanessa arrived, time rushed in—and the blooming garden withered.

name: Lustrous Stream
desc: Furious, Meluthiel confronted her. Vanessa must restore every flower before she'd be allowed to leave.

name: Heartlight for the Lost
desc: So much time had passed. Meluthiel hadn’t even apologized. What had happened since she came here?

name: Forsaken Lament
desc: The girl kept her promise and sailed away. The flowers bloomed, but Meluthiel felt no joy this time.

name: Shackles of the Shade
desc: Go… just go. Meluthiel thought. Go see the world as it is now—see what still remains, or has been lost.

name: Frost Lotus
desc: In fall, Lynn gifted crème brûlée; in spring, Linsy returned a frost lotus. White graced Lynn's garden.

name: Newborn Star
desc: The two grew close, always seen together. As the design contest neared, Lynn's sketches shone like a rising star.

name: Faded Echoes
desc: In the ruins, only one frost lotus remained. Linsy designed a white gown with a full-bloom frost lotus at its heart.

name: Bloom in Ruins
desc: A jealous rival set the fire—designs were burned, and Lynn lost her sight for the colors she once mastered.

name: Tender Hope
desc: Onstage, she exposed the culprit and shared her vision: Flowers will still bloom even in a world washed of color.

name: Mystic Pact
desc: When the last rose finally bloomed, Vanessa asked Meluthiel to keep her promise—but another test awaited.

name: Lanternlit Path
desc: A boat made of aged cedar, sealed with amber oil, bore a lantern to light her way beyond the mists.

name: Vessel of Fate
desc: Vanessa, many paths lead to the garden, but only a boat built by your hands can carry you beyond the mist.'

name: Farewell in Bloom
desc: Vanessa labored tirelessly. When the boat touched water, silent ripples spread—she prayed time was not too late.

name: Oaths Beyond Measure
desc: The garden withered at the touch of an outsider; the witch said: 'When the last bloom returns, you may leave.'

name: Thorns Bloom Bright
desc: Vanessa soon found the witch not as feared; in the scent of tea, Meluthiel began to linger more and more.

name: Crimson Amber
desc: The witch indulged Vanessa's curiosity, teaching her spells like turning roses to gems, treating her like a pupil.

name: Edge Over Heart
desc: The garden revived, but a storm clouded Vanessa's heart; war still looms, haunting her sleepless nights.

name: Echoes of Chimes
desc: That night, the moon stayed silent as time began to flow; the witch stood watching while Vanessa sailed away.

name: Splendid Glimmer
desc: Colors are never confined to clothes. They can be a rain of lights, dyeing the sky hues of splendor.

name: Radiant Starlight
desc: Like a comet, the girl lives to be the brightest version of herself, her existence a manifesto of confidence.

name: Wayward Cadence
desc: She believes in one thing in life: fear no judgment and do whatever you want. Nothing changes her decision.

name: Colorful Decoration
desc: Passionate dancing gives life to wild imagination. Even the colors on the streets seem to be dancing to the beats.

name: Nautical Memory
desc: She fell asleep on the showcase and woke up to see an old photo in the logbook showing familiar faces.

name: Oceanic Whisper
desc: She thought it was a dream until she found a conch in her palm, fine salt falling from its hard shell at her touch.

name: Redolent Impression
desc: Pies made of fruits and edible flowers are the most popular, sold out as soon as they hit the shelves.

name: Basket of Wishes
desc: Food carries the best wishes of its makers. Its purpose is to bring people happiness and satisfaction.

name: Crusty Moment
desc: Take one bite of the shiny, fragrant crust—the taste reminds one of a wheatfield rolling in the golden sunshine.

name: Elegant Lotus
desc: Lights ripple on her skirt; lotus blooms surround the boat. For a moment, the girl feels she is in an immortal realm.

name: Melody of Dusk
desc: It should be time to return, yet she lingers. The misty landscape unfolds before her, too beautiful to leave behind.

name: Misty Rainfall
desc: Mountain weather shifts fast. Blue skies suddenly turn gray. Before she reacts, raindrops fall onto her bamboo hat.

name: Blossoms of Jade
desc: Rain drapes the boat like soft silk. Everything turns misty. Through layers of lotus, she continues her journey.

name: Ripples of Heart
desc: Raindrops strike the pond. Frightened fish flee to the depths, leaving lotus blossoms swaying in slanted rain.

name: Lotus Flower Jade
desc: Lotus leaves blend with distant hills. Petals blur in the rain, tinting even the raindrops pink.

name: Tender Moment
desc: The girls share a smile. Capri sits by the window, feeling the warmth as her fatigue slowly fades.

name: Sweet Aroma
desc: Rian brings a white peach oolong milk tea. Soft foam floats pink peaches, releasing gentle tea and fruit scents.

name: Sweet Sip
desc: This is her favorite winter drink. One sip spreads sweetness in her mouth, sparking endless bright ideas.

name: Tender Moment - Coffee
desc: Your bow reminds me of coffee foam. Did you design it?' 'Yes! I love making all kinds of bows!'

name: Sweet Aroma - Coffee
desc: Simple, familiar design can be grasped quickly, giving winter outfits a soft, airy charm.

name: Sweet Sip - Coffee
desc: Capri takes a sip, surprised by its taste. Praise flows, and her new friend blushes at her delight.

name: Tender Moment - Cheese
desc: On competition day, Capri walks confidently on stage, showing a sweet winter outfit inspired by Rian's drinks.

name: Sweet Aroma - Cheese
desc: Capri shares her design concept, describing how Rian's drinks brightened her long, valuable school days.

name: Sweet Sip - Cheese
desc: They may part in the future, but shared drinks and ideas warm their hearts like a winter hearth.

name: Heartbeat Transmission
desc: She wanders through endless space. 'Maybe one day I can do this in real life,' she thinks, pressing the warp button.

name: Morning Routine
desc: Ahem, let's see what's in the papers today.' 'Momo, why are you doing an impression of Dad?'

name: Leisure of Fishing
desc: She once went fishing with her father, who laughed and wiped her face dry when the fish splattered her with water.

name: Natural Whimsy
desc: She found a set of old fish toys and was surprised when her father remembered all the names she gave them.

name: Gravity of Heart
desc: She stepped beyond the system, slipping free from its intricate web. She became a fragment of 'scattered data.'

name: Secret Mark
desc: Such a state could never last long. The austere girl darted through narrow passages to an unremarkable door.

name: Circuit of Light
desc: Heimdal passed rows of virtual screens to the center. Others looked up from their work, greeting her knowingly.

name: Enigmatic Field
desc: The heavy door sealed. Heimdal unclasped her wristband and tossed it into a chest of discarded restraints.

name: Gravity of Heart - Silence
desc: That sweet little pink-haired girl? Ah… I regret not meeting her sooner. Perhaps I should invite her here myself.'

name: Secret Mark - Silence
desc: Heimdal said nothing, knowing it was only Xuni's jest. Arms crossed, she stared at the numbers on the screen.

name: Circuit of Light - Silence
desc: Tapping her arm, Heimdal mapped a new plan, believing innovation and opportunity would come from her mind.

name: Enigmatic Field - Silence
desc: Numbers raced acrouss the screen, finally settling on a figure. Yet it was still insufficient to free the land.

name: True Companions
desc: With her dearest friend, the girl was never alone. They gathered radiant gems together, grinding them into pigments.

name: Warm Memories
desc: A gentle breeze swept across the field. Fresh shoots sprouted. The girl dabbed her canvas with lively green hues.

name: Where Sea Meets Sky
desc: Waves delivered a conch to the shore, echoing tales of mermaids and birds, and love that spanned ocean and sky.

name: Fragrant Sketch
desc: As she painted the waterfall, the glittering spray and drifting mist stirred her memories of wandering in the forest.

name: Phantom Blossoms
desc: Flowers stretched along the city's edge. Familiar figures flickered. Were they illusions, or echoes of longing?

name: Magic of Color
desc: The sun poured molten gold upon the sky. With bold strokes of fiery orange and red, she painted its dazzling glow.

name: Lines of Frost
desc: The wind carried a song of freedom, snow gleaming in cold light. She traced winter's patterns with silver strokes.

name: Brush of Dreams
desc: The palette still bore wet paint. She dipped her brush in vivid hues, filling the canvas with joy and emotion.

name: Neon Nocturne
desc: The lights shimmered like a dream. Emboldened, her strokes grew freer, blending neon brilliance with the night sky.

name: Wings of Dreams
desc: The journey was not yet over. Every unfinished curve and line became the most beautiful mark of eternity.

name: Glazed Wonder
desc: She painted her dreams, dipping brush into the most brilliant colors and leaving memories that never fade.

name: Radiant Wings
desc: No shadow could dim her vision. With passion in her heart, she would paint a new world with every stroke.

name: Messenger in Green
desc: The green bird led him through the mist to a vast bamboo grove. The swaying leaves whispered like voices in the dark.

name: Emerald Veil
desc: The scholar lost his way in the fog. Just as he faltered, a bird broke through the haze and perched on his shoulder.

name: Moss-Covered Stone
desc: A maiden in green appeared. She seemed both a shadow of light and a slender stalk of bamboo come to life.

name: Fragrance of Nature
desc: They brewed tea by the spring. The scholar came to record world's tales. The maiden smiled, telling her own story.

name: Bitter Moon
desc: 100 years ago, a white-robed gentleman visited here. As he spoke of his dreams, the maiden was captivated.

name: Frosted Orchids
desc: The gentleman was soon to leave for an official post, saying it was a perfect time for great minds to shine.

name: Butterfly Under Moon
desc: Hearing this, the scholar sighed, sympathy for the gentleman's fate and his unfulfilled promise to the maiden.

name: Gathering Clouds
desc: He never returned. When she finally cultivated and left the grove, he had long died in prison, undone by intrigues.

name: Stillness of Night
desc: Nourished by the bamboo grove, the maiden could never leave. The gentleman promised to return once he was settled.

name: Shifting Lights
desc: The scholar left in thought, recording all he saw. As he set down his brush, he seemed to hear bamboo rustle again.

name: Birdsong Reverie
desc: The girl hummed a Lilith ballad, pacing gracefully. Her melodious song echoed with the cheerful chirping of birds.

name: Feathered Horizon
desc: Would this be too deliberate?' Bobo shook her head, the wheat swaying beside her. Birdsong sparked inspiration.

name: Hazy Cloudshadow
desc: A girl-shaped cloud passed. As its shadow passed, Bobo worried again: 'What if she doesn't even notice me...?'

name: Golden Field Sky
desc: Hello! I think I lost my hairpin. Could you help me out?' Bobo rehearsed her opening line to the cloud.

name: Tranquil Verse
desc: Her singing softened into a murmur. She stopped, gazing at the distant horizon, thoughts colliding freely.

name: Pearl of Clarity
desc: Pretend to mistake her for someone else? Invite her to the fountain or the bar? All sounded strange!

name: Emerald Gleam
desc: If only there wasn't a mission,' she sighed. Bobo loved the Wheat Field. She loved everything about this place.

name: Clear Pool Ripples
desc: Bobo's thoughts drifted. She couldn't focus on her task, nor could she fully immerse herself in the scenery.

name: Journey Through Time
desc: Her vision blurred, then refocused on striking pink. At the end of the path, a pink-haired girl entered her world.

name: Timeless Ode
desc: Sky and fields composed the backdrop of the meeting. A bird flew by, marking the beginning of their story.

name: Phoenix's Call
desc: Everyone, please hear me out.' Lunar was gentle yet resolute. 'If we retreat, what becomes of the citizens?'

name: Clinking Jade
desc: Trap or opportunity? Debate raged. Lunar remained silent. The letter in her hand felt as heavy as a thousand weights.

name: Afterglow Radiance
desc: What of the Cloud Empire? How shall we withstand the northern cavalry? How can we surrender our homeland?'

name: Celestial Wings
desc: Lunar touched the Nebula Dual sword, recalling Princess Miror repelling the enemy under the sky ablaze with rainbows.

name: Pearl-Bearing Feather
desc: The Cloud City buzzed with activity again. Silk mills operated at full capacity, producing uniforms for the soldiers.

name: Gilded Radiance
desc: Lunar declared, 'From today, every resource of my family will be devoted to the battle until the enemy is defeated.'

name: Pearl Splendor
desc: Guided by stylists, soldiers launched relentless assaults against the League Tyr for a chance at survival.

name: Luminous Pearl
desc: In a moment of advantage, the former Lilith Prime Minister, for reasons unknown, invited Lunar to a duel.

name: Heavenly Strings
desc: I vowed to become the greatest designer, to end the war…' Lunar murmured to the wind.

name: Emerald Cape
desc: At dusk, stylists regrouped in silence. By now, the city was cut off from food and water, hanging by a thread.

name: Golden Ornaments
desc: Lunar once again led the soldiers into battle, but couldn't break Tyr's defenses and were forced to retreat.

name: Gemlike Splendor
desc: She looked around at the exhausted faces. Ignoring the mayor's protests, she accepted the challenge.

name: Crimson Glow
desc: This was a protracted war. Silk and dye rapidly depleted inside; Northern reinforcements continued to arrive.

name: Jade Chimes
desc: The looming clouds finally broke into a torrential rain. Swords in hand, Lunar ascended toward the shadow of fate.

name: Iridescent Crystal
desc: Yvette was the last to leave the office. She turned off the lights and stepped into the dim stairwell.

name: Journey's Treasure
desc: Crouching by the wall, Yvette muffled her sobs. The crushing pressure and relentless workload nearly suffocated her.

name: Phantasia Lumina
desc: A shadow appeared, offering a bunny cookie. Yvette looked up. It was the Prime Minister, always so gentle to her.

name: Traces of Emotion
desc: Not sure who left it on my desk. I just brought it along,' Nidhogg said calmly, his voice as steady as a mountain.

name: Lingering Affection
desc: Yvette ate the cookie, its sweetness melting on her lips and easing the gloom in her heart.

name: Carefree Nocturne
desc: The Tea Party opened at last, with young designers shining on stage and their works drawing eyes across Miraland.

name: Fragrant Whispers
desc: Thanks to Yvette's efforts, another designer who had once declined finally agreed to attend.

name: Ripples of Time
desc: This morning's rain left tiny pools under the rosebushes, and drifting petals rippled across them.

name: Enchanted Tea Party
desc: The round table held delicate treats, tea fragrance filling the garden. At Ace's arrival, all rose to greet her.

name: Whispering Blooms
desc: The conversation flowed: hair ornaments in Oren, boat rides on the Renner, and a visit to the Cecily Art Museum.

name: Courtyard Fragrance
desc: A gentle breeze carried perfume over the gowns as the girls whispered, cheeks bright with joy.

name: Hymn of Blossoms
desc: A noble girl, acquainted with Ace, sat beside her and murmured, 'You finally came… I thought you wouldn't.'

name: Dreamtide Reverie
desc: The head maid glanced from a faint carpet mark, adjusting Ace's attire. 'Princess, please avoid anything dangerous.'

name: Whispered Trust
desc: Amid the music, Ace held her friend's hand. 'It's just a small disagreement with my sister, not the rumors.'

name: Fragrant Hours
desc: Travels always bring fresh wonders. Soon, all were caught up in Ace's lively tales, laughing and gasping.

name: Laughter of Days Past
desc: But I can't shake this… You're too calm. Why just smile? Hey, Ace, don't do anything reckless…'

name: Tender Glance
desc: That's good… Some even said the Queen would throw you into the River Varna!' Ace laughed at her friend's relief.

name: Melodies in Bloom
desc: The band played a familiar tune, the same Ace and Elle once played as children, stirring memories.

name: Dreamborne Drift
desc: She hid the arrowhead in her sleeve and glanced at the card: 'An adventure awaits tonight. Be prepared.'

name: Feather Whisper
desc: On the woodland path, sunlight scattered through leaves. Strangers passed Iset, their chatter fading into the breeze.

name: Blooming Hues
desc: Here, sister. Fresh flowers I just picked for you!' A voice rang by her ear, as warm and gentle as a spring morning.

name: Bell of Blessing
desc: The wind brushed Iset's hair, carrying the answer: the pink-haired girl was safe, chasing her dream steadily.

name: Gem on Feather
desc: When Iset regained her composure, she found herself holding a flower. But the girl had gone before she could respond.

name: Petals in Dew
desc: The soft bloom brushed Iset's hand, its petals flowing beneath the sunlight. It reminded her of that girl.

name: Feather Whisper - Flame
desc: Several priestesses have replied with assent. The rite will be held soon.' Dalia brought the good news to Iset.

name: Blooming Hues - Flame
desc: A sigh misted into the cold air, veiling the merriment. Iset could sense the weighing on the young man before her.

name: Bell of Blessing - Flame
desc: Yet opportunity often arrives with upheaval. What path lies ahead? Iset looked back the way she had come.

name: Gem on Feather - Flame
desc: The celebration reached its peak. People danced to honor the bounty of nature and the splendor of life.

name: Petals in Dew - Flame
desc: Many changes have come... I must thank you and that girl. Because of you, our tribe did not miss this chance.'

name: Frostbound Echo
desc: The Imperial Army and League Tyr cannot rely on the stalemate. Time for planning slips away fast.

name: Resolute Valor
desc: They walked through narrow alleys to a tavern door. Agata pushed it open: 'Perhaps someone here can lend us aid.'

name: Frostbound Echo - Triumph
desc: Fafnir set down his glass, shrugging with indifference. 'Friend among the Iron Rose? I hardly think so.'

name: Resolute Valor - Triumph
desc: The wind screamed through the narrow alley. Louie left the tavern, setting out on a new journey.

name: Tranquil Pastures
desc: Snow slipped from the base. A hollyfinch trembled beneath it—spring's herald, now weak from the endless freeze.

name: Joyful Whimsy
desc: She removed her scarf, gently wrapping the bird, warming it with her own body heat. Then came a quiet, muffled sob.

name: Petals in White
desc: She stepped to the windmill's core and spotted a golden blur—trapped between icicles, a thumb-sized glowing sprite.

name: Quiet Muse
desc: She passed out from the cold. The freed sprite spread its wings, unleashing magic. Ice melted. The windmill turned.

name: Fields Aflutter
desc: In the spinning light, the girl saw her grandfather's image merging with the windmill.

name: Sunlit Verses
desc: The sprite's wings were stuck between icy gears. Afraid to hurt it, the girl used her warmth to melt the ice again.

name: Full Bloom Charm
desc: No storm is too fierce, no cold too cruel. Spring always blooms for a kind heart,' her grandfather's voice echoed.

name: Woven Wings
desc: The hollyfinch puffed its chest and sang a song. The sprite summoned warmth. The girl's body stirred to life.

name: Reedleaf Vintage
desc: Days passed——green turned to gold, then snow. She kept losing, but her blade grew from three moves to thirty.

name: Stormwoven Reed Hat
desc: In the clash of blades, she began to read his moves. Each parry now held a hint of guidance in its sharp reply.

name: Cirrus Sword
desc: Years flew by. After training, Moyun was ready. Before she left, her master gave her a sword—its name: Yunxiao.

name: Bamboo Bind
desc: From then on, she trained with her sect—dawn to dusk, blade to moon. Under her master's care, her skill soared.

name: Verdant Veil
desc: One rainy spring, Moyun finally struck the branch down. Surprise flickered in his eyes—then turned to pride.

name: Leafbound Dream
desc: The swordsman laughed and left; Moyun followed. Warm wine waited—they drank, the cold outside forgotten.

name: Verdant Oath
desc: Face it tomorrow?' The rain split with steel as the swordsman drew his blade. 'Gladly, Master,' Moyun replied.

name: Bladewash Ale
desc: Ten years, one sword. Moyun roamed far, found beauty, made friends, and upheld justice across the martial world.

name: Windbound Journey
desc: The winds carried lost travelers toward the unknown. Faint tribal chants reached her from afar.

name: Desolate Glow
desc: This secluded tribe moved with the changing seasons. Here, Lant gradually let go of the worries she carried.

name: Afterglow of Day
desc: The dusk was the gentlest moment. The sun sank beyond the horizon, and the curling smoke blurred with the wind.

name: Moment Captured
desc: A bird streaked across the sky; moving sand and light intertwined. Lant pressed the shutter, catching the moment.

name: Faded Trace
desc: Wind-eroded cliffs bore the marks of time. Rock carvings had long faded, like the growth rings of this land.

name: Best Companion
desc: Seeing a chest of untouched fabrics, everyone exchanged looks and pulled out their prepared design sketches.

name: Flicking Ears
desc: Each style seemed worth trying, but for the journey ahead, a cloak was the most fitting choice.

name: Fairy Tale of Time
desc: Thus, Momo's new outfit was born! A yellow cloak like the old one, but looser, adjustable, and more comfortable.

name: Fluffy Tail
desc: Since we're at it, let's make one for Nikki too!' Thus, Nikki got her own adorable loungewear.

name: Falling Feathers
desc: An unknown tune echoed beneath the dome. At the stage appeared not the rumored ghost, but a beautiful black swan.

name: Nocturne of Night
desc: At the stroke of midnight, the rotted curtain suddenly opened. A music box began to turn on its own.

name: Whispered Notes
desc: The swan spread its wings and danced with the music. Hidden among seats, the children watched wide-eyed.

name: Gleam of Moonlight
desc: The swan suddenly dove at the intruders. Yet in that instant, the children saw only a pair of tearful eyes.

name: Thorns of Wings
desc: The white tutu was consumed by nightmares. The troupe vanished, leaving behind only whispers of wraiths and curses.

name: Curtain's Fall
desc: The children had heard countless frightening tales, yet the so-called wraith didn't attack them.

name: Ballad of Chains
desc: The girl stunned the world, yet became a tool for profit. She danced day after day, but could never escape.

name: Fluttering Expectations
desc: On the grass, a girl clutched chalk, doodling on a small board. Momo clapped: 'Nikki, that's lovely!'

name: Moment of Wishes
desc: The girl smiled, lifting her design sketch with care. 'Here, it's for you! Carry it with you on your journey ahead!'

name: Fragrant Whispers
desc: The doors of memory opened once again. Nikki bid farewell to her past, moving with the scent of grass and breeze.

name: Blossoms Aglow
desc: Memories shimmered in her eyes. Nikki nodded firmly: 'Mm… I may not have succeeded yet, but I've never given up!'

name: Dawnlit Melody
desc: Eh? Who are you…?' The younger Nikki tilted her head, puzzled. 'You look just like me—are you me, all grown up?'

name: Verses in Bloom
desc: The child brimmed with joy, peppering questions, 'Where will we go? Will we really wear such beautiful gowns?'

name: Crystal Rose
desc: In the journeys ahead, we'll wear splendid dresses and meet many wonderful friends like Momo, cheering for us.'

name: Rose Reverie
desc: Nikki opened her eyes. Momo snoozed at her side as fields sped past the window. Her journey was still unfolding.

name: Unreal Domain
desc: This prism is special. Through it, she sees the other side of ocean with flowers, birds, sunshine. Another world.

name: Stardust Sands
desc: Layla had only seen the Desolate Island, where stars accompanied her, gentle, yet unreachable.

name: Crumbling Illusions
desc: She saw girls in the prism, just as lonely and lost as herself. Without the power of witches, what will they do?

name: Prism Realm
desc: But every girl seemed to hold her own small magic, unworn by mundane routines and each shinning like a star.

name: Mirage Lock
desc: One day, a girl wrote words that appeared distorted in the prism. Layla finally deciphered: 'Break the prism.'

name: Reflected Shadows
desc: More girls used twigs, brushes, and stones to form the words again and again. Silent, yet their message spoke loudly.

name: Crystalized Years
desc: When she opened her eyes again, she was no longer on the island. Beside her was dew-kissed flowers in sunlight.

name: Emerald Isles
desc: After seeing the other side, island life felt unbearably lonely. The images in the prism blurred with her tears.

name: Divine Decree
desc: Billions of stars hang high, chanting like waves. Break the prism. Break it. But fear crawled through Layla's heart.

name: Creation at Fingertips
desc: Layla finally decided to break the prism. The glass shattered like a fading dream and she fell into a deep sleep.

name: Labyrinth of Night
desc: Layla only had stars for company. The prism was her link to another world. Once broken, she'd be alone again.

name: Reflection in the Box
desc: You gave me courage,' Layla thanked them. 'Us?' The girls exchanged looks, 'We haven't done anything.'

name: Sunny Voyage
desc: The energy of dice runs out. The plane lands at the forest edge, where there's a sad bear holding a wilting flower.

name: Booming Starcloud
desc: A waterfall blocks them. Bunny rolls the dice. Engines roar as Rosy bursts through the water, laughing all the way.

name: Adventurous Checkers
desc: Rosy boards the plane with excitement. It takes off trailing streams of rainbow colors. A new adventure begins.

name: Bunny Bubbles
desc: Rolling the dice, Rosy flies far once again. On her voyages, she hears tales from camels and sings with whales.

name: Innocent Blooms
desc: Water collected from the waterfall revives the flower. The bear dances joyfully and gives Rosy his treasured dice.

name: Colorful Brushes
desc: I don't want to say goodbye, but it's time to end the game,' Bunny smiles. 'When you wake up, come and find us!'

name: Cloudy Lullaby
desc: The plane lands near a cliffside castle, where an old owl serves tea, inviting Rosy and Bunny to rest in the garden.

name: Bubble Blaster
desc: Time passes, and Rosy grows up, yet her childhood dreams linger. One day, she notices a call for events at the park.

name: Blazing Radiance
desc: Must we surrender to League Tyr?' A young stylist asked tentatively after silence.

name: Lumen Unspoken
desc: From that day on, something changed in Elena. She still sat on the rocks, gazing far into the ocean's deep blue.

name: Flicker in Dusk
desc: People started avoiding her. No one spoke of it, but fear crept in—a nameless, instinctive unease.

name: Gaze Beyond Time
desc: Since then, no tide ever threatened the village again. Peace returned, and the girl on the reef faded from memory.

name: Dirge of the Deep
desc: One night, Elena heard the call again. She left with the stone and the book, vanishing into the sea mist.

name: Eyes of Divinity
desc: When they looked at her in the sea wind, she seemed like someone else. Her eyes were like the dark, endless ocean.

name: Coffer of the Void
desc: The stone on the book began to glow. Startled awake, Elena touched it—and heard an ancient voice in the void.

name: Starwave Sail
desc: She took out her easel and brushes, carefully marking reefs, currents, and islands, creating her first sea map.

name: Luminous Butterfly
desc: Returning to town, she recounted her adventures. Townsfolk gathered around, fascinated by the unknown ocean.

name: Mystic Scroll
desc: The exquisite map hung in the council hall. Seeds of exploration sprouted as adventurers set sail again.

name: Abyssal Navigator
desc: A butterfly appeared in her dream again, flying toward distant seas, just as she faced unknown challenges.

name: Whimsy Wings
desc: As the map improved, more ships departed. Explorers and traders thrived, and the once-quiet town prospered anew.

name: Final Stroke
desc: All admired her courage yet worried for her. She untied the ropes, raised the sail, and waved to those who cared.

name: Gleaming Verse
desc: The butterfly still danced in her dream. Her gaze fell on the reef-strewn seas that were still uncharted on her map.

name: Azure Startrail
desc: Her voyages were sung by bards, and townsfolk praised her courage and daring on the open sea.

name: Fading Haze
desc: Someone claimed to have found a special bird from Qingqiu, but it turned out to be a normal dove in disguise.

name: Azure Sea Whisper
desc: Distant sails appear faintly in sparkling waves. Watching the horizon while sitting under the parasol is pure joy.

name: Crepuscular Glow
desc: The sun hasn't fully set; the sky turns deep indigo. Golden dusk meets the dark night, blurring colors in the sky.

name: Cloud Iridescence
desc: At dusk, beams of light peek through clouds in soft golden hues, like a cup of honey-orange iced tea.

name: Icy Orange Juice
desc: Tangy-sweet orange and ice are always the best match. A hint of mint adds even more cool freshness.

name: Magical Garden
desc: Camille's garden flourishes under her care, green and bountiful. Everyone loves to come here to pick their produce.

name: Veggie Hairpin
desc: One day, a weary traveler arrives at the garden, drawn by its lush crops, and asks to rest for a while.

name: Fragrant Bloom
desc: Camille welcomes him and offers some fruit to refresh him. In return, he gives her a bag of seeds before leaving.

name: Colorful Fruits
desc: No one has been able to grow these before. Perhaps you, skilled gardener, can make them bloom,' he says.

name: Skilled Handplant
desc: The birds chirp, 'Give up! Give up! Don't waste your time!' But she shakes her head and tends to the seeds with care.

name: Basket of Fresh Delights
desc: By next spring, the seeds finally sprout, sending long vines up the fence and bearing clusters of unripe tomatoes.

name: Whimsical Kettle
desc: The fruits grow bigger than pumpkins, glowing red and hanging proudly. 'The biggest tomatoes ever!' people marvel.

name: Sweet Dream
desc: Maybe it could grant wishes. But Bebena felt it shouldn't be trapped in a glass tank for that.

name: Summer Girl
desc: As nets came out to catch the stranded Dreamfish, Bebena stood, pulled off her shades, and said: 'Beat me first!'

name: Dewdrop Charm
desc: The crowd stared at the girl in shock—someone gasped, 'It's Bebena, that trending stylist everyone's talking about!'

name: Color Clash
desc: The tale of the Dreamfish was hard to resist—just a legend, perhaps, but some still believed it might bring luck.

name: Starfish Mumurs
desc: Bebena gently lifted the Dreamfish, settled on her flamingo float, and drifted as it slipped into the sea.

name: Swift Flash
desc: When she bought the convertible, Abby chose this bold color——each mile toward freedom rekindling her joy.

name: Coconut Breeze
desc: At sunset, Abby stops, barefoot on the shore, savoring the sea breeze and sweet, cool coconut air.

name: Summer Bliss
desc: Leaving the shore, Abby met a painter—vibrant hues on canvas, her heart unfurling like a bloom.

name: Sharp Vision
desc: By the fire, music lit Abby's heart. She danced with the band, then slept beneath a sky full of stars.

name: Nature Muse
desc: Art answers the heart and nature. Remembering this, Abby's pencil meets paper—her spark quietly returns.

name: Poetic Notes
desc: Abby captures each fleeting moment in her sketchbook—messy, lively lines that trace her journey and growth.

name: Cool Sip
desc: The numb self is gone, swept away by the journey's breeze. Abby sips her drink, calm and free in the golden light.

name: Lake Dream
desc: Soft rain veils the world like a filter—fantasy needs no sharp lines. Countless rains shaped her bond with the lake.

name: Rain Bloom
desc: Each rainfall draws her to the ripples. Nature taps its rhythm, and her heart follows, dreaming with every drop.

name: Ripple of Memory
desc: Melutin thought long—loud or quiet scenes passed her mind. In the end, she chose the small lake outside her window.

name: Serenade in Rain
desc: A drifting heart was suddenly pulled. Before Melutin knew it, “Registration Successful” flashed on the tiny screen.

name: Abyssal Hues
desc: To Melutin, it was music she loved—and a mirror of quiet days. Even the plainest moments held a hint of shining joy.

name: Emblem of Dreams
desc: On slow afternoons, she creates freely. Each small joy is “ideal” made real in daily life.

name: Unspoken Vow
desc: Months later, Rain Over the Lake by virtual idol Ruither went viral—its gentle tune and lyrics touched many.

name: Prism Interlude
desc: In the song, people rediscovered quiet emotions lost in daily life—like stars softly glowing in a dark night sky.

name: Luminous Prologue
desc: On quiet afternoons, Melutin wrote by the window. Stuck for words, she looked to the shimmering lake.

name: Sapphire Oath
desc: Rain Over the Lake marked Melutin's start as a songwriter. Years on, she still remembers the nerves of hitting send.

name: Forsaken Echoes
desc: Back then, Aria didn't grasp what “monster” meant to the villagers. She just felt hurt—and vanished with a spell.

name: Mossy Traces
desc: She escaped and sat by the stream, fixing her hair and tail. The villagers saw her and shouted, chasing her off.

name: Wispfire Glade
desc: Joy from escaping faded fast. Stuck in a trap, Aria thought, the world’s too complicated—maybe I should go home.

name: Abandoned Spire
desc: Such trials wouldn’t stop her. Aria had learned the spells—and that night, she reached the human world at last.

name: Luminous Solitude
desc: The young woman was different—her gentle, bright eyes reminded Aria of the moon in Qingqiu's mist. She took Aria in.

name: Hushed Cosmos
desc: She cared for Aria and made chicken soup. Smelling it, the little fox lit up, tail wagging with joy.

name: Unstill Depths
desc: Aria gifted the young woman her jade pendant. They became close friends—sunbathing, picking mushrooms after the rain.

name: Phantom Fire
desc: Aria thought it just another day, skipping after her aunt's shadow as she left the lively human world.

name: Wavering Exile
desc: Her eyes stayed kind, but tears shimmered. Aria didn't understand goodbye—she just wiped them away.

name: Jade Veil
desc: The human girl had clever hands; Aria, in contrast, was clumsy. Her playful ways often made the girl laugh.

name: Spirit Tail
desc: The elders of Qingqiu found out. Soon, Aria's aunt took her home, but she promised to return when she could.

name: Celestial Azure
desc: Since then, Aria explored with caution, doubting her choice to leave Qingqiu—until she met a young woman.

name: Oneiric Tail
desc: On her way home, Aria passed a sunlit meadow. Girls laughed in the grass—she thought, we were like that once too.

name: Petalfall Ephemera
desc: War came before the bloom. Bevelyn fled with her vase, past smoke and farewells, as fire swallowed her town.

name: Shattered Moon
desc: After countless tries, Bevelyn's vase was born one rainy morning—perhaps her one perfect creation.

name: Dew Blossom
desc: Through war, perfection kept Bevelyn going—until a child's scream. She turned; a hoof hung in the air, ready to fall.

name: Silent Verse
desc: Without pause, she raised her vase. Instinct moved faster than thought—even she was surprised.

name: Renascence Vow
desc: Beneath shattered glass, a seed took root. Though it grew on a battlefield, untended, the flower still bloomed.

name: Sigh & Shine
desc: The child was saved, but the perfect vase lay in pieces—scattered in the dust, now worth nothing at all.

name: Lilac Sonata
desc: No time for sorrow—the vase was gone. Bevelyn grabbed a single shard and hurried back on the road.

name: Scented Time
desc: This time, what drove her wasn't a need to protect perfection, but something deeper—something she couldn't yet name.

name: Fragrant Past
desc: Most of glassmaster Bevelyn’s work is lost to time, yet the shattered vase is still remembered.

name: Roseate Berries
desc: People chat over local cuisine and toast to a wonderful holiday, forgetting all worries in cheers and laughter.

name: Dessert Spirit
desc: The girl's eyes light up the moment she sees the lovely earrings. She slips them on, brightening the special holiday.

name: Summer Sparkle
desc: Before the holiday ends, enjoy a cool glass of coconut water! Let its sweetness linger as a lasting memory of the summer~

name: Stellar Moment
desc: As the sun sets, Jinyi closes her notebook full of notes, wipes away sweat, and runs to her friends at the pier.

name: Time of Silence
desc: Aunt Liu wants a couch, Uncle Chen is selling his shop... She notes everything that has happened on Iris Street.

name: Spectacular Life
desc: Grown-ups ask curiously what the kids are discussing, but they all cleverly beat around the bush.

name: Starry Glitter
desc: One morning, the grown-ups wake up to find a newspaper titled Iris Daily lying quietly at their doorsteps.

name: Unbridled Zest
desc: Info on leases, discounts, lost pets... The handwriting may be childish, but the design is creative and full of doodles.

name: Manifesto of Time
desc: The phone rings at the Star Weekly's office. 'You want to talk to Chief Editor Jinyi? Sorry, her schedule is full...'

name: Sunset Glamor
desc: Ten years passed in the blink of an eye, and neon lights now shine along the Iris Street lined with tall buildings.

name: Windfall Surprise
desc: As friends share the gifts from Jinyi, one taps her on the shoulder, asking, 'How's it going? Still too busy?'

name: Glorious Road
desc: With everyone's praise, a dream starts budding in her heart, waiting to one day sail away to a bright future.

name: Echoing Memories
desc: The girl steps out of a taxi, with shopping bags in her hands and a cellphone held between her ear and shoulder.

name: Cosmic Exploration
desc: She mused about whimsical inventions, dreaming of a jetpack to soar to great heights where clouds and stars entwine.

name: Sea of Starlight
desc: Wumei imagined herself as a shepherdess on vast grasslands, running with sheep friends like her little Lambie.

name: Signal of Aries
desc: What wonders lie in the boundless sky? No one suffers sleepless nights there, and stars spend each evening laughing.

name: Woolen Whispers
desc: Wumei felt that Lambie understood her. The little sheep gazed back at her, and its ears would twitch in reply.

name: Engine of Fantasy
desc: The meteor shower never came. Only a few faint stars scattered across the night. This wasn't what she imagined.

name: Shadow Court
desc: Fury burned in Kasim's eyes. Zahra showed no fear, sounding the horn—her long-awaited call for revenge.

name: Dreaming Lights
desc: Hooves closed in. Zahra cloaked herself in her mother's starry veil, fading into shadow, unseen by the hounds.

name: Hanging Moon
desc: Zahra slipped into the palace. Her veil parted like mist—her blade flashed, piercing Kasim's heart.

name: Silent Nightfall
desc: From despair grew resolve. Zahra returned to a city ruled by Kasim's hounds, its glory lost to fear and blood.

name: Golden Gleam
desc: Shadow was her shield. Zahra gathered loyal hands in secret, weaving a cold, burning web of vengeance.

name: Midnight Glow
desc: Horns rose like Kasim's final song. He lunged—steel flashed, but the blade struck his own traitor's heart.

name: Still Night
desc: Kasim is dead! Lay down your arms!' Zahra's voice rang out as dawn broke through the clouds.

name: Luminous Gold
desc: Veiled in shadow, she forged her blade in blood and wrath. Yet she ruled with wisdom. All sang her name—Zahra.

name: Gleaming Stream
desc: With map and pack, Dalf and the little one set off. The fish bid farewell, and the stream rushed ahead to scout.

name: Fairytale Guest
desc: Dalf stroked the little one's back and said, 'I know stories of rivers and lakes. Let me help you find a new home.'

name: Flowing Waters
desc: To Dalf, lakes were painters sketching the sky and rivers were travelers racing to the sea. Every puddle was unique.

name: Gentle Waves
desc: They met a stream tossing the little one off balance. Dalf chuckled, 'It seems we need to find calmer waters.'

name: Swaying Petals
desc: They arrived at a tranquil forest marsh. A pudgy axolotl released bubbles, then floated up and shook its head.

name: Unknown Realm
desc: The little one's kin arrived at their new home. To thank Dalf, they picked the most beautiful flowers for her.

name: Crystal Gleam
desc: The little one swam joyfully, blowing happy bubbles toward Dalf, 'This is the place! Our new home!'

name: Fragrant Ripples
desc: On hot days, the little one would swish its tail, stirring ripples and breezes to bring Dalf a touch of coolness.

name: Dreamer's Companion
desc: Blossoms encircled Dalf, merging into a romantic sea of flowers conveying gratitude to the girl.

name: Thief's Invitation
desc: Good night. May the moon and stars grant you sweet dreams.' With a graceful leap, the girl got on a hot-air balloon.

name: Heartbeat Heist
desc: On a city rooftop, roses rained down. Two wary factions looked up as a figure slid down the balloon's rope ladder.

name: Momo Balloon
desc: The balloon was reportedly crafted after a cheerful late-night talk between the Troupe's prop master and its leader.

name: Under the Moonlight
desc: Countless heart-shaped balloons erupted to blur the crowd's sight. She seized the treasure swiftly.

name: Nocturnal Fantasia
desc: A fragrance drifted on the wind as ornate invitations fluttered down like snow, revealing the thief's next move.

name: Starlit Trace
desc: A cheer broke the quiet. The Troupe saw Milia clutching props, dashing to the rehearsal hall.

name: Free Spirit
desc: With keen senses to track lost treasures and achieve goals, the girl bows to no power, chasing only what's amusing.

name: Dazzling Moment
desc: As the lights dimmed, a spotlight split the dark. Cloak flared, and Milia, the Phantom Thief, stepped into glory.

name: Prelude to Tomorrow
desc: The girl toyed with a gem, watching the factions quarrel on the rooftop. She laughed to herself.

name: Finale in Splendor
desc: Countless clever touches wove into a stunning show, Milia's effort gifting a feast for the eyes.

name: Glimmering Starlight
desc: Starry sky mirrors in her eyes, igniting a light that sees through all things. Past vows stirred within her soul.

name: Astral Hush
desc: The path unfolds in silence. She steps forward as starlight floods her trail, whispering waves of distant warmth.

name: Veil of Stars
desc: Stars fade and bloom in endless rhythm, stirring tides of light. The distant horizon glows with radiant promise.

name: Distant Stardust - Glow
desc: Stars burn bright in the silent sky, tracing the unexpected fate, shattering into dust, and reborn in the fall.

name: Infinite Cosmos - Glow
desc: Stars cast their light across distant space. Even the most ordinary night is a miracle of the universe, she thought.

name: Starlight of Memory - Glow
desc: Even only for a fleeting moment, the twinkling stars left the most brilliant memories amidst the dark.

name: Starlit Drift
desc: Even in the sea of fallen worlds, a glimmer of hope remains—hidden in stardust, glowing on forgotten paths.

name: Sleepless Abyss
desc: The young woman stumbles on—past shattered stars, through collapsing despair—racing toward the night sea's far shore.

name: Lucent Dream
desc: Silent waves crash as she reaches the shore. Breath held, starlight blooms in her palms—alive with infinite dawn.

name: Secret of Innovation
desc: Star Weekly is a famous magazine in Lotusville. Its founder Jinyi is known for her progressiveness and great vision.

name: Afternoon Tea Break
desc: Clink! Lottie set down the teapot a little too hard, nearly toppling the tea tin. Bono sighed, paw to his forehead.

name: Detective Bono
desc: Bono was a true detective: steady, calm and sharp. No clue, no matter how small, could escape his watchful eyes.

name: Lady's Etiquette
desc: Mind your manners...' Bono began, as Lottie shoved her hat down over unruly hair and tore open the letter.

name: Curious Enigma
desc: Madame Dupont wrote in distress from her manor. Her treasured gem brooch had vanished, leaving her sleepless.

name: Silent Testimony
desc: Lottie soon won the hearts of the staff. The head maid said the Madame's kitten, too, had disappeared recently.

name: Elegant Style
desc: Bono found the cat on the cupboard, batting the brooch like a toy. Madame gave it an affectionate, helpless pinch.

name: Vivid Encounter
desc: Lottie found the grieving Madame in the garden. Her witty comfort brought a smile, lifting the gloom bit by bit.

name: Secrets Unveiled
desc: Bono's investigation revealed some clues: tiny paw prints on the table, snagged curtains, a slightly opened window…

name: Tea-Time Whispers
desc: Mystery solved. Sunlight bathed the procelain cups. Busy detectives? Now, they're tea-sipping lady and gentlemen.

name: Retro Reflection
desc: Lottie and Bono compare notes in the hall. Paw prints, fabric snags, the missing cat… Could the culprit be…?

name: Graceful Poise
desc: Lottie narrowed her eyes in comfort. Solving cases is delightful, but so is a warm cup of tea under the sunshine.

name: Purehearted Moments
desc: Lottie always keeps her cheerful sincerity. With that open heart, she often uncovers the most useful clues.

name: Verdant Terrace
desc: From Lantis's poise and grace, people gradually guessed her true identity, yet chose to guard the princess's secret.

name: Veil of Dawn
desc: A relentless plague swept through the kingdom. Windows and doors were shut tight. The bustling streets fell silent.

name: Crystal Dewfall
desc: Ignoring all pleas, Lantis drove the carriage meant for her safety straight toward a mysterious, perilous valley.

name: Verdant Gleam
desc: The horse carried Lantis back. Unconscious, she still clutched the withered lantis flower and its seeds.

name: Golden Radiance
desc: Amid sheer cliffs bloomed the flower she sought. She climbed on, rocks tearing her hands, yet she never paused.

name: Glistening Teardrops
desc: Even if it was a myth, Lantis vowed to find the flower bearing her name, risking everything for a thread of hope.

name: Dawnlight Veil
desc: People cheered the kingdom's salvation and rejoiced at Lantis's awakening. Her tale was passed down through ages.

name: Petal Heartlock
desc: Irena's words float like feathers. Lonna sees a sea of roses as fairies bring a chest with her long-awaited health.

name: Radiant Verses
desc: Dawn and dusk pass. Encouraged by Irena, Lonna lifts the watering can, watching sunlight turn droplets into rainbows.

name: Garden Fragrance
desc: With Irena's support, Lonna finally steps from the room and sows fragrant flower seeds into the soft courtyard soil.

name: Clustered Blossoms
desc: Sitting among flowers, Irena holds Lonna, telling her tales of bees or humming songs about the blossoms.

name: Prelude of Breeze
desc: How to check humidity, prune leaves, and care for buds… Irena is both a skilled gardener and a gentle guardian.

name: Leisurely Daydreams
